jobs.title: Customer Support & AI Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Customer Support & AI Automation Specialist

Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7877

In this hybrid role, you combine hands-on customer support with ownership of automation and AI-driven improvements. You handle customer requests, identify opportunities to reduce manual work, and help teams adopt new AI agents and automation solutions. You act as a key contributor in improving customer experience while driving efficiency across support operations.

What You Will Do

• Handle customer support requests with accuracy, professionalism, and a customer-first mindset while ensuring proper categorization and data quality.

• Identify recurring issues, manual activities, and process inefficiencies, proactively recommending opportunities for automation and AI-driven improvements.

• Take ownership of automation initiatives from idea to implementation, designing practical solutions that improve efficiency, service quality, and customer experience.

• Drive adoption of new ways of working by working closely with the team to turn new ideas into everyday practice.

What You Bring

• 2+ years of experience in customer support, service operations, process improvement, or a similar customer-facing environment.

• Hands-on experience with AI solutions, automation platforms, workflow optimization, or related technologies.

• Proven ability to identify process improvement opportunities and translate them into practical automation initiatives.

• Experience driving automation or continuous improvement initiatives from concept through implementation.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to recognize patterns, optimize workflows, and improve customer experience.

• A proactive, self-driven mindset with a passion for innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.

• Fluent English skills

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41 583 994 236 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Business Continuity Manager

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de la continuité des activités

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Continuity Manager

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8020

You will define and improve end-to-end processes, ensuring operational resilience and business continuity in line with regulatory requirements (including DORA).

You will work closely with business and technology teams to ensure processes are efficient, well-governed and aligned with service objectives.

In this role, you will play a key part in strengthening operational resilience, supporting business continuity frameworks, and driving continuous improvement across the organization.

What You Will Do

• Define and maintain processes using BPM tools (ADONIS preferred)

• Identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities

• Align processes with SLAs and service objectives

• Support Business Continuity (BIAs, BCPs, DR testing)

• Contribute to DORA and operational resilience initiatives

What You Bring

• 3+ years in process management (BPM)

• 3+ years in Business Continuity (BIA, BCP, DR)

• Experience with SLA definition

• Background in regulated environments (e.g. financial services)

• Knowledge of risk management

• Experience with BPM tools (ADONIS or similar)

• Spanish & English (C1)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:

Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Business Continuity Manager Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8020 Definirai e migliorerai i processi end-to-end, garantendo resilienza operativa e continuità aziendale in linea con i requisiti normativi (tra cui DORA). Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di business e tecnologia per garantire i processi sono efficienti, ben governati e allineati con gli obiettivi di servizio. In questo ruolo, si giocherà un ruolo chiave nel rafforzare la resilienza operativa, sostenere i quadri di continuità aziendale, e di promuovere il miglioramento continuo in tutta l'organizzazione. • Definire e mantenere i processi utilizzando gli strumenti BPM (preferito da ADONIS)
• Identificare inefficienze, rischi e opportunità di miglioramento

• Supporto Continuità aziendale (BIAs, BCP, test DR)
• Contribuire a DORA e iniziative di resilienza operativa Che cosa porta
• 3+ anni di gestione del processo (BPM)
• 3+ anni in Business Continuity (BIA, BCP, DR)
• Esperienza con la definizione SLA
• Sfondo in ambienti regolamentati (ad esempio servizi finanziari)
• Conoscenza della gestione dei rischi
• Esperienza con strumenti BPM (ADONIS o simili)
• Spagnolo e inglese (C1) Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Yuliya Stoyko al +34 917095993 . Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. In dieser Rolle spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Stärkung der operativen Widerstandsfähigkeit, der Unterstützung von Business Continuity Frameworks und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung im gesamten Unternehmen. • Definieren und pflegen Sie Prozesse mit BPM-Tools (ADONIS preferred)
• Ineffizienzen, Risiken und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten identifizieren
• Prozesse an SLAs und Servicezielen ausrichten
• Support Business Continuity (BIAs, BCPs, DR-Tests)
• Beitrag zu DORA und operativen Resilienzinitiativen Was du mitbringst
• 3+ Jahre im Prozessmanagement (BPM)
• 3+ Jahre in Business Continuity (BIA, BCP, DR)
• Erfahrung mit SLA Definition
• Hintergrund in regulierten Umgebungen (z.B. Finanzdienstleistungen)

descriptionByLocale.fr:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - conduit la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième groupe de change en Europe. Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Gestionnaire de la continuité des activités Madrid: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% Référence 8020 Vous définirez et améliorerez les processus de bout en bout, en assurant la résilience opérationnelle et la continuité des opérations conformément aux exigences réglementaires (y compris la DORA). Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'affaires et de technologie pour vous assurer que les processus sont efficaces, bien gérés et alignés sur les objectifs de service. Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le renforcement de la résilience opérationnelle, le soutien des cadres de continuité des opérations et l'amélioration continue de l'organisation. Ce que vous ferez
• Définir et maintenir les processus à l'aide des outils BPM (ADONIS préféré)
• Identifier les inefficacités, les risques et les possibilités d'amélioration
• Harmoniser les processus avec les ALS et les objectifs de service
• Soutien à la continuité des activités (ABI, BCP, essais DR)
• Contribuer aux initiatives DORA et de résilience opérationnelle Ce que vous apportez
• 3 ans et plus en gestion des processus (BPM)
• 3 ans et plus en continuité des activités (BIA, BCP, DR)
• Expérience de la définition de l'ALS
• Contexte dans les environnements réglementés (p. ex. services financiers)
• Connaissance de la gestion des risques
• Expérience des outils BPM (ADONIS ou similaires)
• Espagnol et anglais (C1) Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Yuliya Stoyko au +34 917095993 . Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: Customer Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Customer Operations Specialist

London |  100 | Reference 8190

As a key contributor to our sales operations, you will manage a defined customer territory in close collaboration with a Sales Representative. You will also take ownership of all administrative and support activities related to sales and the implementation of financial information systems for our clients.

What You Will Do

•    Territory Management: Oversee a customer sales territory in partnership with Sales and Account Managers, focusing on financial services products for US customers
•    Client Service: Serve as a primary point of contact for customer inquiries related to products, functionalities, data, pricing, exchange permissions, and issue resolution
•    Contract Administration: Draft, process, and manage customer contracts within the financial customer information system
•    Billing & Financial Oversight: Initiate invoicing processes and monitor dunning procedures and accruals to ensure financial accuracy
•    Project Coordination: Manage product and data entitlements, and plan, coordinate, and track customer and sales-related projects from initiation to completion

What You Bring

•    at least 3 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in a middle or back-office environment
•    strong numerical aptitude and attention to detail
•    customer-focused with a proactive and well-organized approach
•    ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment
•    language Proficiency: Excellent verbal and written communication skills

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Specialista delle operazioni del cliente

London | 100 | Riferimento 8190

Come contributore chiave alle nostre operazioni di vendita, gestirai un territorio cliente definito in stretta collaborazione con un rappresentante delle vendite. Avrete anche la proprietà di tutte le attività amministrative e di supporto relative alle vendite e l'implementazione di sistemi informativi finanziari per i nostri clienti.

Cosa farai

• Territory Management: supervisionare un territorio di vendita dei clienti in collaborazione con Sales and Account Manager, concentrandosi sui prodotti di servizi finanziari per i clienti statunitensi
• Servizio Clienti: Servire come punto di contatto primario per le richieste dei clienti relative a prodotti, funzionalità, dati, prezzi, autorizzazioni di cambio e risoluzione dei problemi
• Amministrazione del contratto: Progetto, processo e gestione dei contratti dei clienti all'interno del sistema informativo finanziario del cliente
• Billing & Financial Oversight: avviare i processi di fatturazione e monitorare le procedure e le procedure d'esecuzione per garantire la precisione finanziaria
• Coordinamento del progetto: Gestire i diritti dei prodotti e dei dati, pianificare, coordinare e monitorare i progetti relativi al cliente e alle vendite dall'avvio al completamento

Che cosa porta

• almeno 3 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile, preferibilmente in un ambiente centrale o back-office
• forte attitudine numerica e attenzione ai dettagli
• focalizzato sul cliente con un approccio proattivo e ben organizzato
• capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo in un ambiente dinamico
• lingua competenza: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Anthony Mills al numero +44 207 550 5407 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Modelli di lavoro flessibili

Ci fidiamo dei nostri dipendenti e offriamo un ambiente di lavoro ben bilanciato, produttivo e favorisce il successo.

Sviluppo personale

Potrai beneficiare di una cultura di apprendimento continuo e feedback. La vostra crescita personale è sostenuta attraverso un'ampia offerta di apprendimento.

Metodi di lavoro Agile

Sia attraverso scrum o pensiero di progettazione,

risolviamo attività emozionanti insieme in squadre.

Customer Operations Spezialist

London | 100 | Referenz 8190

Als wichtiger Beitrag zu unseren Vertriebsaktivitäten verwalten Sie ein definiertes Kundengebiet in enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem Vertriebsmitarbeiter. Sie übernehmen auch die Verantwortung für alle administrativen und unterstützenden Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit dem Verkauf und der Implementierung von Finanzinformationssystemen für unsere Kunden.

Was Sie tun werden

• Territory Management: Überwachen Sie ein Kundenverkaufsgebiet in Partnerschaft mit Sales and Account Managern, wobei Sie sich auf Finanzdienstleistungsprodukte für US-Kunden konzentrieren
• Kundenservice: Als primärer Ansprechpartner für Kundenanfragen in Bezug auf Produkte, Funktionen, Daten, Preise, Austauschberechtigungen und Problemlösung dienen
• Vertragsverwaltung: Entwurf, Verarbeitung und Verwaltung von Kundenverträgen innerhalb des Finanzkundeninformationssystems
• Billing & Financial Oversight: Initiieren Sie Rechnungsstellungsprozesse und überwachen Sie Mahnverfahren und Rückstellungen, um finanzielle Genauigkeit zu gewährleisten
• Projektkoordination: Verwalten Sie Produkt- und Datenberechtigungen und planen, koordinieren und verfolgen Sie kunden- und vertriebsbezogene Projekte von der Einleitung bis zum Abschluss

Was du mitbringst

• mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle, vorzugsweise in einer mittleren oder Back-Office-Umgebung
• starke numerische Eignung und Liebe zum Detail
• Kundenorientiert mit einem proaktiven und gut organisierten Ansatz
• Fähigkeit, unabhängig und kollaborativ in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu arbeiten
• Sprachkenntnisse: Hervorragende verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Anthony Mills unter +44 207 550 5407 an.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

Wir vertrauen unseren Mitarbeitern und bieten ein ausgewogenes, produktives und erfolgsförderndes Arbeitsumfeld.

Sie profitieren von einer Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens und Feedbacks. Ihr persönliches Wachstum wird durch ein umfangreiches Lernangebot unterstützt.

Ob durch Scrum oder Design Thinking,

Wir lösen spannende Aufgaben gemeinsam in Teams.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Spécialiste des opérations client

Référence 8190

En tant que contributeur clé de nos opérations de vente, vous gérerez un territoire client défini en étroite collaboration avec un représentant commercial. Vous serez également propriétaire de toutes les activités administratives et de soutien liées aux ventes et à la mise en place de systèmes d'information financière pour nos clients.

Ce que vous ferez

• Territory Management: Superviser un territoire de vente de clients en partenariat avec Sales and Account Managers, en mettant l'accent sur les produits de services financiers pour les clients américains
• Service à la clientèle : servir de point de contact principal pour les demandes de renseignements des clients concernant les produits, les fonctionnalités, les données, les prix, les autorisations d'échange et la résolution des problèmes
• Administration des contrats : Ébauche, traitement et gestion des contrats clients dans le système d'information sur les clients financiers
• Facturation et surveillance financière : Entreprendre des processus de facturation et surveiller les procédures de facturation et les comptes d'exercice afin d'assurer l'exactitude financière
• Coordination du projet : Gérer les droits à l'égard des produits et des données et planifier, coordonner et suivre les projets liés aux clients et aux ventes de l'initiation à l'achèvement

Ce que vous apportez

• au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire, de préférence dans un environnement intermédiaire ou back-office
• forte aptitude numérique et attention au détail
• axé sur le client avec une approche proactive et bien organisée
• capacité à travailler de manière indépendante et en collaboration dans un environnement dynamique
• maîtrise de la langue: Excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Anthony Mills au +44 207 550 5407 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

Ce que nous offrons

Modèles de travail flexibles

Nous faisons confiance à nos employés et offrons un milieu de travail équilibré, productif et propice au succès.

Développement personnel

Vous bénéficierez d'une culture d'apprentissage continu et de rétroaction. Votre croissance personnelle est soutenue par une vaste offre d'apprentissage.

Méthodes de travail agiles

Qu'il s'agisse d'un brouillon ou d'une pensée de design,

nous résolvons ensemble des tâches passionnantes en équipe.

jobs.title: Backend Developer (C)
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Backend Developer (C)

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8113

You enjoy working with internal and external interfaces and are good at working in IT systems/applications? Our goal is to develop, maintain, and give support to IT applications in the connectivity applications for Post Trading area. To achieve that, a high-level knowledge of the application landscape, dependencies and integration is very important.

What You Will Do

• Act as a support technician within a Development Support team

• Develop and maintain application code across the full development lifecycle and assure the right service

• Understand the SIX processes and apply them properly

• Acquire the required knowledge about the applications to which we provide support

• Collaborate with different IT teams to ensure optimal support to the requestors

• Contribute with ideas or initiatives to enhance the team service

What You Bring

• Linux systems administration knowledge

• 3 years of hands-on experience in C programming and shell scripting

• Additional programming skills in languages such as Python, Java, or similar are highly valued.

• DB technology understanding (MSSQL, Postgre, etc.)

• Microservices and containerization knowledge

• Background in IT corporate tools (Jira/Confluence, GIT, VS Code, etc.)

• Experience and knowledge of CI/CD (GitLab, Artifactory, Ansible, Grafana, Elastic, etc)

• High team-working spirit

• Languages: Spanish (native/proficiency) and fluent in English (verbal and written)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Account Manager

Zurich |  80-100% | Reference 8147

Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment? Are you passionate about market data? Then our Account Management team wants to hear from you! We are an AGILE, DRIVEN and international team responsible for the licensing of market data across both legal entities SIX and BME. In this position you will work closely with Administration & Intelligence, Legal & Compliance and Operations.

What You Will Do

• Responsible for the holistic and service-oriented management of existing and new clients within the framework of proactive account management.

• Acting as the primary point of contact for clients, coordinating cross-functional teams (Product, Legal, Operations) to ensure seamless service delivery, while monitoring account performance and aligning solutions with client needs and business objectives.

• Building and maintaining sustainable client relationships.

• Driving commercial growth through upselling and cross-selling of market data services and value-added analytics offerings.

• Initiate and support client audits and assisting the external auditor in the preparation and execution of audit activities.

What You Bring

• Proven experience in the financial services industry (3-8 years).

• Solid background in the market data domain (e.g. data vendor, exchange or bank).

• Experience in account management, sales, or client relationship management.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Fluent in German and English (both verbal & writing), Spanish or French is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Gestione account

Zurigo | 80-100% | Riferimento 8147

Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente altamente dinamico? Sei appassionato di dati di mercato? Allora il nostro team di Gestione account vuole sentire da voi! Siamo un team AGILE, DRIVEN e internazionale responsabile della licenza dei dati di mercato sia in soggetti legali SIX che BME. In questa posizione lavorerai a stretto contatto con l'Amministrazione e l'Intelligence, la Giurisprudenza e le Operazioni.

Cosa farai

• Responsabile della gestione olistica e orientata al servizio dei clienti esistenti e nuovi nell'ambito della gestione dei conti proattivi.

• Agire come punto di contatto principale per i clienti, coordinare i team interfunzionali (Product, Legal, Operations) per garantire la fornitura di servizi senza soluzione di continuità, monitorando le prestazioni del conto e allineando le soluzioni con le esigenze del cliente e gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Costruire e mantenere relazioni cliente sostenibili.

• Guidare la crescita commerciale attraverso upselling e cross-selling di servizi di dati di mercato e offerte di analisi a valore aggiunto.

• Avviare e sostenere gli audit dei clienti e assistere l'auditor esterno nella preparazione e nell'esecuzione delle attività di audit.

Che cosa porta

• Esperienza dimostrata nel settore dei servizi finanziari (3-8 anni).

• Sfondo solido nel dominio dei dati di mercato (ad esempio, fornitore di dati, scambio o banca).

• Esperienza nella gestione dei conti, vendite o gestione dei rapporti con i clienti.

• Forte senso di proprietà e responsabilità.

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese (sia verbale che scritta), spagnolo o francese è un plus.

jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Test Engineer

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8146

The name “debiX” speaks for itself, as the combination of “debit” and “experience” reflects our shared ambition: to provide debit cardholders and issuers with a unique experience.

To this ambition, we are developing a future-proof platform that enables new payment functions. This includes Apple and Google Pay, mobile apps, fraud detection and other innovative solutions for the card use of the future in Switzerland. With your expertise, you will make a significant contribution to the development of a modern and stable hub in a growing and dynamic environment. Shape the new debiX platform and help take the SIX Cards, ATM and Twint ecosystem to the next level. You are a member of one of our Scrum teams and work closely with Software and Requirements Engineers and Product Owners. As part of the team, you will take on tasks across the entire software development lifecycle

What You Will Do

• Develop and maintain automated tests for the debiX platform features within an agile Scrum team

• Design and execute UI and API testing strategies to validate system behavior and user journeys

• Expand and improve test automation to increase efficiency and coverage across releases

• Take ownership of test processes and contribute to quality strategy across the whole development lifecycle

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners to identify improvements and optimize testing workflows

What You Bring

• 6+ years in software testing with experience in API testing and in UI automation tools.

• Understanding of REST/JSON services and SQL-based data querying

• Experience with testing mobile apps on Android and iOS,

• Familiarity with regulated environments such as banking, payments, or fintech and compliance awareness

• Very good written and spoken German with strong communication skills in cross-functional teams

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8095

We are seeking a motivated Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Analyst with a strong technical mindset to support the intelligence collection,  automation and maturation of our intelligence capabilities.

The focus of this role in Cyber Threat Intelligence is to enhance cyber threat intelligence capabilities through automation, AI-driven analysis, and continuous improvement of telemetry and intelligence workflows. You will work closely with senior team members and partners to enhance the company's intelligence capabilities.

This position is available only in Spain due to the restrictions of some of the intelligence sources.

What You Will Do

• Join an international Cyber Threat Intelligence team operating 24x7, including on-call availability when required.

• Monitor, collect, and analyze intelligence from restricted communities, internal telemetry, and monitoring systems to identify actionable insights and support investigations, incident response, and threat detection activities.

• Own and continuously improve weekly intelligence telemetry reporting, dashboards, and visualization capabilities to provide accurate, consistent, and actionable insights to stakeholders.

• Contribute to the automation and orchestration of CTI workflows, including data collection, enrichment, analysis, reporting, and the integration of AI-driven capabilities for correlation, prioritization, and analytical output generation.

• Work with Threat Intelligence Platforms and security tooling, including OpenCTI, Elastic stack, SIEM, Threat Intelligence Platforms, and malware sandboxes, while applying frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to contextualize threats and improve detection effectiveness.

• Collaborate with SOC, Detection & Hunting, Vulnerability Management, Corporate Security, and other cross-functional teams to operationalize intelligence insights, produce threat reports and executive summaries, and support the continuous improvement and scalability of CTI processes.

What You Bring

• 4 years of experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence, incident response, SOC, or related technical cybersecurity roles.

• Strong technical profile with hands-on experience in automation, scripting, or orchestration

• Familiarity with AI applications in cybersecurity, particularly for automation, data processing, analytics, and intelligence workflow improvement.

• Experience with Threat Intelligence Platforms and security monitoring tools, including OpenCTI, Elastic stack, SIEM platforms, or similar technologies.

• Solid understanding of the intelligence lifecycle, telemetry analysis, tactical intelligence collection, and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK for threat detection and analysis

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Analizzatore di intelligenza minaccia Cyber

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8095

Stiamo cercando un motivato Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Analista con una forte mentalità tecnica per supportare la raccolta di intelligenza, l'automazione e la maturazione delle nostre capacità di intelligenza.

Il focus di questo ruolo in Cyber Threat Intelligence è quello di migliorare le capacità di intelligenza delle minacce informatiche attraverso l'automazione, l'analisi guidata dall'IA e il miglioramento continuo dei flussi di lavoro di telemetria e intelligenza. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i membri del team senior e partner per migliorare le capacità di intelligenza dell'azienda.

Questa posizione è disponibile solo in Spagna a causa delle restrizioni di alcune fonti di intelligence.

Cosa farai

• Unisciti a un team internazionale di Cyber Threat Intelligence che opera 24x7, inclusa la disponibilità on-call quando necessario.

• Monitorare, raccogliere e analizzare l'intelligenza da comunità ristrette, telemetria interna e sistemi di monitoraggio per identificare intuizioni e indagini di supporto, risposta agli incidenti e attività di rilevamento delle minacce.

• Possedere e migliorare continuamente le funzionalità di reportistica, dashboard e visualizzazione dell'intelligenza settimanale per fornire informazioni accurate, coerenti e attuabili agli stakeholder.

• Contribuire all'automazione e all'orchestrazione dei flussi di lavoro CTI, tra cui la raccolta dei dati, l'arricchimento, l'analisi, la segnalazione e l'integrazione delle capacità basate su AI per la correlazione, la priorità e la generazione di output analitici.

• Lavora con Threat Intelligence Platforms e tooling di sicurezza, tra cui OpenCTI, Elastic stack, SIEM, Threat Intelligence Platforms e malware sandboxes, mentre applica framework come MITRE ATT&CK per contestualizzare le minacce e migliorare l'efficacia del rilevamento.

• Collabora con SOC, Detection & Hunting, Vulnerability Management, Corporate Security e altri team interfunzionali per operare intuizioni di intelligence, produrre report di minacce e sintesi esecutive, e sostenere il continuo miglioramento e scalabilità dei processi CTI.

Che cosa porta

• 4 anni di esperienza in Cyber Threat Intelligence, risposta agli incidenti, SOC, o relativi ruoli di sicurezza informatica tecnica.

• Forte profilo tecnico con esperienza pratica nell'automazione, nella scrittura o nell'orchestrazione

• Familiarità con le applicazioni AI in sicurezza informatica, in particolare per l'automazione, l'elaborazione dei dati, l'analisi e il miglioramento del flusso di lavoro di intelligenza.

• Esperienza con Threat Intelligence Platforms e strumenti di monitoraggio della sicurezza, tra cui OpenCTI, Elastic stack, piattaforme SIEM o tecnologie simili.

• Solida comprensione del ciclo di vita dell'intelligenza, dell'analisi della telemetria, della raccolta di informazioni tattiche e delle strutture come MITRE ATT&CK per il rilevamento e l'analisi delle minacce

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Yuliya Stoyko al +34 917095993 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Analyste du renseignement sur les cybermenaces

Madrid: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8095

Nous recherchons un analyste motivé de Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) doté d'un solide état d'esprit technique pour soutenir la collecte, l'automatisation et la maturation de nos capacités de renseignement.

Ce rôle dans Cyber Threat Intelligence est axé sur l'amélioration des capacités de renseignement sur les cybermenaces par l'automatisation, l'analyse axée sur l'IA et l'amélioration continue des flux de travail de télémétrie et de renseignement. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les membres de l'équipe senior et les partenaires pour améliorer les capacités de renseignement de l'entreprise.

Cette position n'est disponible qu'en Espagne en raison des restrictions de certaines sources de renseignement.

Ce que vous ferez

• Rejoignez une équipe internationale de Cyber Threat Intelligence fonctionnant 24x7, y compris la disponibilité sur appel au besoin.

• Surveiller, recueillir et analyser les renseignements provenant de collectivités restreintes, les systèmes de télémétrie interne et les systèmes de surveillance afin d'identifier les renseignements exploitables et de soutenir les enquêtes, les interventions en cas d'incident et les activités de détection des menaces.

• Sa propre capacité d'améliorer continuellement les rapports hebdomadaires de télémétrie, les tableaux de bord et la visualisation afin de fournir aux intervenants des renseignements précis, cohérents et exploitables.

• Contribuer à l'automatisation et à l'orchestration des flux de travail de l'ICT, y compris la collecte de données, l'enrichissement, l'analyse, l'établissement de rapports et l'intégration des capacités de corrélation, de hiérarchisation et de production de produits analytiques.

• Travailler avec Threat Intelligence Platforms et l'outillage de sécurité, y compris OpenCTI, Elastic Stack, SIEM, Threat Intelligence Platforms et malware sandboxs, tout en appliquant des cadres tels que MITRE ATT&CK pour contextualiser les menaces et améliorer l'efficacité de la détection.

• Collaborer avec le COS, la détection et la chasse, la gestion de la vulnérabilité, la sécurité de l'entreprise et d'autres équipes interfonctionnelles pour rendre opérationnels les renseignements, produire des rapports sur les menaces et des résumés exécutifs, et appuyer l'amélioration continue et l'évolutivité des processus d'ICT.

Ce que vous apportez

• 4 ans d'expérience dans le renseignement sur la cybermenace, l'intervention en cas d'incident, le COS ou les rôles connexes en cybersécurité technique.

• Profil technique solide avec une expérience pratique dans l'automatisation, le scénario ou l'orchestration

• Connaissance des applications d'IA en cybersécurité, notamment pour l'automatisation, le traitement des données, l'analyse et l'amélioration des flux de travail de renseignement.

• Expérience des plateformes de renseignement de menace et des outils de surveillance de la sécurité, y compris OpenCTI, Elastic pile, SIEM plates-formes, ou des technologies similaires.

jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Cyber Security Resilience Operations Specialist

Warsaw |  up to 40% working from home | Reference 7950

The Cyber Security Resilience Operations Specialist supports the day-to-day operation of the Cyber Security Resilience services, with a strong focus on service desk activities, operational follow-up, and audit support.

The role acts as the first operational layer for File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baseline (SCB), and Vulnerability Management, relieving senior engineers and analysts from administrative, evidentiary, and coordination tasks while ensuring consistency, quality, and audit readiness.

What You Will Do

• Operational & Service Desk Support

• Act as the primary point of contact for service desk requests and tickets related to: File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baseline (SCB / CIS Benchmarks), Vulnerability Management activities

• Triage, track, and coordinate operational tickets, ensuring timely handling and clear communication with stakeholders.

• Perform initial analysis and validation of findings (e.g. expected vs. unexpected changes, status of vulnerabilities, baseline deviations) before escalation.

• Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and FAQs related to Cyber Security Resilience services.

• Tool-Based Operational Activities

• Operate and support Cyber Security Resilience tooling on a daily basis, including retrieving data, validating results, and supporting reporting activities.

• Assist in maintaining data quality and consistency across FIM, SCB, and Vulnerability Management tools.

• Support recurring operational tasks such as: Report generation, Status checks, Evidence extraction, Follow-up tracking

• This role is not responsible for tool engineering, rule development, or architecture, but requires a solid understanding of how the tools work and how results should be interpreted.

• Audit & Compliance Support

• Actively support internal and external audit activities (e.g. FINMA, DORA, internal audits) by extracting audit evidence directly from Cyber Security Resilience tools, ensuring evidence is complete, traceable, and aligned with audit requests, supporting responses to audit questions in coordination with senior team members.

• Maintain structured audit evidence repositories and support continuous audit readiness.

• Help standardise and streamline evidence collection processes to reduce broader team workload.

• Coordination & Stakeholder Support

• Liaise with infrastructure, platform, and operations teams on operational clarifications and ticket follow-ups.

• Support the Cyber Security Resilience team by absorbing operational overhead, allowing engineers and specialists to focus on analysis and improvement initiatives.

• Escalate operational risks, recurring issues, or data gaps to senior team members in a structured manner.

What You Bring

• Solid foundational understanding of cyber security concepts, particularly: Vulnerability management, Secure system configuration / CIS Benchmarks, File integrity and change monitoring

• Hands-on experience working with security or infrastructure tooling, ideally in an operational or service-oriented role.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems, SLAs, and operational support models.

• Experience supporting audits, compliance activities, or evidence collection is a strong advantage.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and reliable in execution.

• Comfortable working with operational data, evidence, and repetitive tasks while maintaining quality.

• Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Proactive in identifying inefficiencies or improvement opportunities in operational processes.

• English Fluency

• German advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Site Reliability Engineer

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8133

We’re looking for a seasoned DevOps/SRE professional to drive automation, reliability, and operational excellence across our platforms. You will own CI/CD pipelines, release processes, incident response, and collaborate closely with development and infrastructure teams to ensure smooth, secure, and scalable delivery.

What You Will Do

• Prioritize automation over manual work; eliminate toil through tooling and process improvements.

• Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to streamline delivery.

• Own release management and deployment processes.

• Design, build, and maintain team CI/CD pipelines.

• Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues.

• Participate in Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement.

• 2nd-Level Support; handle incidents and problem management, participate in on-call rotations and respond to high-priority events.

• Dispatching and Coordination; prioritize and route tasks effectively, communicate clearly with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Ownership and Seniority; bring seasoned expertise and technical judgment, take ownership of critical tasks and projects end-to-end.

What You Bring

• Degree in Computer Science or a related field, plus 5+ years in DevOps/SRE (ideally in containerized environments).

• Deep experience with Linux and containers (Docker, Podman, OpenShift/Kubernetes).

• Strong understanding of CI/CD practices and tooling.

• Excellent problem-solving, prioritization, and ability to work independently.

• Strong work ethic and collaborative mindset.

• Excellent verbal and written English.

• CI/CD: GitLab CI, Ansible (experience building pipelines and automation), ArgoCD, Helm.

• Languages/Scripting: Java or C++, Python, Bash.

• Streaming/Data: Kafka (thorough knowledge).

• Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, ELK,

• Databases/Directory: LDAP/OUD, MySQL.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

• Bases de données/Annuaire: LDAP/OUD, MySQL. jobs.description:

Application Developer (80-100%)

Olten |  Onsite | Reference 7835

Are you passionate about modern technology and building high-performance applications? Do you thrive in an agile environment where collaboration, trust, and ownership matter? Join our Application Development Team and help deliver innovative, high-quality solutions for our customers. • Ability to lead and support development teams with technical guidance while actively contributing as a lead developer.

• Proficiency in English (written and spoken); German and/or Spanish are a plus.

jobs.title: IT Product Manager
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT Product Manager

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8015

Are you passionate about IT technologies and interested in working in a highly dynamic environment? Join the Costs & Vendors team, where you will help manage costs and compliance for our global IT infrastructure and workplace. You will collaborate with internal and external partners to deliver services for the global IT of SIX.

What You Will Do

• Support the financial steering of global IT infrastructure products (budget planning, forecasting, cost transparency)

• Act as a single point of contact for internal stakeholders and coordinate IT procurement requests and clarifications

• Support contract and license management activities (renewal tracking, documentation, basic compliance checks)

• Prepare reports and maintain operational processes (purchase orders, demand verification, renewals, documentation)

What You Bring

• First experience in IT product management, service-, contract- or license management

• Basic financial understanding (budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation) and strong attention to detail

• Strong analytical skills and interest in IT infrastructure and how services are delivered

• Willingness to learn licensing models and understand their commercial impact

• Skilled in Power BI reporting, automation and the use of artificial intelligence

• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German and/or Spanish are a plus

• Growth mindset, open to change, and motivated to take on more responsibility step-by-step

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Developer Platform Engineer (Windows/Linux)
jobs.description:
SIX impulsa la transformación de los mercados financieros.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brillantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

Developer Platform Engineer (Windows/Linux)

Madrid, Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Referencia  8031

We are seeking a Developer Experience Engineer to join our centralized DevOps Tools Team. As a Developer Experience Engineer, you define and configure development environments that software engineers rely on every day. You focus on creating reliable, secure, and consistent developer profiles including IDEs to command‑line tooling and possible CI/CD integration.

Working closely with platform, security, and product engineering teams, you continuously improve the developer experience by reducing friction, increasing automation, and enabling engineers to focus on building high‑quality software.

What You Will Do

• Design, develop, and maintain developer client tools such as CLIs, IDE configurations and local development environments.

• Standardize and automate developer onboarding and local setup across Linux and Windows.

• Integrate client tools with source control, CI/CD pipelines, artifact repositories and package managers.

• Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure secure, policy‑compliant developer environments.

• Act as a technical point of contact for engineering teams, gathering feedback and translating it into tooling and end-to-end developer workflow improvements.

• Document tools, workflows, and best practices to enable self‑service and adoption at scale.

What You Bring

• A strong background in software engineering, DevOps, Docker, platform engineering or developer productivity.

• Solid programming skills in at least one language such as Python, Bash, Powershell or TypeScript.

• Experience working with CI/CD systems and integrating local tooling with build and release pipelines.

• Hands‑on experience with build tools and dependency management, Package managers (e.g. npm, pip, Maven), Linux and Windows environments (preferred).

• A strong focus on developer experience, usability and automation.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to document and explain technical solutions.

If you have any questions,  check out our  FAQ page  or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst internship
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Quantitative Analyst internship

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8197

As an intern in a Quantitative Analyst (Sales) role, you will help transform trading data into actionable insights that support strategic conversations with clients. You will contribute to client analytics and the creation of impactful sales materials and presentations, helping showcase the value of SIX products and services to market participants. This role offers a unique opportunity to apply the concepts learned throughout your studies to real-world challenges and gain first-hand exposure to the fast-paced world of financial markets.

If you want to learn more about how financial market works and gain experience in Quantitative Analyst area, don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Create and enhance client-facing presentations by combining trading data, market insights, and compelling visualisations into clear and impactful sales narratives.

• Monitor and analyse client activity, distil complex data into clear takeaways, and communicate insights to the wider organisation.

• Maintain and further develop existing analytics codebases used to analyse client trading activity, generate insights, and support data-driven client engagement.

• Gain hands-on experience with diverse trading datasets and a state-of-the-art cloud platform, applying modern analytics and AI tools to solve real-world business challenges.

What You Bring

• You are currently pursuing a Master's degree in a quantitative discipline and have a strong interest in financial markets, trading, and data analytics.

• Academic experience applying Python for data analysis, including libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. Exposure to SQL and large-scale data processing frameworks such as PySpark is an advantage.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate complex findings clearly and effectively to a wide range of stakeholders.

• Excellent command of written and spoken English and Spanish

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari e appartiene a SIX, il terzo più grande gruppo di scambi in Europa.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Stage quantitativo di analisti

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8197

Come tirocinante in un ruolo Quantitative Analyst (Sales), si contribuirà a trasformare i dati di trading in insight attuabili che supportano conversazioni strategiche con i clienti. Contribuirai all'analisi dei clienti e alla creazione di materiali e presentazioni di vendita impattanti, contribuendo a mostrare il valore dei prodotti e dei servizi SIX ai partecipanti al mercato. Questo ruolo offre un'opportunità unica per applicare i concetti appresi durante gli studi alle sfide del mondo reale e ottenere l'esposizione di prima mano al mondo veloce dei mercati finanziari.

Se vuoi saperne di più su come funziona il mercato finanziario e acquisire esperienza nell'area Quantitative Analyst, non esitare e applica ora con il tuo CV in inglese.

Cosa farai

• Creare e migliorare le presentazioni orientate al cliente combinando i dati di trading, le intuizioni di mercato e le avvincenti visualizzazioni in narrazioni di vendita chiare e di impatto.

• Monitorare e analizzare l'attività del cliente, distilizzare i dati complessi in luoghi chiari e comunicare informazioni all'organizzazione più ampia.

• Mantenere e sviluppare ulteriormente le basi di codice di analisi esistenti utilizzate per analizzare l'attività di trading dei clienti, generare insight e supportare l'impegno del cliente guidato dai dati.

• Ottieni esperienze pratiche con diversi set di dati di trading e una piattaforma cloud all'avanguardia, applicando strumenti moderni di analisi e AI per risolvere le sfide aziendali del mondo reale.

Che cosa porta

• Attualmente stai perseguendo un Master in una disciplina quantitativa e hai un forte interesse nei mercati finanziari, nel trading e nell'analisi dei dati.

• Esperienza accademica che applica Python per l'analisi dei dati, incluse librerie come Pandas, NumPy e scikit-learn. L'esposizione a quadri di elaborazione dati SQL e su larga scala come PySpark è un vantaggio.

• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con la capacità di comunicare risultati complessi in modo chiaro ed efficace a una vasta gamma di stakeholder.

• Ottimo comando scritto e parlato inglese e spagnolo

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Sara Perez de la Cuesta al +34 91 709 56 80 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette in inglese.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Executive Assistant (80-100%)

Zurich |  Home Office möglich | Reference 8140

Will you take a seat at the center of Banking Services – connecting teams, shaping priorities, and driving execution?
As Executive Assistant to the Head of the Business Unit Banking Services (BBS), a member of the SIX Group Executive Board, you will serve as a trusted partner and play a pivotal role within the BBS leadership team. In this highly visible role, you will go beyond traditional executive support, actively contributing to the prioritization, coordination, and execution of initiatives in a dynamic environment.

Acting as a key interface across the organization, you will connect people, ideas, and decisions, ensuring alignment and momentum on critical topics. You will bring structure to complexity, anticipate challenges, and proactively drive actions to successful outcomes. Leading a small Executive Support team in Poland, you will foster collaboration, high service standards, and continuous improvement.

What You Will Do

• Act as a trusted sparring partner to the Head of Banking Services, helping to shape priorities, navigate complexity, and enable clear focus, effective decisions, alignment, and enabling the Executive to stay focused, make sound decisions, align stakeholders, and drive results.

• Manage the executive office of the Head of Banking Services, including complex calendar and inbox management, meeting coordination, travel arrangements, and day-to-day prioritization of activities.

• Ensure smooth preparation and follow-up of leadership meetings and offsites by coordinating agendas, managing action items, preparing briefing materials, and driving timely execution of decisions.

• Take ownership of selected team-wide coordination topics, and key operational initiatives

• Act as the central coordination point across senior stakeholders inside and outside the organization, ensuring the right people are aligned, informed, and moving in the same direction.

• Lead and develop a small Executive Support team based in Poland.

• Take on additional project responsibilities in line with your experience and ambition

What You Bring

• Experience supporting senior executives (C-level level preferred) in a fast-paced corporate, consulting or banking environment.

• Excellent communication skills, enabling you to build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders.

• Business acumen and sound judgment, with the ability to connect the dots, navigate ambiguity, and serve as a trusted sparring partner.

• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership, enabling you to challenge constructively, take initiative and drive topics forward independently.

• First experience in leading small teams in remote setup

• Excellent organizational and coordination skills with a service-oriented yet assertive approach

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and digital collaboration tools.

• Fluent in German and English.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Assistente esecutivo (80-100%)

Zurigo | Home Office möglich | Riferimento 8140

Ti siedi al centro dei Servizi Bancari – collegando le squadre, plasmando le priorità e guidando l'esecuzione?
In qualità di Assistente Esecutivo al Capo dei Servizi Bancari delle Business Unit (BBS), membro del Consiglio Esecutivo del Gruppo SIX, fungerai da partner affidabile e svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nel team di leadership della BBS. In questo ruolo altamente visibile, andrete oltre il tradizionale supporto esecutivo, contribuendo attivamente alla priorità, al coordinamento e all'esecuzione di iniziative in un ambiente dinamico.

Agendo come interfaccia chiave in tutta l'organizzazione, si collegherà persone, idee e decisioni, garantendo allineamento e slancio su argomenti critici. Si porterà la struttura alla complessità, anticipare le sfide, e guidare proattivamente le azioni per i risultati di successo. Conducendo un piccolo team di supporto esecutivo in Polonia, promuoverai la collaborazione, gli elevati standard di servizio e il miglioramento continuo.

Cosa farai

• Agire come partner risparmiatore di fiducia al capo dei servizi bancari, contribuendo a plasmare le priorità, navigare nella complessità e consentire un focus chiaro, decisioni efficaci, allineamento e consentire all'Esecutivo di rimanere concentrato, prendere decisioni sonore, allineare le parti interessate e guidare i risultati.

• Gestire l'ufficio esecutivo del capo dei servizi bancari, tra cui calendario complesso e gestione delle caselle di posta, coordinamento delle riunioni, accordi di viaggio e priorità di giorno per giorno di attività.

• Assicurare la preparazione e il follow-up fluido di incontri di leadership e offsite coordinando gli ordini del giorno, gestendo gli elementi d'azione, preparando materiali di briefing e guidando l'esecuzione tempestiva delle decisioni.

• Assumere la proprietà di determinati temi di coordinamento a livello di team e iniziative operative chiave

• Agire come punto di coordinamento centrale tra gli stakeholder senior all'interno e all'esterno dell'organizzazione, assicurando che le persone giuste siano allineate, informate e in movimento nella stessa direzione.

• Guidare e sviluppare un piccolo team di supporto esecutivo con sede in Polonia.

• Assumere ulteriori responsabilità del progetto in linea con la vostra esperienza e ambizione

Che cosa porta

• Esperienza che supporta i dirigenti senior (livello C preferito) in un ambiente aziendale, di consulenza o di banca veloce.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, consentendo di costruire fiducia e credibilità con gli stakeholder senior.

• Business acum e giudizio sonoro, con la capacità di collegare i punti, navigare ambiguità, e servire come partner di risparmio affidabile.

• Una mentalità proattiva e orientata alla soluzione con un forte senso di proprietà, che consente di sfidare costruttivamente, prendere iniziative e guidare argomenti in modo indipendente.

• Prima esperienza nella guida di piccoli team nella configurazione remota

• Eccellente capacità organizzative e di coordinamento con un approccio orientato al servizio ma assertivo

• La competenza in applicazioni Microsoft Office e strumenti di collaborazione digitale.

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Maria Teresa Buchanan al numero +41 58 399 8083 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Executive Assistant (80-100%)

Zürich | Home Office möglich | Referenz 8140

Werden Sie im Zentrum von Banking Services Platz nehmen - Teams verbinden, Prioritäten gestalten und die Ausführung vorantreiben?
Als Executive Assistant des Head of the Business Unit Banking Services (BBS), einem Mitglied des Vorstands der SIX Group, werden Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Partner fungieren und eine zentrale Rolle im Führungsteam der BBS einnehmen. In dieser sehr sichtbaren Rolle gehen Sie über die traditionelle Exekutivunterstützung hinaus und tragen aktiv zur Priorisierung, Koordination und Durchführung von Initiativen in einem dynamischen Umfeld bei.

Als zentrale Schnittstelle in der gesamten Organisation verbinden Sie Personen, Ideen und Entscheidungen und sorgen für Ausrichtung und Dynamik bei kritischen Themen. Sie bringen Struktur zur Komplexität, antizipieren Herausforderungen und treiben proaktiv Maßnahmen zu erfolgreichen Ergebnissen. Als Leiter eines kleinen Executive Support Teams in Polen fördern Sie die Zusammenarbeit, hohe Servicestandards und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

Was Sie tun werden

• Handeln Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Sparringspartner für den Head of Banking Services und helfen Sie dabei, Prioritäten zu gestalten, Komplexität zu navigieren und eine klare Fokussierung, effektive Entscheidungen, Ausrichtung zu ermöglichen und es der Exekutive zu ermöglichen, konzentriert zu bleiben, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen, Stakeholder anzugleichen und Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

• Verwalten Sie die Geschäftsstelle des Head of Banking Services, einschließlich des komplexen Kalender- und Posteingangsmanagements, der Sitzungskoordination, der Reisevorbereitungen und der täglichen Priorisierung der Aktivitäten.

• Gewährleistung einer reibungslosen Vorbereitung und Weiterverfolgung von Führungssitzungen und Offsites durch die Koordinierung von Agenden, die Verwaltung von Aktionspunkten, die Vorbereitung von Briefing-Materialien und die rechtzeitige Durchführung von Entscheidungen.

• Übernahme der Verantwortung für ausgewählte teamweite Koordinationsthemen und wichtige operative Initiativen

• Handeln Sie als zentraler Koordinationspunkt für hochrangige Stakeholder innerhalb und außerhalb der Organisation und stellen Sie sicher, dass die richtigen Personen ausgerichtet, informiert und in die gleiche Richtung gehen.

• Führen und entwickeln Sie ein kleines Executive Support-Team mit Sitz in Polen.

• Übernehmen Sie zusätzliche Projektverantwortung im Einklang mit Ihrer Erfahrung und Ihrem Ehrgeiz

Was du mitbringst

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Führungskräften (C-Level-Level bevorzugt) in einem schnelllebigen Unternehmens-, Beratungs- oder Bankenumfeld.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, Vertrauen und Glaubwürdigkeit bei leitenden Stakeholdern aufzubauen.

• Geschäftssinn und gesundes Urteilsvermögen, mit der Fähigkeit, die Punkte zu verbinden, Mehrdeutigkeiten zu navigieren und als vertrauenswürdiger Sparringspartner zu dienen.

• Ein proaktives, lösungsorientiertes Mindset mit starkem Verantwortungsbewusstsein, das es Ihnen ermöglicht, konstruktiv herauszufordern, Initiative zu ergreifen und Themen selbstständig voranzutreiben.

• Erste Erfahrung in der Leitung kleiner Teams im Remote Setup

• Hervorragende Organisations- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten mit einem serviceorientierten und dennoch durchsetzungsfähigen Ansatz

• Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office Anwendungen und digitalen Collaboration Tools.

• fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Maria Teresa Buchanan unter +41 58 399 8083 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre racines locales et pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Assistant exécutif (80-100%)

Zurich Accueil Bureau möglich. Référence 8140

Prenez-vous place au centre des services bancaires – connections des équipes, définition des priorités et exécution de conduite ?
En tant qu'adjoint exécutif du chef de la Business Unit Banking Services (BBS), membre du Directoire du Groupe SIX, vous serez un partenaire de confiance et jouerez un rôle central au sein de l'équipe de direction de BBS. Dans ce rôle très visible, vous allez au-delà du soutien exécutif traditionnel, contribuant activement à l'établissement des priorités, à la coordination et à l'exécution des initiatives dans un environnement dynamique.

En agissant comme une interface clé dans l'ensemble de l'organisation, vous connecterez les gens, les idées et les décisions, assurant l'alignement et l'élan sur des sujets critiques. Vous apporterez une structure à la complexité, prévoirez les défis et conduireez de façon proactive des actions à des résultats fructueux. Dirigez une petite équipe de soutien exécutif en Pologne, vous favoriserez la collaboration, des normes de service élevées et l'amélioration continue.

Ce que vous ferez

• Agir en tant que partenaire fiable du chef des Services bancaires, aider à définir les priorités, naviguer dans la complexité et permettre une orientation claire, des décisions efficaces, l'alignement et permettre à l'exécutif de rester concentré, de prendre des décisions saines, d'harmoniser les intervenants et de produire des résultats.

• Gérer le bureau exécutif du chef des services bancaires, y compris le calendrier complexe et la gestion des boîtes de réception, la coordination des réunions, l'organisation des voyages et la hiérarchisation quotidienne des activités.

• Assurer la préparation et le suivi en douceur des réunions de direction et des réunions hors site en coordonnant les ordres du jour, en gérant les points d'action, en préparant des documents d'information et en conduisant à l'exécution rapide des décisions.

• Prendre en charge certains thèmes de coordination à l'échelle de l'équipe et les principales initiatives opérationnelles

• Agir comme point central de coordination entre les principaux intervenants à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de l'organisation, en veillant à ce que les bonnes personnes soient alignées, informées et en allant dans la même direction.

• Diriger et développer une petite équipe de soutien exécutif basée en Pologne.

• Prendre des responsabilités de projet supplémentaires en fonction de votre expérience et de votre ambition

Ce que vous apportez

• Expérience de soutien aux cadres supérieurs (niveau C préféré) dans un environnement d'entreprise, de consultation ou de banque rapide.

• Excellentes compétences en communication, vous permettant de renforcer la confiance et la crédibilité auprès des principaux intervenants.

• L'esprit d'entreprise et le bon jugement, avec la capacité de relier les points, naviguer l'ambiguïté, et servir de partenaire de confiance.

• Un état d'esprit proactif et axé sur la solution, avec un fort sentiment d'appropriation, vous permettant de défier de manière constructive, de prendre des initiatives et de faire avancer les sujets de façon indépendante.

• Première expérience dans la conduite de petites équipes en configuration à distance

• Excellentes compétences en matière d'organisation et de coordination, avec une approche axée sur le service mais affirmée

• Compétence en applications Microsoft Office et outils de collaboration numérique.

• Fluent en allemand et en anglais.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Maria Teresa Buchanan au +41 58 399 8083 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Financial Markets Research & Content Specialist (with German)

Barcelona |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8203

Are you interested in turning financial market research into content that helps clients and stakeholders understand change? The Marketing Content team develops research-led publications and marketing assets that connect market developments, regulation, technology and client needs across SIX.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Financial Markets Research & Content Specialist (mit Deutsch)

Barcelona | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 8203

Sind Sie daran interessiert, die Finanzmarktforschung in Inhalte umzuwandeln, die Kunden und Stakeholdern helfen, Veränderungen zu verstehen? Das Marketing Content-Team entwickelt forschungsgeführte Publikationen und Marketing-Assets, die Marktentwicklungen, Regulierung, Technologie und Kundenbedürfnisse von SIX miteinander verbinden.

In dieser Rolle kombinieren Sie die Forschung der Finanzindustrie mit redaktionellen und inhaltlichen Fähigkeiten. Sie identifizieren relevante Themen, analysieren Evidenz und verwandeln komplexe Erkenntnisse in klare Berichte, Thought Leadership und wiederverwendbare Marketing-Inhalte. In Zusammenarbeit mit Experten im gesamten Unternehmen tragen Sie dazu bei, die Position von SIX in den Bereichen Finanzmarktinfrastruktur, Daten und Dienstleistungen durch genaue, auf das Publikum ausgerichtete Erzählungen zu stärken.

Zögern Sie nicht und bewerben Sie sich jetzt mit Ihrem Lebenslauf auf Englisch. Wir freuen uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören!

Was Sie tun werden

• Identifizieren Sie Forschungs- und Content-Möglichkeiten, indem Sie die Finanzmärkte, Kundenbedürfnisse, regulatorische Entwicklungen, Technologietrends und die strategischen Prioritäten von SIX überwachen.

• Führen Sie unabhängige Recherchen mit internem Fachwissen, öffentlichen Quellen, Branchenstudien und relevanten Datensätzen durch und bewerten Sie die Auswirkungen auf die Finanzmarktteilnehmer und die Geschäfte von SIX.

• Verwandeln Sie Forschungsergebnisse und komplexe finanzielle, regulatorische und technische Themen in klare, evidenzbasierte Berichte, Thought Leadership und Marketinginhalte, die an unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und Kanäle angepasst sind.

• Interviewen Sie Fachexperten und arbeiten Sie mit Produkt-, Geschäfts-, Daten- und Regulierungsspezialisten zusammen, um Standpunkte zu entwickeln, Ergebnisse zu validieren und die Geschäftsrelevanz sicherzustellen.

• Verwalten Sie Publikationen vom ersten Konzept bis zur Auslieferung, koordinieren Sie redaktionelle Vorschläge, entwerfen Sie, Stakeholder-Reviews, Qualitätskontrolle und Wiederverwendung über Kampagnen und kundenorientierte Kommunikation hinweg.

• Verwenden Sie KI-fähige Tools, um Forschung und Content-Produktion zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig Genauigkeit, Konsistenz, Qualität und Compliance zu gewährleisten.

Was du mitbringst

• Ein Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Wirtschaft, Finanzen, Finanzmärkten, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Finanzmarktforschung, Finanzinhalten, Thought Leadership, Finanzjournalismus, Beratung oder Finanzdienstleistungen mit Beispielen für analytische Publikationen oder Marktstudien.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse der Kapitalmärkte und der Finanzmarktinfrastruktur mit Fachwissen in verschiedenen Bereichen wie Börsenökosysteme, Marktdaten, Nachhandel, Zahlungen, Bankeninfrastruktur, Marktstruktur oder europäische Finanzregulierung.

• Starke Forschungs- und Analysefähigkeiten, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, Quellen zu bewerten, Finanzdaten zu interpretieren, Erkenntnisse mit Kunden- und Geschäftsrelevanz zu verbinden und mit Datenplattformen zu arbeiten.

• Klare Schreib-, Bearbeitungs- und Storytelling-Fähigkeiten, kombiniert mit Stakeholder- und Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten und der Fähigkeit, Facheingaben in zugängliche, genaue und zielgruppenorientierte Inhalte umzuwandeln.

• Hohes Niveau in Deutsch und Englisch, geschrieben und gesprochen.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Sara Perez de la Cuesta unter +34 91 709 56 80 an.

Für diese Stelle akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen in englischer Sprache.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
