descriptionByLocale.fr:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - conduit la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième groupe de change en Europe.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Spécialiste de la recherche et du contenu sur les marchés financiers (avec l'allemand)

Barcelone : travailler de chez soi jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8203

Êtes-vous intéressé à transformer l'étude des marchés financiers en contenu qui aide les clients et les intervenants à comprendre le changement? L'équipe du contenu marketing développe des publications et des actifs marketing dirigés par la recherche qui relient les développements du marché, la réglementation, la technologie et les besoins des clients dans SIX.

Dans ce rôle, vous combinerez la recherche de l'industrie financière avec des capacités éditoriales et de contenu. Vous identifierez les sujets pertinents, analyserez les données probantes et transformerez les conclusions complexes en rapports clairs, leadership de pensée et contenu de marketing réutilisable. En travaillant avec des experts de l'ensemble de l'entreprise, vous aiderez à renforcer la position de SIX dans l'infrastructure, les données et les services des marchés financiers grâce à des récits précis axés sur le public.

N'hésitez pas et appliquez maintenant avec votre CV en anglais. Nous sommes impatients de vous entendre !

Ce que vous ferez

• Identifier les possibilités de recherche et de contenu en surveillant les marchés financiers, les besoins des clients, les développements réglementaires, les tendances technologiques et les priorités stratégiques de SIX.

• Mener des recherches indépendantes à l'aide d'expertises internes, de sources publiques, d'études de l'industrie et de ensembles de données pertinents, et évaluer les implications pour les participants aux marchés financiers et les entreprises de SIX.

• Transformer les résultats de la recherche et les sujets financiers, réglementaires et techniques complexes en rapports clairs et fondés sur des données probantes, en leadership réfléchi et en contenu de marketing adapté à différents publics et canaux.

• Interroger les experts en la matière et collaborer avec les spécialistes des produits, des affaires, des données et de la réglementation afin d'élaborer des points de vue, de valider les constatations et d'assurer la pertinence des activités.

• Gérer les publications du concept initial à la livraison, coordonner les propositions rédactionnelles, rédiger, examiner les parties prenantes, contrôler la qualité et les réutiliser dans les campagnes et les communications avec les clients.

• Utiliser des outils compatibles avec l'IA pour appuyer la recherche et la production de contenu tout en maintenant la précision, la cohérence, la qualité et la conformité.

Ce que vous apportez

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en économie, finance, marchés financiers, administration des affaires ou un domaine connexe.

• Au moins 4 années d'expérience en études de marché financier, contenu financier, leadership de pensée, journalisme financier, conseil ou services financiers, avec des exemples de publications analytiques ou d'études de marché.

• Une bonne connaissance des marchés de capitaux et des infrastructures des marchés financiers, avec une expertise dans plusieurs domaines tels que les écosystèmes d'échange, les données de marché, la post-commerce, les paiements, l'infrastructure bancaire, la structure du marché ou la réglementation financière européenne.

• De solides capacités de recherche et d'analyse, y compris la capacité d'évaluer les sources, d'interpréter les données financières, de relier les constatations à la pertinence des clients et des entreprises et de travailler avec les plateformes de données.

• Compétences claires en rédaction, en édition et en narration, associées aux capacités de gestion des intervenants et des projets et capacité de transformer les commentaires des spécialistes en contenus accessibles, précis et axés sur le public.

• Niveau élevé en allemand et en anglais, écrit et parlé.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Sara Perez de la Cuesta au +34 91 709 56 80 .

Pour cette vacance, nous acceptons uniquement les candidatures directes en anglais.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

• Une bonne connaissance des marchés de capitaux et des infrastructures des marchés financiers, avec une expertise dans plusieurs domaines tels que les écosystèmes d'échange, les données de marché, la post-commerce, les paiements, l'infrastructure bancaire, la structure du marché ou la réglementation financière européenne.

Zurich |  (bis zu 40% Home Office möglich) | Referenz 8155

Als Teamhead Customer Service Center führst du Mitarbeitende personell, fachlich und organisatorisch, stellst gemeinsam mit dem Schichtbetrieb die Einhaltung der Service Levels und Qualitätsstandards sicher und entwickelst Services, Prozesse und Arbeitsabläufe kontinuierlich weiter. Du übernimmst Verantwortung im Tagesgeschäft, im Qualitäts- und Effizienzmanagement sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen und trägst damit wesentlich zur Stabilität und Weiterentwicklung des Customer Service Centers bei.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Du führst Customer Service Agents und Schichtleiter personell, fachlich, organisatorisch und administrativ und förderst ihre Entwicklung durch Coaching, Monitoring, Zielvereinbarungen und regelmässige Standortbestimmungen.

• Du stellst gemeinsam mit dem Schichtbetrieb die Einhaltung der Qualitätsgrundsätze, Service Levels und operativen Abläufe im 7/24h Customer Service Center sicher.

• Du analysierst Qualitäts-, Effizienz- und Leistungskennzahlen, leitest geeignete Massnahmen ab und unterstützt ein wirkungsvolles Betriebscontrolling sowie Risk Management.

• Du verantwortest Themen rund um Rekrutierung, Einarbeitung, Einsatz-, Schicht- und Ferienplanung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit HR, Schichtleitung und internen Schnittstellen.

• Du entwickelst Services und Prozesse konzeptionell weiter, wirkst in Projekten mit und pflegst ein aktives Beziehungsmanagement zu relevanten Anspruchsgruppen.

Das bringst du mit

• Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Fachschule oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung sowie langjährige Berufserfahrung, idealerweise im Banken-, Karten- oder Zahlungsverkehrsumfeld.

• Du bringst solide Führungserfahrung sowie Praxiserfahrung in einem Call Center, Customer Interaction Center oder Kundendienst mit. Erfahrung im 7/24h-Schichtbetrieb und im Workforce Management ist von Vorteil.

• Du denkst prozessorientiert, handelst verantwortungsbewusst und verfügst über analytisches sowie konzeptionelles Denkvermögen, Veränderungsbereitschaft und Durchsetzungsvermögen.

• Du überzeugst durch hohe Sozialkompetenz, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Belastbarkeit, Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität und eine klare Hands-on-Mentalität.

• Du bist sicher im Umgang mit moderner Technik, Telefonie-, Multichannel- und Ticketing-Applikationen, verfügst über sehr gute MS Office-Kenntnisse und kommunizierst verhandlungssicher in Deutsch, Französisch, Englisch und Italienisch.

Vuoi formare attivamente un Customer Service Center di 7/24h con responsabilità di leadership diretta e insieme al tuo team garantire un servizio affidabile, orientato al cliente ed efficiente? In qualità di Customer Service Center Teamhead, tu guidi i dipendenti in termini di personale, competenza e organizzazione, garantisci il rispetto dei livelli di servizio e degli standard di qualità insieme alle operazioni a turni e sviluppi continuamente servizi, processi e flussi di lavoro. Si assume la responsabilità nel business quotidiano, nella gestione della qualità e dell'efficienza, nonché in collaborazione con le interfacce interne e contribuisce in modo significativo alla stabilità e allo sviluppo ulteriore del Customer Service Center.

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Condurrai gli agenti del servizio clienti e i responsabili dei turni in termini di personale, competenza, organizzazione e amministrazione e promuoverai il loro sviluppo attraverso coaching, monitoraggio, accordi di destinazione e regolari regolamenti di localizzazione.

• Insieme alle operazioni a turni, garantisci la conformità ai principi di qualità, ai livelli di servizio e ai processi operativi nel Customer Service Center 7/24h.

• Analizzerai indicatori di qualità, efficienza e prestazioni, tradurrai misure adeguate e supporterai un efficace controllo operativo e una gestione dei rischi.

• Sei responsabile di argomenti relativi al reclutamento, formazione, distribuzione, spostamento e pianificazione delle vacanze in stretta collaborazione con HR, gestione dei turni e interfacce interne.

• Sviluppi servizi e processi concettualmente, partecipi ai progetti e mantieni una gestione attiva dei rapporti con le parti interessate.

Lo porti con te.

• Hai una scuola tecnica completa o un'istruzione equivalente, così come molti anni di esperienza professionale, idealmente nell'ambiente bancario, carta o pagamento.

• Porti una solida esperienza di leadership e un'esperienza pratica in un call center, un centro di interazione con i clienti o un servizio clienti. L'esperienza nel funzionamento a turni 7/24h e la gestione della forza lavoro è un vantaggio.

• Pensate orientati al processo, agire in modo responsabile e avere capacità di pensiero analitiche e concettuali, la volontà di cambiare e affermare.

• Convinci con alte capacità sociali, forti capacità di comunicazione, resilienza, lavoro di squadra, flessibilità e una chiara mentalità hands-on.

• Sei fiducioso nel trattare con tecnologia moderna, telefonia, multicanale e applicazioni di ticketing, hanno una buona conoscenza MS Office e comunicare in tedesco, francese, inglese e italiano.

Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Julia Schmidt al numero +41 583 994 236.

Per questa vacanza, consideriamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi accogliamo le applicazioni indipendentemente dal background personale.

SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us forward: Between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique mixture of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of financial markets with us.

Zurich | (up to 40% home office possible) | Reference 8155

Do you want to actively shape a 7/24h Customer Service Center with direct leadership responsibility and together with your team ensure a reliable, customer-oriented and efficient service? As a Teamhead Customer Service Center, you lead employees in terms of personnel, expertise and organisation, ensure compliance with service levels and quality standards together with shift operations and continuously develop services, processes and workflows. You assume responsibility in day-to-day business, in quality and efficiency management as well as in cooperation with internal interfaces and thus contribute significantly to the stability and further development of the Customer Service Center.

These are your tasks

• You will lead customer service agents and shift managers in terms of personnel, expertise, organisation and administration and promote their development through coaching, monitoring, target agreements and regular location regulations.

• Together with shift operations, you ensure compliance with the quality principles, service levels and operational processes in the 7/24h Customer Service Center.

• You will analyze quality, efficiency and performance indicators, derive suitable measures and support effective operational controlling and risk management.

• You are responsible for topics related to recruitment, training, deployment, shift and holiday planning in close cooperation with HR, shift management and internal interfaces.

• You develop services and processes conceptually, participate in projects and maintain an active relationship management with relevant stakeholders.

You bring that with you

• You have a completed technical school or an equivalent education as well as many years of professional experience, ideally in the banking, card or payment environment.

• You bring solid leadership experience as well as practical experience in a call center, customer interaction center or customer service. Experience in 7/24h shift operation and workforce management is an advantage.

• You think process-oriented, act responsibly and have analytical and conceptual thinking skills, willingness to change and assertiveness.

• You convince with high social skills, strong communication skills, resilience, teamwork, flexibility and a clear hands-on mentality.

• You are confident in dealing with modern technology, telephony, multichannel and ticketing applications, have very good MS Office knowledge and communicate in German, French, English and Italian.

If you have any questions, visit our FAQ page or contact Julia Schmidt on +41 583 994 236.

For this vacancy, we only consider direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we welcome applications regardless of personal background.

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

DevOps Engineer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7866

Do you want to work in an agile environment where passion, trust, innovation, and operational robustness are key principles?
Are you motivated to learn, grow your technical skills, and contribute to modern DevOps practices while working alongside experienced engineers?
If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!
We are looking for an Application Ops Engineer to join our Operations Team and support application development teams through automation, standardized CI/CD pipelines, and the configuration of shared operational platforms.
In this role, you will contribute to building and operating scalable deployment and automation solutions, while gaining hands-on experience with tools such as GitLab, Ansible, ArgoCD, Airflow, and Python, and collaborating closely with developers and platform teams to ensure operational quality and Operations best practices across the application lifecycle.

What You Will Do

• Contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and ArgoCDDevelop, adapt, and maintain reusable automation templates using Ansible

• Support development teams in integrating deployment pipelines, workflows, and observability configurations

• Assist in the operation and improvement of scheduling and workflow automation platforms such as Airflow

• Write and maintain Python scripts to support automation, integrations, and operational tasks

• Help drive standardization, security, and scalability in build and deployment workflows

• Collaborate with central infrastructure teams on provisioning, upgrades, and shared platform services (e.g. Grafana, Vault, ELK)

• Document processes, configurations, and best practices, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives

• Learn and apply modern DevOps tooling and practices, sharing knowledge within the team

What You Bring

• A strong interest in DevOps and automation across the software delivery lifecycle

• Hands-on experience or practical knowledge of GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, ArgoCD, or similar tools

• Basic experience with Python for scripting or automation purposes

• Familiarity with Linux environments and application deployments

• Exposure to observability or monitoring tools such as Grafana, ELK, Prometheus is a plus

• Willingness to learn, ask questions, and collaborate in a cross-functional environment

• Proactive mindset, good communication skills, and a team-oriented attitude

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari e appartiene a SIX, il terzo più grande gruppo di scambi in Europa.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

DevOps Engineer

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 7866

Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente agile dove passione, fiducia, innovazione e robustezza operativa sono principi fondamentali?
Sei motivato a imparare, crescere le tue competenze tecniche e contribuire alle moderne pratiche DevOps mentre lavori insieme a ingegneri esperti?
Se è così, abbiamo un'opportunità emozionante per voi!
Siamo alla ricerca di un Application Ops Engineer per unire il nostro Team Operazioni e supportare i team di sviluppo delle applicazioni attraverso l'automazione, le pipeline CI/CD standardizzate e la configurazione di piattaforme operative condivise.
In questo ruolo, contribuirai a costruire e gestire soluzioni di distribuzione e automazione scalabili, acquisendo al contempo esperienza pratica con strumenti come GitLab, Ansible, ArgoCD, Airflow e Python, e collaborando a stretto contatto con sviluppatori e team di piattaforma per garantire la qualità operativa e le migliori pratiche operative nel ciclo di vita dell'applicazione.

Cosa farai

• Contribuire alla progettazione, implementazione e manutenzione di tubazioni CI/CD utilizzando GitLab e ArgoCDSviluppare, adattare e mantenere modelli di automazione riutilizzabili utilizzando Ansible

• Supporta i team di sviluppo nell'integrazione di pipeline di distribuzione, flussi di lavoro e configurazioni di osservabilità

• Assistere al funzionamento e al miglioramento delle piattaforme di pianificazione e automazione del flusso di lavoro come Airflow

• Scrivere e mantenere gli script Python per supportare l'automazione, le integrazioni e le attività operative

• Guidare la standardizzazione, la sicurezza e la scalabilità nei flussi di lavoro di costruzione e distribuzione

• Collabora con i team di infrastrutture centrali per fornire, aggiornare e servizi di piattaforma condivisi (ad esempio Grafana, Vault, ELK)

• Processi, configurazioni e best practice, contribuendo a iniziative di miglioramento continuo

• Impara e applica strumenti e pratiche DevOps moderni, condividendo le conoscenze all'interno del team

Che cosa porta

• Un forte interesse per DevOps e l'automazione attraverso il ciclo di vita di consegna del software

• Esperienza pratica o conoscenza pratica di GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, ArgoCD, o strumenti simili

• Esperienza di base con Python per scopi di scrittura o automazione

• Familiarità con ambienti Linux e implementazioni applicative

• Esposizione a strumenti di osservazione o monitoraggio come Grafana, ELK, Prometheus è un plus

• Volontà di imparare, porre domande e collaborare in un ambiente interfunzionale

• mentalità attiva, buone capacità di comunicazione e un atteggiamento orientato al team

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Yuliya Stoyko al +34 917095993 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

descriptionByLocale.de:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran und gehört zu SIX, der drittgrößten Börsengruppe in Europa.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

DevOps Engineer

Madrid | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 7866

Möchten Sie in einem agilen Umfeld arbeiten, in dem Leidenschaft, Vertrauen, Innovation und operative Robustheit Schlüsselprinzipien sind?
Sind Sie motiviert, zu lernen, Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten zu erweitern und zu modernen DevOps-Praktiken beizutragen, während Sie mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren zusammenarbeiten?
Wenn ja, haben wir eine spannende Gelegenheit für Sie!
Wir suchen einen Application Ops Engineer, der unserem Operations Team beitritt und Anwendungsentwicklungsteams durch Automatisierung, standardisierte CI/CD-Pipelines und die Konfiguration gemeinsamer Betriebsplattformen unterstützt.
In dieser Rolle werden Sie zum Aufbau und Betrieb skalierbarer Bereitstellungs- und Automatisierungslösungen beitragen, während Sie praktische Erfahrungen mit Tools wie GitLab, Ansible, ArgoCD, Airflow und Python sammeln und eng mit Entwicklern und Plattformteams zusammenarbeiten, um die Betriebsqualität und die Best Practices für den gesamten Anwendungslebenszyklus sicherzustellen.

Was Sie tun werden

• Beitrag zum Design, zur Implementierung und Wartung von CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab und ArgoCDDevelop, Anpassung und Wartung von wiederverwendbaren Automatisierungsvorlagen mit Ansible

• Unterstützung von Entwicklungsteams bei der Integration von Deployment-Pipelines, Workflows und Observability-Konfigurationen

• Unterstützung beim Betrieb und der Verbesserung von Planungs- und Workflow-Automatisierungsplattformen wie Airflow

• Python-Skripte schreiben und pflegen, um Automatisierung, Integrationen und Betriebsaufgaben zu unterstützen

• Unterstützung bei Standardisierung, Sicherheit und Skalierbarkeit in Build- und Deployment-Workflows

• Zusammenarbeit mit zentralen Infrastrukturteams bei Provisioning, Upgrades und Shared Platform Services (z.B. Grafana, Vault, ELK)

• Dokumentation von Prozessen, Konfigurationen und Best Practices als Beitrag zu Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung

• Lernen und wenden Sie moderne DevOps-Tools und -Praktiken an und teilen Sie Wissen innerhalb des Teams

Was du mitbringst

• Starkes Interesse an DevOps und Automatisierung über den gesamten Softwarelieferzyklus hinweg

• Praxiserfahrung oder praktische Kenntnisse von GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, ArgoCD oder ähnlichen Tools

• Grundlegende Erfahrung mit Python für Skript- oder Automatisierungszwecke

• Vertrautheit mit Linux-Umgebungen und Anwendungsbereitstellungen

• Exposition gegenüber Beobachtbarkeit oder Monitoring-Tools wie Grafana, ELK, Prometheus ist ein Plus

• Bereitschaft zu lernen, Fragen zu stellen und in einer funktionsübergreifenden Umgebung zusammenzuarbeiten

• Proaktives Mindset, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und eine teamorientierte Einstellung

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Yuliya Stoyko unter +34 917095993 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - conduit la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième groupe de change en Europe.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Ingénieur DevOps

Madrid: travailler à partir de chez soi jusqu'à 40 % Référence 7866

Voulez-vous travailler dans un environnement agile où la passion, la confiance, l'innovation et la robustesse opérationnelle sont des principes clés?
Êtes-vous motivé à apprendre, développer vos compétences techniques et contribuer aux pratiques DevOps modernes tout en travaillant avec des ingénieurs expérimentés?
Si oui, nous avons une opportunité passionnante pour vous!
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur d'applications pour rejoindre notre équipe des opérations et soutenir les équipes de développement d'applications par l'automatisation, des pipelines CI/CD normalisés et la configuration de plateformes opérationnelles partagées.
Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez à la construction et à l'exploitation de solutions de déploiement et d'automatisation évolutives, tout en acquérant une expérience pratique avec des outils tels que GitLab, Ansible, ArgoCD, Airflow et Python, et en collaborant étroitement avec les développeurs et les équipes de plateforme pour assurer la qualité opérationnelle et les meilleures pratiques d'exploitation tout au long du cycle de vie des applications.

Ce que vous ferez

• Contribuer à la conception, à la mise en œuvre et à l'entretien des pipelines CI/CD en utilisant GitLab et ArgoCDDévelopper, adapter et maintenir des modèles d'automatisation réutilisables en utilisant Ansible

• Aider les équipes de développement à intégrer les pipelines de déploiement, les flux de travail et les configurations d'observation

• Aider à l'exploitation et à l'amélioration des plates-formes de programmation et d'automatisation des flux de travail telles que Airflow

• Écrire et entretenir des scripts Python pour soutenir l'automatisation, les intégrations et les tâches opérationnelles

• Contribuer à la normalisation, à la sécurité et à l'évolutivité des flux de travail de construction et de déploiement

• Collaborer avec les équipes centrales d'infrastructure à la fourniture, à la mise à niveau et au partage des services de plate-forme (p. ex. Grafana, Vault, ELK)

• Documenter les processus, les configurations et les pratiques exemplaires, contribuant aux initiatives d'amélioration continue

• Apprendre et appliquer les outils et les pratiques DevOps modernes, partager les connaissances au sein de l'équipe

Ce que vous apportez

• Un vif intérêt pour DevOps et l'automatisation tout au long du cycle de vie de la livraison de logiciels

• Expérience pratique ou connaissance pratique d'outils GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, ArgoCD ou similaires

• Expérience de base avec Python à des fins de script ou d'automatisation

• Familiarité avec les environnements Linux et les déploiements d'application

• Exposition à des outils d'observation ou de surveillance tels que Grafana, ELK, Prométheus est un plus

• Volonté d'apprendre, de poser des questions et de collaborer dans un environnement interfonctionnel

• Un état d'esprit proactif, de bonnes compétences en communication et une attitude axée sur l'équipe

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Yuliya Stoyko au +34 917095993 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: Quantitative Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Quantitative Risk Analyst

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8143

As Quantitative Risk Analyst of SIX Clearing, you will be a key member of our Financial Quantitative Risk Management team. Your primary resposibility is to develop, calibrate, implement and review quantitative risk methodologies of SIX Clearing, enhancing the existing quantitative risk methodologies framework in compliance with the Regulation, and according to the SIX Group risk policies, procedures and best practices in terms of risk management.

What You Will Do

• Developing, calibrating, implementing and reviewing quantitative risk models, stress- and back-tests, scenario analysis to ensure SIX Clearing resilience to adverse market conditions

• Write well-formulated documents of model/methodology specifications, behavior, and testing results

• Close collaboration with other Clearing teams, such as Financial Risk Management Clearing, SIX Clearing’s Operations (1st line of defense) amongst others

• Advise management on the identification and measurement of the different risks faced by SIX Clearing, as well as on the introduction of good practices in line with other CCPs and markets

What You Bring

• Minimum of 3 year ‘experience in the financial markets industry, Quantitative Risk or Trading area, preferably in banks

• Strong quantitative background, desirable an MSc or PhD degree in a quantitative subject, preferably a degree in financial mathematics

• Broad knowledge of financial products from bonds to cryptos. Strong understanding of derivatives products

• Solid experience with Databases and programming skills with Python as the primary language. Experience with other analytical or scripting languages is a plus

• Strong analytical, critical thinking, excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills

• Good communication skills in English and Spanish to clearly convey ideas in front of various audiences, and concise writing skills

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Analizzatore di rischio quantitativo

Madrid | 100% | Riferimento 8143

SIX gestisce l'infrastruttura in base al settore finanziario svizzero e offre una gamma completa di servizi in tutto il mondo nel campo delle operazioni di negoziazione e insediamento di titoli, informazione finanziaria e pagamento.

Noi guidiamo la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ecco perché investiamo in menti luminose, nelle loro idee, conoscenza e sviluppo. Lo facciamo combinando i nostri migliori lati. Se volete scoprire perché la stabilità ci rende così agili, perché l'esperienza ci rende così curiosi e perché l'empatia ci rende così incisivi, applica ora per la posizione di Quantitative Risk Analyst.

Cosa farai

• Sviluppare, calibrare, implementare e rivedere modelli di rischio quantitativi, test di stress e back-test, analisi degli scenari per garantire la resilienza SIX Clearing alle condizioni di mercato avverse

• Scrivere documenti benformulati di specifiche modello/metodologia, comportamento e risultati di test

• stretta collaborazione con altri team di Clearing, come Financial Risk Management Clearing, SIX Clearing Operazioni (1a linea di difesa) tra gli altri

• Consiglia la gestione all'identificazione e alla misurazione dei diversi rischi affrontati da SIX Clearing, nonché all'introduzione di buone pratiche in linea con altri PCC e mercati

Che cosa porta

• Minimo di 3 anni di esperienza nell’industria dei mercati finanziari, zona di rischio quantitativo o di negoziazione, preferibilmente nelle banche

• Forte background quantitativo, auspicabile un grado MSc o PhD in un argomento quantitativo, preferibilmente una laurea in matematica finanziaria

• Ampia conoscenza dei prodotti finanziari da obbligazioni a cripto. Forte comprensione dei prodotti derivati.

• Esperienza solida con Database e competenze di programmazione (Python, Matlab e VBS)

• Forte pensiero analitico, critico, ottima attenzione ai dettagli e alle competenze di problem solving

• Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese e spagnolo per trasmettere chiaramente idee di fronte a vari pubblico, e competenze di scrittura concise

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Tedesco Lopez Arranz al +34 91 709 5771 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

jobs.description:

Accountant Manager

Stamford |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8153

Join SIX, the Swiss Exchange Group, as a Financial Accountant supporting our Financial Information business in the United States. You'll play a key role in financial reporting, accounting, tax, and compliance while working across a global finance organization.

What You Will Do

• Deliver accurate and timely financial reporting by supporting the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing process, preparing journal entries, reconciliations, and analyses, and contributing to IFRS-compliant financial statements and management reporting.

• Own and continuously improve core accounting processes across the general ledger, including accruals, payroll, fixed assets, prepaid expenses, cash management, and intercompany transactions, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and strong financial governance.

• Drive tax compliance and tax accounting activities by coordinating federal, state, and local tax filings, supporting tax provisions and deferred tax calculations, monitoring regulatory developments, and partnering with internal and external advisors on compliance, audits, transfer pricing, and planning initiatives.

• Strengthen financial controls and compliance by supporting audits, statutory reporting, regulatory requirements, and the continuous enhancement of internal controls and accounting practices.

• Act as a trusted business partner to Finance leadership by providing insightful financial analysis, identifying risks and improvement opportunities, collaborating across Finance, HR, and many other internal and external stakeholders, and driving automation, standardization, and process excellence across accounting, reporting, and tax functions.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field; CPA, CMA, or similar professional certification preferred.

• 5+ years of progressive accounting experience in complex, multinational, or public accounting environments.

• Strong technical expertise in IFRS, financial reporting, and U.S. tax and regulatory requirements.

• Proven experience managing accounting, close, reporting, reconciliation, and tax compliance processes.

• Analytical, detail-oriented, and collaborative professional with strong communication skills and systems proficiency.

• Advanced Excel skills and experience working with modern ERP systems (especially SAP).

Site Reliability Engineer

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 8055

Do you thrive in highly dynamic, fast-paced environments where reliability, automation, and innovation are at the core of engineering culture?

We are looking for a talented Site Reliability Engineer  to join our SRE & Platform Engineering team in Warsaw.

In this role, you will help design, automate, and operate scalable, resilient, and cloud-native platforms supporting critical business services. You will work closely with development, infrastructure, and security teams to improve system reliability, accelerate delivery pipelines, and drive operational excellence through automation and AI-driven initiatives.

At our company, we strongly encourage innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. Engineers are empowered to propose and implement new ideas, experiment with automation and AI technologies, and continuously expand their skills through access to modern training platforms, certifications, and learning resources.

What You Will Do

• Drive automation and reliability initiatives across infrastructure and application platforms to reduce operational overhead and improve system resilience

• Design, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies for secure, scalable, and efficient software delivery

• Manage and improve Kubernetes/OpenShift-based container platforms in production environments.

• Develop automation solutions and internal tooling using Bash/Shell scripting, Python, and Java (Scala experience is a strong plus).

• Partner with development teams to improve observability, performance, scalability, and operational readiness of services.

• Lead incident response activities, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures to improve platform stability.

• Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to ensure high availability and operational visibility.

• Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices using modern DevOps and cloud-native tooling.

• Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the engineering organization.

• Explore and adopt AI-powered operational tooling and automation opportunities to improve engineering efficiency and reliability.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Platform Engineering roles within modern containerized/cloud-native environments

• Strong Linux system administration expertise with advanced Bash/Shell scripting skills.

• Strong programming experience in Python, experience with Java is required, and Scala knowledge is considered a strong advantage

• Hands-on experience with container and orchestration technologies including Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, and OpenShift

• Strong understanding of CI/CD, GitOps, and infrastructure automation practices

• Experience with tools and technologies such as GitLab CI/CD, ArgoCD, Helm, Ansible, Kafka, and observability/monitoring platforms

• Solid troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in complex distributed systems environments

• Experience with production incident management, root cause analysis, and reliability engineering practices.

• Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Do you want to shape the future of capital markets infrastructure in a highly dynamic environment?  We seek a Head Strategy & Business Development for Securities Services , based in Zurich or Madrid, responsible for translating strategy into execution, driving growth initiatives, and leading partnerships and M&A efforts. • Advise executive leadership on priorities, resource allocation, and strategic decisions using structured insights

• Drive cross‑business growth across clearing, custody, securities finance, and trade repositories

• Build and oversee business-intelligence capabilities supporting data-driven business and strategic decisions.

• Own M&A workstreams and business cases, ensuring alignment with long‑term strategy and integration success

• Strong experience in strategy or consulting within exchanges or financial market infrastructures

• 10 years of relevant professional experience with a proven leadership track record building high‑performing teams during transformation and change programs

• Deep expertise in post‑trade services, market infrastructure, and regulatory and competitive dynamics

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross‑business initiatives and execute strategy with measurable outcomes

• Fluent English required, with strong communication skills; German and/or Spanish is an advantage

Chef Stratégie et développement des entreprises Services de valeurs mobilières

Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% possible

Le responsable du développement des entreprises et de la stratégie définit et fournit le programme de croissance de SIX Securities Services. Ce rôle est à l'origine d'initiatives stratégiques transversales, de nouvelles créations d'entreprises, de partenariats et de possibilités de fusions et acquisitions, ce qui permet à BSS de se positionner comme un fournisseur d'infrastructure post-négociation européen de premier plan.

Fonctionnant sur toutes les verticales de produits, elle traduit la stratégie en exécution, ouvre de nouvelles possibilités de revenus et aide les cadres supérieurs à diriger le développement à long terme de l'unité opérationnelle.

Ce que vous ferez

• Diriger l'exécution stratégique : Traduire la stratégie de SSC en feuilles de route claires, en assurant une prestation disciplinée, la gestion des risques et des résultats mesurables.

• Identifier et offrir des possibilités de croissance : Élargir les flux de revenus entre les services de compensation, de garde, de financement des valeurs mobilières et de valeur ajoutée, y compris les nouveaux marchés et les segments de clients.

• Diriger les partenariats et les initiatives de S et A : Élaborer des partenariats stratégiques et gérer les possibilités de croissance inorganique, de l'évaluation à l'intégration.

• Conseiller les cadres supérieurs : Fournir des conseils stratégiques, des analyses de rentabilisation et une surveillance du rendement pour appuyer la prise de décisions au niveau des cadres supérieurs.

• Assurer l'alignement interfonctionnel : favoriser la collaboration entre les unités commerciales et renforcer le positionnement de SIX avec les clients et au sein de l'écosystème des marchés financiers.

Ce que vous apportez

• Expérience approfondie en matière de stratégie et de leadership : Expérience éprouvée en matière de stratégie d'entreprise, de consultation ou de développement d'entreprise au sein des infrastructures des marchés financiers ou des marchés de capitaux.

• Forte concentration sur l'exécution : Capacité démontrée de traduire la stratégie en priorités réalisables et de réaliser des initiatives à grande échelle ayant un impact mesurable.

• Expertise approfondie de l'industrie : Compréhension solide des services post-négociation, de la dynamique des infrastructures de marché et de l'environnement réglementaire.

• Expérience des partenariats et des fusions-acquisitions : Exposition directe aux partenariats stratégiques et à la croissance inorganique, y compris l'élaboration d'analyses de rentabilisation et la planification de l'intégration.

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT Service, Governance Risk & Compliance Specialist

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8225

Do you want to help strengthen reliable, compliant, and well-governed IT services in a regulated financial market environment? We are looking for an IT Service, Governance Risk & Compliance Specialist to join our IT Management Team within Exchanges IT in Las Rozas, Madrid. In this role, you will support service management, Service Level Agreements (SLA) governance, IT controls, audit readiness, and risk management activities across relevant IT services. You will work closely with application owners, risk owners, and technical teams in a collaborative environment built on ownership, trust, and continuous improvement.

We are looking forward to hear from you. Apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) performance across applications and IT services, prepare service reports, and support regular service reviews.

• Coordinate IT control, audit, and compliance activities, including evidence collection, remediation tracking, and follow-up actions.

• Work with risk owners and application owners to identify, assess, and document operational and technology risks.

• Maintain governance documentation, service metrics, and management reporting to support transparent decision-making.

• Collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to improve operational resilience, control effectiveness, and service quality.

What You Bring

• A minimum of 3 years of experience in IT service management, IT audit, IT controls, or governance roles, ideally in a regulated environment.

• Good understanding of Service Level Agreements (SLA) governance, service reporting, operational risk, and compliance processes.

• Ability to coordinate evidence collection, follow-up actions, and remediation activities with different stakeholders.

• Structured, analytical, and detail-oriented working style, with strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Professional proficiency in English and Spanish are required.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8225

Vuoi contribuire a rafforzare i servizi IT affidabili, conformi e ben governati in un ambiente di mercato finanziario regolamentato? Siamo alla ricerca di un Servizio IT, Governance Risk & Compliance Specialist per aderire al nostro IT Management Team all'interno di Exchanges IT a Las Rozas, Madrid. In questo ruolo, supporterai la gestione dei servizi, la governance di Service Level Agreements (SLA), i controlli IT, la disponibilità di audit e le attività di gestione dei rischi nei servizi IT rilevanti. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i proprietari di applicazioni, i proprietari di rischi e i team tecnici in un ambiente collaborativo costruito su proprietà, fiducia e miglioramento continuo.

Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applica ora con il tuo CV in inglese.

Cosa farai

• Monitorare le prestazioni degli Accordi di livello di servizio (SLAs) attraverso applicazioni e servizi IT, preparare i rapporti di servizio e supportare regolari recensioni dei servizi.

• Coordinate le attività di controllo, audit e compliance dell'IT, incluse la raccolta delle prove, il monitoraggio della bonifica e le azioni di follow-up.

• Lavora con i proprietari di rischi e i proprietari di applicazioni per identificare, valutare e documentare i rischi operativi e tecnologici.

• Mantenere la documentazione di governance, metriche di servizio e report di gestione per sostenere il processo decisionale trasparente.

• Collabora con team tecnici e stakeholder per migliorare la resilienza operativa, l'efficacia del controllo e la qualità dei servizi.

Che cosa porta

• Un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei servizi IT, audit IT, controlli IT o ruoli di governance, idealmente in un ambiente regolamentato.

• Buona comprensione degli accordi di livello di servizio (SLA) governance, reporting di servizio, rischio operativo e processi di conformità.

• Capacità di coordinare la raccolta delle prove, le azioni di follow-up e le attività di bonifica con diversi stakeholder.

• Stile di lavoro strutturato, analitico e orientato al dettaglio, con forti capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione.

• Sono richieste competenze professionali in inglese e spagnolo.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Sara Perez de la Cuesta al +34 91 709 56 80 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette in inglese.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

jobs.title: Performance Test Engineer (Linux)
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Performance Test Engineer (Linux)

Madrid, Barcelona |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7888

Are you passionate about modern technology and eager to work in an agile, highly dynamic environment at the heart of the stock exchange trading business? Join our team that integrates and operates the low latency matching application within the trading platform. Your role will be to design, implement, automate and document latency, throughput, performance, capacity, failover tests. In this position as a Performance Test Engineer you will work closely with testing, infrastructure, network, security teams.

What You Will Do

• Design, implement, and execute performance/NFT strategies for a matching application, with a focus on latency, throughput, jitter, failover, and load testing across pre prod and prod like environments.

• Build and automate test harnesses, scenarios, and continuous integrations to continuously assess performance, regression test results, and scalability; leverage Ansible and scripting for repeatable tests in various environments.

• Visualize results of NF testing, create performance dashboards using different tools (e.g., Grafana), produce reports and recommendations for engineering and other stakeholders.

• Collaborate with functional testers, infrastructure, network, and database teams to model realistic market conditions, tune systems, and design non-functional test cases; contribute to release readiness and change planning.

• Troubleshoot and analyze issues from low level network packets to OS and application behavior; drive root cause analysis and propose performance optimizations and mitigations.

What You Bring

• Strong Linux engineering background with excellent Bash scripting and Python programming skills complemented with C/C++.

• Experience implementing and executing fully automated non-functional tests; ability to simulate market like traffic patterns.

• Very good understanding of networks and various factors that impact low latency systems.

• Hands on experience with DevOps practices and toolchains relevant to automation and continuous testing (e.g., Ansible, GitLab, CI, Airflow, Openshift/ArgoCD); familiarity with version control and artifact handling will be a plus.

• Analytical mindset with excellent troubleshooting skills across layers; collaborative communicator comfortable working with infrastructure, network, application, and security teams; readiness to occasionally work outside normal hours for major tests or incidents.

• Very good verbal and written English.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Join our team that integrates and operates the low latency matching application within the trading platform. Your role will be to design, implement, automate and document latency, throughput, performance, capacity, failover tests. In this position as a Performance Test Engineer you will work closely with testing, infrastructure, network, security teams.

What You Will Do

• Design, implement, and execute performance/NFT strategies for a matching application, with a focus on latency, throughput, jitter, failover, and load testing across pre prod and prod like environments.

• Build and automate test harnesses, scenarios, and continuous integrations to continuously assess performance, regression test results, and scalability; leverage Ansible and scripting for repeatable tests in various environments.

• Visualize results of NF testing, create performance dashboards using different tools (e.g., Grafana), produce reports and recommendations for engineering and other stakeholders.

• Collaborate with functional testers, infrastructure, network, and database teams to model realistic market conditions, tune systems, and design non-functional test cases; contribute to release readiness and change planning.

• Troubleshoot and analyze issues from low level network packets to OS and application behavior; drive root cause analysis and propose performance optimizations and mitigations.

What You Bring

• Strong Linux engineering background with excellent Bash scripting and Python programming skills complemented with C/C++.

• Experience implementing and executing fully automated non-functional tests; ability to simulate market like traffic patterns.

• Very good understanding of networks and various factors that impact low latency systems.

• Hands on experience with DevOps practices and toolchains relevant to automation and continuous testing (e.g., Ansible, GitLab, CI, Airflow, Openshift/ArgoCD); familiarity with version control and artifact handling will be a plus.

• Analytical mindset with excellent troubleshooting skills across layers; collaborative communicator comfortable working with infrastructure, network, application, and security teams; readiness to occasionally work outside normal hours for major tests or incidents.

• Very good verbal and written English.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Talent Acquisition intern

Madrid |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 8085

Are you passionate about Human Resources and interested in the financial industry? Then our Talent Acquisition team, responsible for Recruiting and Sourcing, wants to hear from you!

We are looking for a bright, dedicated team player to join our HR department for a 6-months part-time internship, where you can put into practice everything you are learning in your degree or master.

You will be providing hands-on support to help drive our international Talent Acquisition, working closely with our internal and external partners, such as universities and collaborating in our recruiting processes.

What You Will Do

• Assist in Talent Acquisition processes and support ongoing recruitment projects

• Collaborate across the full recruitment cycle, from sourcing to onboarding

• Provide ad hoc administrative and coordination support to the TA team

• Help maintain recruitment data and documentation in internal systems

• Participate in employer branding and candidate experience initiatives What You Bring

What You Bring

• be pursuing a university degree in Psychology, Business Administration, Labor Relations, communications or a master's degree in HR

• first experience in Recruiting or HR will be valuable

• ability to work in a fast-paced environment with very good time management, communication and organization skills

• proactive and creative mindset with an ability to work in a team as well as autonomously

• fluent verbal and written English. Spanish, German or Polish would be a plus

• essere inseguendo una laurea in Psicologia, Business Administration, Labor Relations, comunicazioni o un master in HR

If you’re motivated, curious, and eager to contribute to high‑quality data operations, this role offers a great opportunity to grow and make an impact.

What You Will Do

• perform technical onboarding of fund data providers, including file analysis, mapping configuration, testing, and production deployment

• monitor and manage data deliveries, ensuring successful processing and maintaining mailbox forwarding rules

• coordinate with stakeholders to clarify requirements and support onboarding and operational activities

• investigate and resolve data, mapping, and technical issues, escalating complex cases when required

• monitor daily processing and exceptions in DataHub, Xceptor, and related systems to ensure operational stability

• maintain data quality and reference data, including share class mappings, asset classifications, and coverage analysis

What You Bring

• bachelor’s or higher education degree in Finance, Economics or Computer Science and at least 1 year of working experience in financial services

• good knowledge of financial markets and securities instruments

• analytical, methodological, technical, problem-solving skills are a key strength

• motivated, inquisitive and organized team player with a "can do” spirit

• excellent verbal and written skills in English

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Datenanalyst

Warschau | Bis zu 40% von zu Hause aus arbeiten möglich | Referenz 8128

Als Data Analyst spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gewährleistung der Genauigkeit, Stabilität und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Datenprozesse. Diese Position ist ideal für jemanden, der gerne mit komplexen Datensätzen arbeitet, mit Stakeholdern zusammenarbeitet und technische Herausforderungen mit einer strukturierten, analytischen Denkweise löst. Wenn Sie motiviert, neugierig und eifrig sind, zu qualitativ hochwertigen Datenoperationen beizutragen, bietet diese Rolle eine großartige Gelegenheit, zu wachsen und etwas zu bewirken.

Was Sie tun werden

• Führen Sie das technische Onboarding von Fondsdatenanbietern durch, einschließlich Dateianalyse, Zuordnungskonfiguration, Tests und Bereitstellung der Produktion

• Überwachung und Verwaltung der Datenlieferungen, Gewährleistung einer erfolgreichen Verarbeitung und Aufrechterhaltung der Regeln für die Postfachweiterleitung

• Koordination mit Stakeholdern zur Klärung von Anforderungen und Unterstützung von Onboarding und operativen Aktivitäten

• Untersuchung und Lösung von Daten, Mapping und technischen Problemen, bei Bedarf Eskalation komplexer Fälle

• Überwachung der täglichen Verarbeitung und Ausnahmen in DataHub, Xceptor und verwandten Systemen zur Gewährleistung der Betriebsstabilität

• Aufrechterhaltung der Datenqualität und Referenzdaten, einschließlich Share-Class-Mappings, Asset-Klassifizierungen und Coverage-Analysen

Was du mitbringst

• Bachelor- oder Hochschulabschluss in Finanzen, Wirtschaft oder Informatik und mindestens 1 Jahr Berufserfahrung in Finanzdienstleistungen

• gute Kenntnisse der Finanzmärkte und Wertpapierinstrumente

• analytische, methodische, technische, problemlösende Fähigkeiten sind eine Schlüsselstärke

• motivierter, neugieriger und organisierter Teamplayer mit einem "Can Do" -Geist

• ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Fähigkeiten in Englisch

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Agnieszka Leputa unter +48 538 562 645 an

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Analyste des données

Varsovie: jusqu'à 40% de travail à domicile possible

En tant qu'analyste de données, vous jouerez un rôle clé pour assurer la précision, la stabilité et la fiabilité de nos processus de données. Cette position est idéale pour quelqu'un qui aime travailler avec des ensembles de données complexes, collaborer avec les intervenants et résoudre les défis techniques avec un état d'esprit structuré et analytique. Si vous êtes motivé, curieux et désireux de contribuer à des opérations de données de haute qualité, ce rôle offre une excellente occasion de grandir et d'avoir un impact.

Ce que vous ferez

• effectuer l'embarquement technique des fournisseurs de données du fonds, y compris l'analyse des fichiers, la configuration des cartes, les essais et le déploiement de la production

• surveiller et gérer les livraisons de données, assurer le traitement efficace et maintenir les règles de transmission des boîtes aux lettres

• coordonner avec les parties prenantes pour clarifier les exigences et l'appui aux activités de bord et opérationnelles

• enquêter sur les données, la cartographie et les problèmes techniques et les résoudre, en augmentant les cas complexes au besoin

• surveiller le traitement quotidien et les exceptions dans DataHub, Xceptor et les systèmes connexes pour assurer la stabilité opérationnelle

• maintenir la qualité des données et les données de référence, y compris la cartographie des classes de parts, la classification des actifs et l'analyse de la couverture;

Ce que vous apportez

• Licence ou diplôme d'études supérieures en finance, économie ou informatique et au moins 1 an d'expérience dans les services financiers

• bonne connaissance des marchés financiers et des instruments de valeurs mobilières

• Les compétences analytiques, méthodologiques, techniques et en résolution de problèmes constituent une force clé

• motivé, curieux et organisé joueur d'équipe avec un "peut faire" esprit

• excellentes compétences verbales et écrites en anglais

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa au +48 538 562 645

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: Atlassian Cloud Administrator (Jira & Confluence)
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - impulsa la transformación de los mercados financieros y pertenece a SIX, el tercer grupo bursátil más grande de Europa.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brillantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

Atlassian Cloud Administrator (Jira & Confluence)

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Referencia  8033

Provide strategic ownership of Jira and Confluence Cloud as enterprise platforms, ensuring they are secure, scalable, and continuously improved to meet evolving customer and organizational needs. Acts as the highest escalation point for complex issues and as a technical authority with expert knowledge of Atlassian Marketplace apps, including BigPicture and ScriptRunner. Provides 3rd‑level support and drives platform optimization through advanced configuration, automation, and AI capabilities to enhance user experience, delivery efficiency, and decision‑making.

What You Will Do

• Provide strategic ownership of Jira and Confluence Cloud as enterprise platforms, ensuring they are secure, scalable, and continuously improved to meet evolving customer and organizational needs.

• Acts as the highest escalation point for complex issues and as a technical authority with expert knowledge of Atlassian Marketplace apps, including BigPicture and ScriptRunner.

• Provides 3rd level support and drives platform optimization through advanced configuration, automation, and AI capabilities to enhance user experience, delivery efficiency, and decision making.

What You Bring

• Expert administration of Jira Software, JSM, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise environments

• Proven experience providing 3rd‑level (L3) support for Atlassian products (strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to work independently on high‑impact issues)

• Advanced use of Marketplace apps (e.g. BigPicture, ScriptRunner) and strong experience in their administration

• Very good technical English skills (written and spoken), suitable for technical documentation and collaboration with international stakeholders

• Automation & AI enablement (Jira Automation, Rovo, AI features) to improve efficiency and user experience

• Solid understanding of integrations, data flows, and limitations within Atlassian Cloud

Si tienes alguna duda, consulta nuestra página de preguntas frecuentes (FAQ) o contacta con Yuliya Stoyko   +34 917095993 .

Para esta vacante sólo aceptamos solicitudes directas.

La diversidad es importante para nosotros. Por lo tanto, estamos deseando recibir solicitudes independientemente de cualquier contexto personal.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Legal Counsel

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8164

Do you want to work in an international environment where collaboration, trust, and innovation are paramount? We are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join the Group Corporate Centre Legal team, with a particular focus on M&A, while also supporting broader corporate centre matters. You will work in a diverse and flexible environment in close cooperation with colleagues in various jurisdictions, contributing to strategic initiatives that shape the future of our markets.

We are looking to hear from you. Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Lead or support M&A transactions, corporate reorganizations and other strategic Group initiatives.

• Provide legal advice and support on other strategic, complex or time-sensitive matters where Corporate Centre input is required.

• Prepare high-quality materials and deliver clear, concise legal input to support decision-making at senior management and board level.

• Work closely with internal stakeholders, regulators and authorities, preparing key documentation and ensuring effective execution.

• Lead or support cross-functional initiatives, manage external counsel, and contribute to the development of legal processes, frameworks and tools.

What You Bring

• Master's degree in law, admission to the bar in Spain or another relevant European jurisdiction and 5+ years of professional experience in a law firm or the financial sector.

• Strong expertise in M&A and corporate law; experience in competition law and/or financial market regulation is an advantage.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior leadership, board-level contacts, and external stakeholders.

• Independent, pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset, with sound judgment, discretion and the ability to handle sensitive matters.

• Affinity for technology and digital tools, including AI-enabled solutions; proficiency in Microsoft 365; fluency in English and Spanish.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Consigliere legale senior

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8164

Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente internazionale dove la collaborazione, la fiducia e l'innovazione sono fondamentali? Siamo alla ricerca di un Senior Legal Counsel per unire il Gruppo Corporate Centre Legal team, con una particolare attenzione alla M&A, supportando anche questioni più ampie del centro aziendale. Lavorerai in un ambiente diversificato e flessibile in stretta collaborazione con colleghi di varie giurisdizioni, contribuendo a iniziative strategiche che plasmano il futuro dei nostri mercati.

Cosa farai

• Condurre o sostenere le transazioni M&A, le riorganizzazioni aziendali e altre iniziative strategiche del Gruppo.

• Fornire consulenza legale e supporto su altre questioni strategiche, complesse o puntuali in cui è richiesto l'ingresso del Corporate Centre.

• Preparare materiali di alta qualità e fornire un ingresso legale chiaro e conciso per sostenere il processo decisionale a livello di senior management e board.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni, i regolatori e le autorità, preparare la documentazione chiave e garantire l'esecuzione efficace.

• Guidare o sostenere iniziative interfunzionali, gestire il consulente esterno e contribuire allo sviluppo di processi legali, quadri e strumenti.

Che cosa porta

• Laurea magistrale in diritto, ammissione al bar in Spagna o un'altra giurisdizione europea rilevante e 5+ anni di esperienza professionale in uno studio legale o nel settore finanziario.

• Forte competenza in M&A e diritto societario; l'esperienza nel diritto della concorrenza e/o la regolamentazione del mercato finanziario è un vantaggio.

jobs.title: Real-time Data Service Specialist
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Real-time Data Service Specialist

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8171

As a Real-Time Data Service Specialist, you ensure the quality, availability, and transparency of real-time market data services by monitoring data feeds and coordinating the resolution of customer-impacting issues. Working closely with colleagues across time zones, you support our services 24/7 and collaborate with customers, data sources, and internal stakeholders.

Operating at the intersection of data operations, customer support, and technical troubleshooting, you combine data expertise, analytical thinking, and technical understanding to manage time-critical incidents, assess customer impact, and drive service improvements. Acting as a central coordination point between customers, Customer Support, Product teams, and Service Reliability Engineers, you help deliver a reliable service experience and outstanding customer outcomes.

What You Will Do

• Perform data monitoring and quality management for incoming data feeds from exchanges and contributors, including anomaly detection, validation, cleanup, and follow-up actions for existing and future sources.

• Act as the central coordination point for critical real-time incidents end-to-end, performing structured triage, customer impact assessment, stakeholder coordination, and transparent customer communication.

• Investigate and troubleshoot technical issues across market data delivery, APIs, network connectivity, and service operations, ensuring timely resolution and escalation.

• Provide operational expertise and technical consultancy by maintaining customer context, supporting onboarding activities, and collaborating across business and technology teams.

• Drive service reliability and continuous improvement through monitoring enhancements, release readiness, automation, recurring issue analysis, and operational excellence initiatives.

• 24/5 shifts (7 hours) with colleagues in Warsaw and around the globe

What You Bring

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to understand complex data flows, system dependencies, and customer impact scenarios.

• Experience in production support, incident management, monitoring, or market data services, ideally within financial services or another business-critical environment.

• Good understanding of IT systems, APIs, networking, data processing, and troubleshooting techniques; scripting, SQL, or automation skills are an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Specialista del servizio dati in tempo reale

Varsavia | 100 | Riferimento 8171

In qualità di Data Service Specialist in tempo reale, garantisci la qualità, la disponibilità e la trasparenza dei servizi di dati di mercato in tempo reale monitorando i feed di dati e coordinando la risoluzione dei problemi di impatto del cliente. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i colleghi attraverso i fusi orari, supporta i nostri servizi 24/7 e collabora con i clienti, le fonti di dati e gli stakeholder interni.

Operando all'incrocio tra operazioni di dati, assistenza clienti e risoluzione dei problemi tecnici, si combina l'esperienza dei dati, il pensiero analitico e la comprensione tecnica per gestire incidenti critici nel tempo, valutare l'impatto del cliente e migliorare il servizio di azionamento. Agendo come punto di coordinamento centrale tra i clienti, il supporto clienti, i team di prodotto e gli ingegneri di affidabilità del servizio, aiuta a fornire un'esperienza di servizio affidabile e risultati eccezionali del cliente.

Cosa farai

• Eseguire il monitoraggio dei dati e la gestione della qualità per i feed di dati in arrivo da scambi e contributori, tra cui rilevamento anomalia, validazione, pulizia e azioni di follow-up per le fonti esistenti e future.

• Agire come punto di coordinamento centrale per gli incidenti critici in tempo reale end-to-end, eseguire triage strutturato, la valutazione dell'impatto del cliente, il coordinamento delle parti interessate e la comunicazione del cliente trasparente.

• Indagare e risolvere problemi tecnici attraverso la consegna dei dati di mercato, API, la connettività di rete e le operazioni di servizio, garantendo la risoluzione tempestiva e l'escalation.

• Fornire competenze operative e consulenza tecnica mantenendo il contesto del cliente, sostenendo le attività di bordo, e collaborando tra team aziendali e tecnologici.

• Affidabilità del servizio di guida e miglioramento continuo attraverso miglioramenti di monitoraggio, disponibilità di rilascio, automazione, analisi dei problemi ricorrenti e iniziative di eccellenza operativa.

• 24/5 turni (7 ore) con colleghi a Varsavia e in tutto il mondo

Che cosa porta

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con la capacità di comprendere flussi di dati complessi, dipendenze di sistema e scenari di impatto del cliente.

• Esperienza nel supporto alla produzione, nella gestione degli incidenti, nel monitoraggio o nei servizi di dati di mercato, idealmente all'interno dei servizi finanziari o di un altro ambiente business-critical.

• Buona comprensione dei sistemi IT, API, networking, elaborazione dei dati e tecniche di risoluzione dei problemi; script, SQL, o abilità di automazione sono un vantaggio.
