jobs.title: SOC Analyst
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

SOC Analyst

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8166

The Security Operations Center (SOC) is a critical Line of Defense 1 function at SIX, responsible for detecting, investigating, and responding to cyber threats across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and email environments. We are looking for a hands-on security professional with experience in incident response, threat hunting, and security monitoring. In this role, you will investigate complex alerts, develop and tune detection use cases, support containment and remediation efforts, improve automation and playbooks, and proactively identify threats to strengthen SIX's overall security posture.

Does it sound interesting for you? Apply now with your CV in English. We are looking forward to hearing for you.

What You Will Do

• Develop, tune, and maintain threat detections and SIEM use cases across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, mail, and M365 environments.

• Investigate complex security incidents, lead threat analysis, and coordinate containment and remediation activities.

• Design and improve detection content, SOC automation, SOAR workflows, and incident response playbooks.

• Conduct proactive threat hunting using threat intelligence and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

• Identify detection gaps and continuously enhance SOC capabilities and security posture.

• Mentor junior analysts and contribute to SOC process improvements and knowledge sharing.

What You Bring

• 4+ years of experience in SOC operations, detection engineering, threat hunting, and incident response.

• Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, and SOAR platforms (preferably Sentinel, Elastic, Defender for Endpoint, and Cortex XSOAR).

• Strong background in detection rule development, security investigations, and threat hunting across multiple telemetry sources.

• Experience with scripting, automation, APIs, and tools such as Python, GitLab, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD practices.

• Knowledge of security query languages and frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK.

• Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Risponder incidente

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8166

Il Security Operations Center (SOC) è una funzione critica della linea di difesa 1 a SIX, responsabile per rilevare, indagare e rispondere alle minacce informatiche attraverso gli ambienti endpoint, identità, rete, cloud e e e e-mail. Stiamo cercando un professionista di sicurezza pratico con esperienza in risposta agli incidenti, la caccia alle minacce e il monitoraggio della sicurezza. In questo ruolo, si indagano avvisi complessi, sviluppare e sintonizzare casi di utilizzo, sostenere gli sforzi di contenimento e di bonifica, migliorare l'automazione e playbook, e identificare proattivamente le minacce per rafforzare la postura di sicurezza generale di SIX.

Cosa farai

• Sviluppare, sintonizzare e mantenere i rilevamento delle minacce e i casi di utilizzo di SIEM in ambienti endpoint, rete, identità, cloud, mail e M365.

• Investigate complessi incidenti di sicurezza, analisi delle minacce di piombo e coordinare le attività di contenimento e di bonifica.

• Progettare e migliorare il contenuto di rilevamento, l'automazione SOC, i flussi di lavoro SOAR e i playbook di risposta incidente.

• Condurre la caccia alla minaccia proattiva utilizzando l'intelligenza delle minacce e il framework MITRE ATT&CK.

• Identificare le lacune di rilevamento e migliorare continuamente le capacità SOC e la postura di sicurezza.

• Mentor junior analisti e contribuire a miglioramenti del processo SOC e condivisione della conoscenza.

Che cosa porta

• 5+ anni di esperienza nelle operazioni SOC, ingegneria di rilevamento, caccia alle minacce e risposta agli incidenti.

• Esperienza pratica con piattaforme SIEM, EDR e SOAR (preferibilmente Sentinel, Elastico, Difensore per Endpoint e Cortex XSOAR).

• Sfondo forte nello sviluppo delle regole di rilevamento, nelle indagini di sicurezza e nella caccia alle minacce attraverso più fonti di telemetria.

• Esperienza con scripting, automazione, API e strumenti come Python, GitLab, Azure DevOps e pratiche CI/CD.

• Conoscenza delle lingue e dei framework di query di sicurezza, tra cui MITRE ATT&CK.

• Forte capacità analitiche, di comunicazione, di collaborazione e di mentoring.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Tedesco Lopez Arranz al +34 91 709 5771 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Governance Counsel
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Corporate Governance Counsel

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8090

We are looking for a Corporate Governance Counsel to help strengthen corporate governance across the Group. The role is of mid-level seniority, with room for learning and development.

In this role, you will work closely with the Head Legal Governance and the Governance teams in Switzerland and Spain. You will help shape governance standards, support legal entity management, and improve key governance processes across an international group.

We are looking forward to hear from you. Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Assist the Company Secretary and Assistant Company Secretary in the scheduling, preparation and running of the meetings of the Board of Directors, prepare the minutes, manage the sharing of information according to internal practices and regulations, manage secretariat formalities (notary, filing, registers etc..).

• Provide governance advice relative to the governance of legal entities, including newly established entities, acquired entities, divestitures, joint ventures and in the context of re-organizations and assist in the review of governance documents, including Articles of Association, Organization Rules, and Competency Rules.

• Advise on signature authority and support the development of related policies and processes.

• Create and maintain templates for governance-related documentation and improve key governance workflows and support and drive governance projects and AI-based process improvements.

• Maintain document management and SharePoint structures and ensure proper archiving and draft legal memos, prepare presentations, and deliver training to internal stakeholders. Draft powers of attorney and support notarial and registration processes.

• Work with colleagues across functions and jurisdictions to deliver practical governance solutions and assist in the establishment of standards and processes to ensure a coordinated and efficient governance of all legal entities within the Group.

• Participate in the execution of strategic projects as they relate to legal entities and governance.

What You Bring

• A minimum of 5 years of corporate governance experience in Spain.

• Experience in establishing standards and processes across a group of legal entities incorporated in different jurisdictions.

• You write clearly, work in a structured way, and turn complex topics into practical solutions.

• Team player personality with strong collaborative skills, an eye for details and pragmatism. You value simplicity over complexity. You can be relied upon for your discretion and efficiency. You are eager to continuously learn and develop and welcome feedback and guidance.

• You are confident using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, and you are comfortable working with AI tools.

• You are fluent in English and Spanish.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8090

London |  60% office requirement and 40% hybrid | Reference 8209

Are you looking to grow your career in a dynamic, collaborative environment? We are seeking a Data Licensing Specialist for Finance & Process Automation to join our London-based Data Licensing Managment team, with responsibility for financial tasks, operational compliance and quality assurance.

You will work with minimal supervision and manage a varied workload. The role involves supporting Customers, Data Suppliers, Sales, Data Acquisition and the wider Customer Operations team, while working closely with Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable and Controlling. You will manage external relationships on financial matters, support issue resolution, and play an active role in process improvement, automation initiatives and the adoption of AI-enabled solutions across operational activities. The role offers the opportunity to combine financial process ownership with innovation, helping to improve efficiency, scalability and service quality within Customer Operations and Data Licensing Management. • Perform sanctions screening and security master data controls in line with regulatory, compliance, and risk management requirements.

• Monitor data quality, investigate discrepancies, and resolve exceptions to support operational excellence and client satisfaction.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Operations, Compliance, Product, and Technology teams to improve data processes and controls.

• Contribute to process optimization, automation initiatives, and continuous improvement activities within Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) services.

What You will Bring

• Experience in operations, data management, business process outsourcing, financial services, or a related environment.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to analyze, validate, and maintain large volumes of sensitive data accurately.

• Knowledge of sanctions screening, regulatory requirements, KYC/AML principles, or financial market infrastructure is advantageous.

• Excellent problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to investigating and resolving operational issues.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Data Licensing Specialist (Finance & Process Automation)

Londra | 60% richiesta di ufficio e 40% ibrido | Riferimento 8209

Stai cercando di crescere la tua carriera in un ambiente dinamico e collaborativo? Stiamo cercando un Data Licensing Specialist for Finance & Process Automation per unire il nostro team di Gestione licenze dati di Londra, con responsabilità per compiti finanziari, conformità operativa e garanzia di qualità.

Potrai lavorare con una supervisione minima e gestire un carico di lavoro vario. Il ruolo consiste nel supportare clienti, fornitori di dati, vendite, acquisizione dati e il più ampio team di operazioni dei clienti, mentre si sta lavorando a stretto contatto con Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable e Controlling. Potrai gestire relazioni esterne su questioni finanziarie, risoluzione dei problemi di supporto e svolgere un ruolo attivo nel miglioramento dei processi, iniziative di automazione e l'adozione di soluzioni abilitate all'intelligenza artificiale in tutte le attività operative. Il ruolo offre l'opportunità di combinare la proprietà dei processi finanziari con l'innovazione, contribuendo a migliorare l'efficienza, la scalabilità e la qualità dei servizi all'interno delle operazioni dei clienti e della gestione dei dati. L'accuratezza, l'attenzione ai dettagli, una mentalità collaborativa e un autentico interesse per il miglioramento continuo sono essenziali.

Cosa farai

• Mantenere e arricchire i dati critici di riferimento e master attraverso i servizi di informazione finanziaria, garantendo elevati livelli di accuratezza, completezza e integrità.

• Eseguire i controlli dei dati di screening e di controllo dei dati di controllo della sicurezza in linea con i requisiti di regolazione, conformità e gestione dei rischi.

• Monitorare la qualità dei dati, indagare le discrepanze e risolvere le eccezioni per supportare l'eccellenza operativa e la soddisfazione del cliente.

• Collabora con gli stakeholder interni tra i team Operations, Compliance, Product e Technology per migliorare i processi e i controlli dei dati.

• Contribuire a processi di ottimizzazione, iniziative di automazione e attività di miglioramento continuo all'interno dei servizi di Business Process Outsourcing (BPO).

Cosa porterai

• Esperienza in operazioni, gestione dei dati, outsourcing dei processi aziendali, servizi finanziari o un ambiente correlato.

• Forte attenzione ai dettagli con la capacità di analizzare, convalidare e mantenere con precisione grandi volumi di dati sensibili.

• La conoscenza delle sanzioni screening, requisiti normativi, principi KYC/AML, o infrastrutture di mercato finanziario è vantaggioso.

• Eccellente capacità di problem solving con un approccio proattivo per indagare e risolvere problemi operativi.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente collaborativo e veloce.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Anthony Mills al numero +44 207 550 5407 .

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Cosa offriamo

Spezialist für Datenlizenzierung (Finance & Process Automation)

London | 60% Bürobedarf und 40% Hybrid | Referenz 8209

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Working Student Data Analyst 60-80%

Zurich |  60-80% | Reference 8234

Are you comfortable diving into large datasets and numbers? Are you interested in learning how a stock exchange functions and in connecting with people? If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you! Our Data Analytics Exchanges team provides easy access to data insights and drives data innovation to help both our organization and our customers operate smarter and grow.

As a modern, dynamic, and innovative company, we offer a wide range of opportunities to develop your potential in the exciting world of technology and finance. We support you in your career entry, invest in your development, and the expansion of your personal skills. As a Working Student you will be part of our NextGen Community and join a network of dedicated career starters. This position is limited to 12 months, with the option of extension.

What you will do

• Supporting our cloud migration by modernizing existing Tableau reports into Power BI dashboards

• Designing and implementing new data visualization tools to communicate insights and support decision-making

• Assisting with testing and validating report and dashboard migrations on the new Azure cloud platform

What you bring

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, preferably in Computer Science or Data Science

• Initial programming experience with Python or SQL

• Hands-on experience with Power BI or Tableau

• Fast learner with a reliable, trustworthy, and detail-oriented working style

• Collaborative team player with a proactive mindset

• Fluent in English

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Janine Reichling  at +41 58 399 42 99 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Java Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - impulsa la transformación de los mercados financieros y pertenece a SIX, el tercer grupo bursátil más grande de Europa.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brillantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

Java Full Stack Developer

Madrid, Barcelona |  Working from home up to 40% | Referencia  8189

If you are interested in financial technology and would like to understand what happens in financial systems after trading activity in regulated markets, you may be a great fit for our Post-Trade team.

We are looking for an energetic and experienced Software Engineer to help evolve a group of applications within the Asset Management and post-trade services domain. You will contribute to the evolution of systems that support the global settlement infrastructure within a corporation where you can grow your career alongside highly skilled professionals in this field.

What You Will Do

• enhance and develop applications in the Post-Trade (Asset Management) area.

• manage the application lifecycle and related infrastructure (FATE, Linux, OpenShift, and .NET).

• collaborate on technology transformation projects involving new solutions and application stacks.

• location: Barcelona or Madrid.

• availability to travel for short periods (1 to 5 days).

What You Bring

• experience developing applications using Angular, Java, and OpenShift.

• knowledge of application lifecycle tools such as JIRA, Confluence, GitLab, and Maven.

• experience working in Agile development teams (Scrum and Kanban).

• Nice to have knowledge of .NET and Microsoft SQL Server development stacks.

• knowledge of financial technology within the Spanish financial sector is considered a plus.

• experience in technology transformation processes within financial environments is considered a plus.

• 5 years of experience developing similar applications.

• languages: Spanish and English (minimum B2 level).

Si tienes alguna duda, consulta nuestra página de preguntas frecuentes (FAQ) o contacta con Yuliya Stoyko   +34 917095993 .

Para esta vacante sólo aceptamos solicitudes directas.

La diversidad es importante para nosotros. Por lo tanto, estamos deseando recibir solicitudes independientemente de cualquier contexto personal.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brilliantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

Software Engineer

Madrid, Barcelona | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referencia 8189

Wenn Sie sich für Finanztechnologie interessieren und verstehen möchten, was in Finanzsystemen nach Handelsaktivitäten in regulierten Märkten passiert, passen Sie möglicherweise hervorragend zu unserem Post-Trade-Team.

Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem energiegeladenen und erfahrenen Software-Ingenieur, der bei der Entwicklung einer Gruppe von Anwendungen im Bereich Asset Management und Post-Trade-Services hilft. Sie werden zur Entwicklung von Systemen beitragen, die die globale Abwicklungsinfrastruktur innerhalb eines Unternehmens unterstützen, in dem Sie Ihre Karriere neben hochqualifizierten Fachleuten in diesem Bereich ausbauen können.

Was Sie tun werden

• Verbesserung und Entwicklung von Anwendungen im Bereich Post-Trade (Asset Management).

• Verwalten des Anwendungslebenszyklus und der zugehörigen Infrastruktur (FATE, Linux, OpenShift und .NET).

• Zusammenarbeit bei Technologietransformationsprojekten mit neuen Lösungen und Anwendungsstacks.

• Standort: Barcelona oder Madrid.

• Verfügbarkeit für kurze Zeiträume (1 bis 5 Tage).

Was du mitbringst

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Anwendungen mit Angular, Java und OpenShift.

• Kenntnisse über Application Lifecycle Tools wie JIRA, Confluence, GitLab und Maven.

• Erfahrung in agilen Entwicklungsteams (Scrum und Kanban).

• Kenntnisse von .NET und Microsoft SQL Server Entwicklungsstacks.

• Kenntnisse der Finanztechnologie im spanischen Finanzsektor gelten als Plus.

• Erfahrung in Technologietransformationsprozessen im finanziellen Umfeld wird als Plus angesehen.

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung ähnlicher Anwendungen.

• Sprachen: Spanisch und Englisch (Mindestniveau B2).

Si tienes alguna duda, consulta nuestra página de preguntas frecuentes (FAQ) o contacta con German Lopez Arranz +34 91 709 5771.

Para esta vacante sólo aceptamos solicitudes directas.

La diversidad es importante para nosotros. Por lo tanto, estamos deseando recibir solicitudes independientemente de cualquier contexto personal.

Ingénieur logiciel

Madrid, Barcelone

Si vous êtes intéressé par la technologie financière et que vous souhaitez comprendre ce qui se passe dans les systèmes financiers après l'activité de négociation sur les marchés réglementés, vous pouvez être un grand ajustement pour notre équipe post-commerce.

Nous recherchons un ingénieur logiciel énergique et expérimenté pour aider à développer un groupe d'applications dans le domaine de la gestion d'actifs et des services post-négociations. Vous contribuerez à l'évolution des systèmes qui soutiennent l'infrastructure de règlement global au sein d'une société où vous pourrez développer votre carrière aux côtés de professionnels hautement qualifiés dans ce domaine.

Ce que vous ferez

• améliorer et développer les applications dans le domaine de la gestion après le commerce.

• gérer le cycle de vie de l'application et l'infrastructure connexe (FATE, Linux, OpenShift et .NET).

• collaborer à des projets de transformation technologique impliquant de nouvelles solutions et des piles d'application.

• lieu: Barcelone ou Madrid.

• disponibilité pour voyager pendant de courtes périodes (1 à 5 jours).

Ce que vous apportez

• expérience de développement d'applications en utilisant Angular, Java et OpenShift.

• connaissance des outils du cycle de vie des applications comme JIRA, Confluence, GitLab et Maven.

• Expérience dans les équipes de développement Agile (Scrum et Kanban).

• connaissance des piles de développement .NET et Microsoft SQL Server.

• la connaissance des technologies financières dans le secteur financier espagnol est considérée comme un atout.

• L'expérience des processus de transformation technologique dans les milieux financiers est considérée comme un atout.

• 5 ans d'expérience en développement d'applications similaires.

• langues: espagnol et anglais (niveau minimum B2).

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Software Engineer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8191

Are you passionate about modern technology? Do you want to work in an agile, self-organized environment where collaboration, trust, and innovation are paramount? Then, our motivated Application Development Team wants to hear from you. Our goal is to offer technological products of high quality to our customers. You cooperate with Business and IT stakeholders and take over various tasks as Software Engineer in the area of the Spanish Tax Services.

What You Will Do

• ensure Run operations of the application. Resolution of the incident and problem management process and support the business team.

• development of the application enhancements and maintenance of the application with business and IT units. Ensure timely delivery of the deliverables.

• make sure the development and change process is in accordance with the principles and guidance from Architecture, Security & Strategy.

• continuous improvement in the areas of secure coding, application monitoring and automation. Management of technical debts and timely resolutions.

• work in close collaboration with Product Owner, IT Architects and other stakeholders.

What You Bring

• full-stack development with up-to-date skills in Java OpenJDK, Spring Boot, Angular, OpenShift, ArgoCD, GitLab, Ansible, Tomcat, WildFly.

• experience in web application development and maintenance.

• ability to analyze requirements, design test strategies, and identify edge cases before they reach production.

• high team-working ability.

• knowledge in secure coding and web security, strong problem-solving and documentation skills with a proactive approach to improving software quality.

• good verbal and written English and Spanish.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari e appartiene a SIX, il terzo più grande gruppo di scambi in Europa.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Ingegnere di software

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8191

Sei appassionato di tecnologia moderna? Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente agile e auto-organizzato dove la collaborazione, la fiducia e l'innovazione sono fondamentali? Poi, il nostro team di sviluppo applicazioni motivato vuole sentire da voi. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di offrire prodotti tecnologici di alta qualità ai nostri clienti. Collaborate con gli stakeholder di Business e IT e assumete diversi compiti come Software Engineer nell'area dei Servizi fiscali spagnoli.

Cosa farai

• garantire le operazioni di esecuzione dell'applicazione. Risoluzione del processo di gestione degli incidenti e dei problemi e supporto al team aziendale.

• sviluppo dell'applicazione miglioramenti e manutenzione dell'applicazione con business e unità IT. Assicurare la consegna tempestiva dei consegnabili.

• assicurarsi che il processo di sviluppo e cambiamento sia conforme ai principi e alla guida di Architettura, Sicurezza e Strategia.

• miglioramento continuo delle aree di codifica sicura, monitoraggio delle applicazioni e automazione. Gestione dei debiti tecnici e risoluzioni tempestive.

• lavorare in stretta collaborazione con Product Owner, IT Architects e altri stakeholder.

Che cosa porta

• sviluppo completo con competenze aggiornate in Java OpenJDK, Spring Boot, Angular, OpenShift, ArgoCD, GitLab, Ansible, Tomcat, WildFly.

• esperienza nello sviluppo e nella manutenzione delle applicazioni web.

• capacità di analizzare i requisiti, progettare le strategie di test e identificare i casi di bordo prima di raggiungere la produzione.

• alta capacità di lavoro di squadra.

• conoscenze in sicurezza di codifica e sicurezza web, forti capacità di problem solving e documentazione con un approccio proattivo per migliorare la qualità del software.

• buono verbale e scritto inglese e spagnolo.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Tedesco Lopez Arranz al +34 91 709 5771 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

descriptionByLocale.de:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran und gehört zu SIX, der drittgrößten Börsengruppe in Europa.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Software Engineer

Madrid | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 8191

Sie interessieren sich für moderne Technologie? Möchten Sie in einem agilen, selbstorganisierten Umfeld arbeiten, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Vertrauen und Innovation an erster Stelle stehen? Dann möchte unser motiviertes Anwendungsentwicklungsteam von Ihnen hören. Unser Ziel ist es, unseren Kunden technologische Produkte von hoher Qualität anzubieten. Sie kooperieren mit Business- und IT-Stakeholdern und übernehmen verschiedene Aufgaben als Software Engineer im Bereich der spanischen Steuerdienstleistungen.

Was Sie tun werden

• sicherstellen, dass der Betrieb der Anwendung ausgeführt wird. Lösung des Incident- und Problemmanagement-Prozesses und Unterstützung des Business-Teams.

• Entwicklung der Anwendungserweiterungen und Wartung der Anwendung mit Geschäfts- und IT-Einheiten. Gewährleistung einer rechtzeitigen Lieferung der zu erbringenden Leistungen.

• sicherstellen, dass der Entwicklungs- und Veränderungsprozess in Übereinstimmung mit den Prinzipien und Leitlinien von Architecture, Security & Strategy steht.

• kontinuierliche Verbesserung in den Bereichen sichere Codierung, Anwendungsüberwachung und Automatisierung. Management von technischen Schulden und rechtzeitige Abwicklungen.

• arbeiten eng mit Product Owner, IT Architects und anderen Stakeholdern zusammen.

Was du mitbringst

• Full-Stack-Entwicklung mit aktuellen Fähigkeiten in Java OpenJDK, Spring Boot, Angular, OpenShift, ArgoCD, GitLab, Ansible, Tomcat, WildFly.

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Wartung von Webanwendungen.

• Fähigkeit, Anforderungen zu analysieren, Teststrategien zu entwerfen und Edge Cases zu identifizieren, bevor sie die Produktion erreichen.

• hohe Teamarbeitsfähigkeit.

• Kenntnisse in sicherer Codierung und Web-Sicherheit, starke Problemlösung und Dokumentation Fähigkeiten mit einem proaktiven Ansatz zur Verbesserung der Software-Qualität.

• gutes mündliches und schriftliches Englisch und Spanisch.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie German Lopez Arranz unter +34 91 709 5771 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - conduit la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième groupe de change en Europe.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Ingénieur logiciel

Madrid: travailler à partir de la maison jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8191

Êtes-vous passionné par la technologie moderne? Voulez-vous travailler dans un environnement agile et auto-organisé où la collaboration, la confiance et l'innovation sont primordiales? Ensuite, notre équipe de développement d'applications motivée veut vous entendre. Notre objectif est d'offrir des produits technologiques de haute qualité à nos clients. Vous coopérez avec les acteurs des affaires et de l'informatique et prenez en charge diverses tâches en tant qu'ingénieur logiciel dans le domaine des services fiscaux espagnols.

Ce que vous ferez

• assurer le fonctionnement de l'application. Règlement de l'incident et du processus de gestion des problèmes et soutien de l'équipe d'affaires.

• développement des améliorations de l'application et maintenance de l'application avec les unités d'affaires et de TI. Assurer la livraison en temps opportun des produits livrables.

• s'assurer que le processus de développement et de changement est conforme aux principes et directives de l'architecture, de la sécurité et de la stratégie.

• amélioration continue dans les domaines du codage sécurisé, du suivi des applications et de l'automatisation. Gestion des dettes techniques et résolutions en temps voulu.

• travailler en étroite collaboration avec le propriétaire du produit, les architectes informatiques et d'autres intervenants.

Ce que vous apportez

• développement complet avec des compétences à jour dans Java OpenJDK, Spring Boot, Angular, OpenShift, ArgoCD, GitLab, Ansible, Tomcat, WildFly.

• expérience dans le développement et la maintenance d'applications web.

• capacité d'analyser les besoins, de concevoir des stratégies d'essai et d'identifier les cas de bordure avant qu'ils n'atteignent la production.

• haute capacité de travail en équipe.

• les connaissances en matière de codage sécurisé et de sécurité du Web, les compétences solides en résolution de problèmes et de documentation avec une approche proactive pour améliorer la qualité des logiciels.

• bon verbal et écrit anglais et espagnol.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez l'Allemand Lopez Arranz au +34 91 709 5771 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Information Security Officer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8228

Are you passionate about cyber security and information technology? Are you valuing the power of teamwork and global collaboration with business and IT stakeholders? Then our international team of Information Security Officers is excited to hear from you! As part of Corporate Security and SIX’s 2nd line of defense, we help to balance information security risks and make sure SIX’s security posture is leading in class.

Does it sound interesting for you? Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• advise and support our local and international projects to make sure IT security requirements are properly defined and implemented

• orchestrate penetration tests with business and IT stakeholders and top security experts

• expand your technical expertise to conduct deep dives in form of structured security assessments

• improve our overall process maturity with your ideas and based on your experience

• grow personally and technically through constant exchange with your colleagues from Switzerland, Spain and Germany

What You Bring

• experience in information/cyber security

• good knowledge of technical IT (networks, operating systems, application architectures, cloud services, development standards, artificial intelligence services)

• good organizational skills and ability to explain complex things in a simple way

• comfortable and capable of handling business and IT personnel on an adequate level

• interest in financial infrastructure provided for financial services and markets

• advanced training or certification in information security (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC) is a plus

• fluent in English and Spanish (both verbal and writing), German is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Data Transformation Specialist
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Data Transformation Specialist

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8175

We are looking for a Data Transformation Specialist to drive process transformation and automation initiatives within Financial Information Data Operations. This role combines deep business knowledge of financial instrument data with strong technical capabilities to identify inefficiencies, redesign processes, and implement scalable automation solutions.

The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders across Switzerland, Spain, the UK, and Poland, contributing directly to strategic transformation objectives and operational excellence initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining technology, data, and business process improvement to deliver measurable business impact.

jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Specialist Post-Trade Education & Client Testing (80 - 100%)

Olten |  bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Referenz 8082

Möchtest du in einem dynamischen Team im Bereich Post-Trade Education & Client Testing arbeiten? Bist du eine kommunikative Persönlichkeit, welche über ein ausgeprägtes Kundenverständnis verfügt und auch in hektischen Zeiten einen kühlen Kopf behält? Verfügst du über gute Kenntnisse der Börsen- und Wertschriftenwelt? Dann bewirb dich und werde Teil unseres Post-Trade Education & Client Testing Team.

Als Specialist Post-Trade Education & Client Testing unterstützt du unser Team in der Erstellung von E-Learning Kursen sowie bei der Planung und Durchführung von Präsenzkursen. Die Online- und Präsenzkurse richten sich an unsere Kunden und Mitarbeitende und vermitteln Wissen zu mehreren Bereichen der Wertschriftenwelt und zu diversen SIX Applikationen.

Im Client Testing verantwortest du die zentrale Koordination zwischen internen Stakeholdern und unseren Kunden und stellst eine abgestimmte Umsetzung der Testszenarien sicher. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit deinen Teamkollegen gewährleistest du, dass die Anliegen neuer und bestehender Kunden hinsichtlich Testing-Aktivitäten erfasst und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Die Training sowie Client Testing Aktivitäten umfassen diverse Fachbereiche von SIX wie z.B. Settlement, Corporate Action, Tax, Fonds, Clearing u.a.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Erstellung und Durchführung von Ausbildungsinhalten für Mitarbeitende und Kunden (E-Learning und Präsenzkurse) in verschiedenen Post-Trade-Fachbereichen wie Settlement, Corporate Actions, Tax etc. in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern.

• Durchführung von qualitativ hochstehenden und kundenorientierten Demo Sessions oder Präsentationen von Applikationen und Services, online oder an SIX Standorten, ggf. auch bei Kunden vor Ort

• Interne Schnittstelle für Client Testing Anfragen sowie zentrale Anlaufstelle zur Koordination und Ausführung von reibungslosen Client Testing Aktivitäten mit neuen sowie bestehenden Kunden

• Erstellen und Aktualisieren von Test Scripts für verschiedene Business Fachbereiche wie Corporate Action, Settlement, Clearing u.a.

• Regelmässiger Kundenkontakt, telefonisch wie schriftlich auf Deutsch und Englisch

Das bringst du mit

• Zwingende, mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Wertschriftenabwicklung und im Post-Trading Bereich, idealerweise Custody & Clearing (Settlement, Corporate Action, Clearing etc.), SWIFT Kenntnisse ebenfalls von Vorteil

• Aufgeschlossene und wortgewandte Persönlichkeit, welche gerne ihr Wissen vermittelt und sicher vor Publikum auftreten kann

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Kunden sowie ein ausgeprägtes Kundenflair

• Belastbare und teamfähige Persönlichkeit die sich nicht scheut auch eigene Ideen einzubringen

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englisch Kenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. Level B2), Französisch und Italienisch sowie jede weitere Sprache ist von Vorteil

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska  unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

• Molto buone competenze in tedesco e inglese in parola e scrittura (livello minimo B2), francese e italiano e qualsiasi altra lingua è un vantaggio Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49. In this role, you will own and further develop our business Marketing Automation strategy in Marketo, with a strong focus on generating Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) and supporting sales opportunity creation. You will define and optimize lifecycle communications across email and other relevant channels.

You will act as the strategic driver behind targeting, segmentation, personalization, lifecycle design, attribution, and performance measurement. In doing so, you will define business requirements and work closely with IT, Data teams, and the Marketo Application Manager.

With your deep expertise in Marketing Automation, you will also steer and mentor a Junior Marketing Automation Manager.

We invest in the development of our experts and support you in continuously expanding your skills, both strategically and technically.

As a modern, innovative company at the intersection of technology and finance, SIX offers a wide range of opportunities to make a meaningful impact and fully leverage your potential.
We look forward to receiving your application in English.

What You Will Do

• Define and own the end-to-end business Marketing Automation strategy in Marketo, translating business objectives into clear automation use cases, roadmaps and success metrics, while aligning with platform capabilities.

• Define and optimize B2B email marketing and omnichannel engagement strategies, ensuring that nurturing, lifecycle communications, and automated journeys are relevant and aligned with business objectives across the customer journey.

• Design, implement, and optimize marketing automation frameworks (lead scoring, lead qualification, nurturing) and continuously improve targeting, segmentation, and personalization to drive Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs).

• Define and manage attribution models in Marketo, and contribute to holistic performance reporting by connecting Marketo data with Google Data Studio dashboards.

• Act as strategic owner and senior stakeholder interface for Marketing Automation, leading governance across internal teams (Compliance, Marketing, Sales, Tech, Data, IT) and external partners, while steering and and coaching one Junior Marketing Automation Manager.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communication, Marketing, Media, Public Relations, or a comparable field.

• 5+ years of experience in Marketing Automation, with proven ownership of enterprise‑scale Marketo setups and the ability to define and drive marketing automation strategy beyond campaign execution.

• Strong experience in B2B email marketing, lifecycle communications and omnichannel campaign orchestration, including segmentation, personalization, testing, engagement optimization and email best practices.

• Deep expert knowledge of Marketo, including architecture, lead scoring and qualification models, lifecycle management, attribution, reporting, and governance, with a strong focus on SQL and sales opportunity generation.

• Analytical and attribution skills, including defining attribution models in Marketo and connecting Marketo data to Google Data Studio dashboards.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers. Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre racines locales et pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Directeur principal de l'automatisation du marketing Varsovie: jusqu'à 40 % de travail à domicile possible Êtes-vous passionné par l'automatisation du marketing au niveau de l'entreprise et la conduite d'un impact commercial mesurable? Proliférez-vous dans un environnement international et appréciez-vous façonner la stratégie, les voyages des clients et les décisions axées sur les données? Ensuite, rejoignez notre équipe numérique internationale en tant que spécialiste principal de l'automatisation marketing. Dans ce rôle, vous posséderez et développerez davantage notre stratégie d'automatisation marketing commerciale à Marketo, en mettant fortement l'accent sur la production de leads qualifiés de vente (SQL) et en soutenant la création d'opportunités de vente. Vous définirez et optimiserez les communications du cycle de vie par courriel et par d'autres canaux pertinents. Vous agirez comme le moteur stratégique derrière le ciblage, la segmentation, la personnalisation, la conception du cycle de vie, l'attribution et la mesure du rendement. Ce faisant, vous définirez les exigences opérationnelles et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes IT, Data et Marketo Application Manager. Avec votre expertise approfondie en Marketing Automation, vous dirigerez et encadrerez également un Junior Marketing Automation Manager. Nous investissons dans le développement de nos experts et vous accompagnons dans l'expansion continue de vos compétences, à la fois stratégiquement et techniquement. En tant qu'entreprise moderne et innovante à l'intersection de la technologie et de la finance, SIX offre un large éventail d'opportunités pour faire un impact significatif et exploiter pleinement votre potentiel. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature en anglais. Ce que vous ferez
• Définir et posséder la stratégie d'automatisation marketing de bout en bout dans Marketo, transformant les objectifs commerciaux en cas d'utilisation d'automatisation claire, feuilles de route et indicateurs de succès, tout en s'harmonisant avec les capacités de la plateforme.
• Définir et optimiser les stratégies de marketing par courriel et d'engagement omnicanal B2B, en veillant à ce que l'éducation, les communications sur le cycle de vie et les trajets automatisés soient pertinents et alignés sur les objectifs opérationnels de tout le parcours client.
• Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et optimiser les cadres d'automatisation du marketing (score de leader, qualification de leader, éducation) et améliorer continuellement le ciblage, la segmentation et la personnalisation pour conduire des Leads qualifiés de vente (LQS).
• Définir et gérer des modèles d'attribution dans Marketo, et contribuer à des rapports de performance holistiques en connectant les données de Marketo avec les tableaux de bord Google Data Studio.
• Agir en tant que propriétaire stratégique et interface senior des intervenants pour l'automatisation marketing, dirigeant la gouvernance à travers les équipes internes (Compliance, Marketing, Ventes, Tech, Data, IT) et des partenaires externes, tout en dirigeant et coachant un gestionnaire d'automatisation marketing junior. Ce que vous apportez
• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en communication, marketing, médias, relations publiques, ou un domaine comparable.
• 5+ ans d'expérience en Marketing Automation, avec la propriété éprouvée des configurations Marketo à l'échelle de l'entreprise et la capacité de définir et de piloter la stratégie d'automatisation marketing au-delà de l'exécution de campagne.
• Forte expérience dans le marketing par courriel B2B, les communications du cycle de vie et l'orchestration de campagne omnicanale, y compris la segmentation, la personnalisation, les tests, l'optimisation de l'engagement et les meilleures pratiques de courriel.
• Une connaissance approfondie de Marketo, y compris l'architecture, les modèles de notation et de qualification, la gestion du cycle de vie, l'attribution, l'établissement de rapports et la gouvernance, avec un accent fort sur SQL et la génération d'opportunités de vente.
• Compétences d'analyse et d'attribution, y compris la définition de modèles d'attribution dans Marketo et la connexion des données de Marketo aux tableaux de bord Google Data Studio. Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa au +48 538 562 645 Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel. Style "div dir"auto"

Warsaw, Madrid |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7548

We’re looking for an AI Solutions Lead - Development Tools (Claude Code) to join our Software Engineering Practice Team.  Your mission: shape how AI transforms the way software gets built at SIX from idea to production code powering the financial markets in Europe and beyond. In this role you define the vision and strategy, design the architecture, evaluate suitable solutions and drive their adoption. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and developer tooling, the internal development platforms and organizational change - putting agentic AI into the hands of product owners, business analysts, architects, testers and developers across the company.

• Own the AI roadmap for the Software Development Lifecycle — from requirements and design through development and deployment

• Continuously evaluate, benchmark and assess the latest AI tools and platforms

• Prototype and integrate AI-powered workflows when off-the-shelf solutions don't fit, using modern agent frameworks

• Drive enterprise-wide adoption of AI-enabled solutions by designing rollout strategies, running pilots and workshops and tracking measurable adoption outcomes

• as a first project engineer and rollout Claude Code for the Developers

What You Bring

• passion for AI and re-imagining software development

• 5+ years in software engineering and demonstrated experience in Claude Code

• strong understanding of the end-to-end Software Development Lifecycle

• hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI Agents

• ability to drive adoption of new tools and practices across engineering teams, not just make them available

• strong communication and presentation skills, fluent in English

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Technical Account Manager

Frankfurt |  bis zu 40% Home Office | Reference 7979

Are you passionate about bridging the gap between technology and customer success? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your technical and data expertise and client-facing skills make a real impact? Then we want to hear from you! We are a collaborative sales-driven team responsible for delivering tailored data services to key clients in Germany, Austria and Eastern Europe. In this role, you will work closely with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.

What You Will Do

• Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for strategic and major clients for all technical coordination and 2nd level support, issue resolution, and rollout of development requests

• Support clients in enhancing existing services

• Trusted consultant and advisor for customers and be the go-to-person for all financial data content questions

• Coordinate and track usage metrics, development requests, and ensure timely communication between internal teams and clients

• Coordinate sub-contractors/partners

• Support upgrades and migrations

What You Bring

• Technical background with solid understanding of IT systems, data structures, interfaces and/or integration processes, ideally within banking or investment platforms

• Min. 3 years’ experience in technical account management or technical project management, preferably in the financial services industry

• Excellent customer orientation and communication skills with the ability to translate technical topics into business language and comprehensive understanding of the German financial market

• Strong organizational / project management skills with experience working in agile development environments is a plus

• Collaborative team player with a commercial mindset and an ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Fluent in German (C2) and English (C1)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Cloud Data Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Cloud Data Engineer

Madrid, Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7590

SIX is recruiting a data platform engineer to work on the company wide data platform. In this role, you will be part of a cross-functional team responsible for both designing and implementing a reliable platform for analytics and data science, as well as consulting internal customers who use the platform across the organization.

What You Will Do

• Be part of an international team that designs and maintains a mature cloud native data science platform, currently serving more than 14 internal analytics teams and 600+ users.

• Closely collaborate with key stakeholders from business data science teams and IT data engineering teams to enable them on the platform. Identify new requirements, analyze platform suitability, propose best practices and existing solutions through demos...

• Act as a hands-on data engineer to onboard new use cases and optimize existing ones, build production ready ETL pipelines, ML/AI use cases and reporting solutions.

• Implement new infrastructure components with Infrastructure as code (IaC), as well as creating templates to ensure best practices and standardization among analytics teams.

What You Bring

• 4+ years of practical experience building production data pipelines, data modeling and BI tools in the cloud.

• Experience with Lakehouse architecture, preferably Databricks, with a strong knowledge of Spark and Open Table formats (Delta and/or Iceberg).

• Proficiency with Python (PySpark) and SQL with a solid understanding of software development and automation concepts like CI/CD to build production data and ML pipelines (DataOps/MLOps).

• Basic knowledge of cloud foundation services (IAM, networking, storage...), cloud costs management (FinOps) as well as tools to manage cloud infrastructure with IaC (Terraform/OpenTofu, Pulumi, bash scripting...) on Microsoft Azure (our primary cloud service provider) and/or Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform.

• Growth mindset and a very proactive attitude for continuous learning and development.

• Good presentation and communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken English.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Specialist Static Data Operations (80-100%)
jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Specialist Static Data Operations (80-100%)

Zurich |  40% Home Office möglich | Referenz 8057

Als Specialist Static Data Operations bist Du in spannenden Bereichen im Herzen des Börsenbetriebes tätig. Du stellst die Qualität der Stamm- und Handelsdaten der Handelsplattform sicher.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine zuverlässige Persönlichkeit, die sich mit Freude in unserem dynamischen und internationalen Umfeld einbringen möchte.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Sicherstellung der Qualität und Erfassen der Markt- und Handels-Stammdaten

• Bearbeiten von einfachen bis sehr komplexen Kundenanfragen und Mitarbeit bei der Weiter- oder Neuentwicklung von Kundenlösungen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management, Change Management sowie SIX Exchange Regulation bei diversen Projekten

• Durchführung von Business Acceptance Tests in Projekten und Börsen Releases

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene Berufslehre und/oder Hochschulabschluss vorzugsweise in Wirtschaft oder Wirtschaftsinformatik

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im operativen Bereich und/oder bei Betreuung von Kunden in der Finanzbranche

• Gute Kenntnisse im Börsenumfeld, insbesondere Kenntnisse von Finanzprodukten über die gesamte Lebensdauer

• Verständnis für technische Zusammenhänge und Datenmodellierung von Vorteil sowie ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen

• Engagierte, selbständige sowie lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit exakter und präziser Arbeitsweise

• Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Julia Schmidt unter der Nummer +41 583 994 236.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX sta guidando la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci rende diversi ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti intelligenti e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro dei mercati finanziari con noi.

Operazioni dati statiche specializzate (80-100%)

Zurigo | 40% Home Office possibile | Riferimento 8057

Come operazioni dati statiche specialistiche, si lavora in aree emozionanti nel cuore delle operazioni di mercato azionario. Assicura la qualità dei dati master e trading della piattaforma di trading.
Per rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando una personalità affidabile che voglia contribuire con piacere nel nostro ambiente dinamico e internazionale.

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Assicurare la qualità e la cattura dei dati di mercato e di riferimento commerciale

• Elaborazione di richieste di clienti semplici e complesse e cooperazione nell'ulteriore o nuovo sviluppo delle soluzioni dei clienti

• Una stretta collaborazione con la gestione dei prodotti, la gestione dei cambiamenti e il regolamento SIX Exchange sui vari progetti

• Condurre i test di accettazione aziendale in progetti e versioni di scambio

Lo porti con te.

• Apprendistato professionale completo e/o diploma universitario preferibilmente in informatica aziendale o aziendale

• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale nel settore operativo e/o nel supporto dei clienti nel settore finanziario

• Buona conoscenza dell'ambiente del mercato azionario, in particolare la conoscenza dei prodotti finanziari per tutta la vita

• Comprendere le relazioni tecniche e la modellazione dei dati e il forte pensiero analitico

• Personalità indipendente e orientata alla soluzione con metodi di lavoro precisi e precisi

• Molto buona conoscenza orale e scritta di tedesco e inglese

Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Julia Schmidt al numero +41 583 994 236.

Per questa vacanza, consideriamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi accogliamo le applicazioni indipendentemente dal background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What makes us different drives us forward: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique mixture of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of financial markets with us.

Specialist Static Data Operations (80-100%)

Zurich | 40% Home Office possible | Reference 8057

As a Specialist Static Data Operations, you work in exciting areas at the heart of stock market operations. You ensure the quality of the master and trading data of the trading platform.
To strengthen our team, we are looking for a reliable personality who would like to contribute with pleasure in our dynamic and international environment.

These are your tasks

• Ensure quality and capture of market and trade reference data

• Processing of simple to very complex customer inquiries and cooperation in the further or new development of customer solutions

• Close cooperation with Product Management, Change Management and SIX Exchange Regulation on various projects

• Conducting Business Acceptance Tests in Projects and Exchange Releases

You bring that with you

• Completed vocational apprenticeship and/or university degree preferably in business or business informatics

• At least 5 years of professional experience in the operational field and/or in supporting clients in the financial sector

• Good knowledge of the stock market environment, in particular knowledge of financial products over the entire lifetime

• Understanding technical relationships and data modeling as well as strong analytical thinking

• Engaged, independent and solution-oriented personality with exact and precise working methods

• Very good oral and written knowledge of German and English

If you have any questions, visit our FAQ page or contact Julia Schmidt on +41 583 994 236.

For this vacancy, we only consider direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we welcome applications regardless of personal background.

Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Specialist Static Data Operations (80-100%)

Zurich | 40% Home Office möglich | Referenz 8057

Als Specialist Static Data Operations bist Du in spannenden Bereichen im Herzen des Börsenbetriebes tätig. Du stellst die Qualität der Stamm- und Handelsdaten der Handelsplattform sicher.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine zuverlässige Persönlichkeit, die sich mit Freude in unserem dynamischen und internationalen Umfeld einbringen möchte.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Sicherstellung der Qualität und Erfassen der Markt- und Handels-Stammdaten

• Bearbeiten von einfachen bis sehr komplexen Kundenanfragen und Mitarbeit bei der Weiter- oder Neuentwicklung von Kundenlösungen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management, Change Management sowie SIX Exchange Regulation bei diversen Projekten

• Durchführung von Business Acceptance Tests in Projekten und Börsen Releases

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene Berufslehre und/oder Hochschulabschluss vorzugsweise in Wirtschaft oder Wirtschaftsinformatik

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im operativen Bereich und/oder bei Betreuung von Kunden in der Finanzbranche

• Gute Kenntnisse im Börsenumfeld, insbesondere Kenntnisse von Finanzprodukten über die gesamte Lebensdauer

• Verständnis für technische Zusammenhänge und Datenmodellierung von Vorteil sowie ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen

• Engagierte, selbständige sowie lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit exakter und präziser Arbeitsweise

• Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Julia Schmidt unter der Nummer +41 583 994 236.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

Zurich 40% Home Office possible

Pour renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons une personnalité fiable qui aimerait contribuer avec plaisir dans notre environnement dynamique et international.

jobs.title: Business Information Security Officer

titleByLocale.fr: Agent de la sécurité de l'information commerciale

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Information Security Officer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7942

Information security is a key requirement for the successful and compliant operation of Securities Services. As a Business Information Security Officer (BISO), you act as the main point of contact for information security topics within Securities Services, supporting the appropriate handling of security risks, regulatory obligations, and internal security requirements in line with SIX standards.
In this role, you work closely with business, IT, and security stakeholders to ensure that information security requirements are well understood and applied in a pragmatic and business‑oriented manner. You support initiatives and day‑to‑day activities by providing guidance, facilitating alignment between parties, and contributing to a consistent security approach across the organization.
You will collaborate with central security teams, IT, legal, risk, and compliance functions, and be part of the wider BISO community within SIX.

We are looking forward to hear for you. Please apply with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Act as a key contact and advisor for information security topics within the assigned business area, supporting managers and key stakeholders

• Advise and support projects, applications, and initiatives in implementing information security requirements in line with SIX standards and best practices

• Contribute to the identification, assessment, and handling of information security risks affecting the business area

• Facilitate effective collaboration between business, IT, and security functions to ensure pragmatic and proportionate security solutions

• Support the interpretation and application of regulatory, contractual, and internal security requirements (e.g. data protection, industry standards)

• Contribute to security awareness, reporting, and continuous improvement activities, and actively participate in the SIX BISO community

What You Bring

• 4 years of professional experience in information security, IT risk, IT, or a related field. Relevant training or certification in information security will be a plus

• Good understanding of information security principles, risk management, and control concepts with ability to understand technical security topics and communicate them clearly to non‑technical stakeholders

• Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to financial services is an advantage

• Structured and solution‑oriented working style, with attention to detail

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a pragmatic and service‑oriented mindset and ability to manage multiple topics in parallel and work effectively with a range of stakeholders

• Fluency in English and Spanish (both written and spoken)  German is an advantage but not mandatory

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Analyst

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7801

At BME Exchange, we are looking for an experienced, customer-orientated business analyst to work on the business rollout of projects and enhancements to the SIX Swiss Exchange and BME Exchange. Are you a flexible team player, passionate about implementing initiatives in an Agile framework environment? Are you motivated to learn about the regulatory framework governing financial market infrastructure and securities trading and analyse how these are affected by new initiatives?

This is your chance to experience the stock exchange from the inside, in a unique, fast paced, and inspiring environment. In this role you will participate in the creation of the common Spanish and Swiss trading platform, contributing to its functional development and market innovation.

Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English!

What You Will Do

• Coordinate and ensure changes are rolled out to clients seamlessly

• Write business documents, including interface specifications, and communications to support clients integrating changes into their internal systems

• Coordinate and perform acceptance tests for the Spanish Market and Exchanges platform (SMART), SIX Swiss Exchange and the future common Spanish and Swiss trading platform Equinox

• Analyze and assess business initiatives in Equity, Fixed Interest and Derivatives Trading

• Research for the impact of these changes on SSX and BME Regulatory documents and work with internal teams to ensure Regulators are informed of and approve changes in a timely manner

What You Bring

• Minimum 5 years’ experience as a Business Analyst in financial services

• Ambition to work independently and take responsibility in a small team

• Good communication skills as well as systematic and accurate working methods

• Strong analytical and conceptual reasoning and the ability to impart knowledge

• Very good verbal and written skills in Spanish and English. German is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Security Platforms Engineer
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Security Platforms Engineer

Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7629

Do you enjoy building and operating resilient, automated platforms that sit at the heart of security operations? Are you comfortable owning production systems, improving them through code, and thinking in terms of reliability, failure modes, and scale?

We are looking for a Senior Security Platforms Engineer to strengthen our Cyber Security Engineering team. The role focuses on engineering, automation, and reliability of critical security data platforms, while supporting a broad set of domains such as security logging, detection pipelines, and platform integrations. The role focuses on engineering and automation over manual operations.

Our platforms process and transport security and operational relevant data at scale across multiple regions. This role combines hands‑on platform ownership with SRE principles , strong automation, and close collaboration with security engineering and operations teams.

The role is intended as senior , but we are open to strong mid‑level candidates who demonstrate the right mindset, technical depth, and growth potential.

What You Will Do

• Own and improve security‑critical platforms that ingest, process, and store large‑scale data (e.g. Elastic‑based platforms, messaging pipelines), ensuring reliability, scalability, and integrity of security‑relevant data.

• Drive reliability improvements using SRE principles , reducing operational toil and systematically addressing failure modes, data loss scenarios, and resilience under stress.

jobs.title: Senior Web Access Management Engineer 80-100%
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Web Access Management Engineer 80-100%

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8237

Are you passionate about secure web access, identity, and modern authentication technologies? Then our Web Access Management team wants to hear from you. We are a collaborative and security-focused team responsible for protecting access to business-critical web applications and APIs. Our goal is to provide stable, secure, and continuously improving access services across reverse proxy, web application firewall, and customer identity platforms. In this role, you will work closely with application teams, security architects, platform engineers, and service owners to design, operate, and enhance secure access patterns in a regulated environment.

What You Will Do

• Operate and enhance Web Access Management services, including reverse proxy, access gateway, web application firewall, and customer identity components.

• Design, build, and troubleshoot secure authentication and single sign-on flows based on OpenID Connect, OAuth2, and SAML 2.0.

• Configure routing, TLS certificates, access policies, authorization mappings, and upstream integrations for web applications and APIs.

• Tune and maintain web application firewall policies, including OWASP Core Rule Set handling, exceptions, anomaly scoring, and change control.

• Contribute to operational stability, automation, monitoring, incident response, upgrades, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous service improvement.

What You Bring

• Strong hands-on knowledge of reverse proxy or access gateway platforms, including TLS handling, routing, header and cookie management, session handling, and high-availability operations.

• Practical experience with web application firewall technologies, ModSecurity, OWASP Core Rule Set, rule tuning, false-positive handling, and secure publishing patterns.

• Solid understanding of customer identity and access management, identity lifecycle, multi-factor authentication, secure account recovery, token validation, and authorization models.

• Good knowledge of federation and access protocols such as OpenID Connect, OAuth2, SAML 2.0, JWT, PKCE, scopes, claims, certificates, metadata, and key rotation.

• Analytical, security-minded, and collaborative working style, with good communication skills; fluent English is required, German is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41 583 994 236 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
