IT Workplace Support Specialist

Zurich |  100% | Reference 7977

About the role

For our Workplace IT team, we are looking for a hands-on Level 2 Onsite Supporter who ensures stable, reliable, and user centric IT services at our Zurich site.

You act as a key contact point for our employees on site, handle complex support cases, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of our workplace environment in close collaboration with central IT teams and external partners.

What You Will Do

• provide onsite 2nd level support (and backup for 1st level when required) for Windows 11 clients and standard workplace services

• handle incidents and service requests via ITSM, including IMACD activities and escalation coordination

• install, replace, and troubleshoot end user devices (laptops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals)

• support Microsoft 365, Active Directory / Azure AD user and access management

• operate and support printers, meeting rooms, and collaboration technology (Teams Rooms, video conferencing)

• support Endpoint Management (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) for device enrollment, compliance checks, and software assignments

• contribute to workplace standardization and lifecycle management (devices, accessories, meeting rooms)

• support rollouts, pilots, and refresh cycles in cooperation with central engineering teams

• ensure accurate documentation of solutions, processes, and how tos

• work closely with 3rd level engineering, service providers, and internal stakeholders

• support smaller workplace IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives

• act as a reliable onsite counterpart for central initiatives and standards

What You Bring

• 2–4+ years of experience in onsite IT support or IT service desk (Level 1/2) in enterprise environments

• strong hands-on skills in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• practical experience with hardware support and structured rollouts

• solid understanding of Active Directory / Azure AD and basic Intune tasks

• basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN fundamentals) for onsite troubleshooting

• experience working with ticketing and asset processes, SLA oriented mindset

• high service orientation, reliability, structured working style, and clear communication

• German fluent (spoken and written); good English for documentation and support interaction

• ITIL Foundation or comparable certification

• experience in large enterprise environments

• know how around Microsoft Teams Rooms and meeting room technology

• English certification (e.g. Cambridge B2 / C1)

Zurigo | 100% | Riferimento 7977

• contribuire alla standardizzazione del posto di lavoro e alla gestione del ciclo di vita (dispositivi, accessori, sale riunioni)

• supporto rollout, piloti e cicli di aggiornamento in collaborazione con i team di ingegneria centrale

• garantire la documentazione accurata di soluzioni, processi e come

• esperienza pratica con supporto hardware e rollout strutturati

• comprensione solida di Active Directory / Azure AD e compiti base Intune

• conoscenze di rete di base (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN fondamentalis) per la risoluzione dei problemi in loco

• esperienza di lavoro con i processi di ticketing e asset, mentalità orientata SLA

• alto orientamento del servizio, affidabilità, stile di lavoro strutturato e comunicazione chiara

• fluente tedesco (spoken e scritto); buon inglese per la documentazione e l'interazione di supporto

• ITIL Foundation o certificazione comparabile

• esperienza in ambienti di grande impresa

• know how around Microsoft Teams Rooms and meeting room technology

• Certificazione inglese (ad esempio Cambridge B2 / C1)

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT Workplace Support Specialist

Zurich | 100% | Reference 7977

About the role

For our Workplace IT team, we are looking for a hands-on Level 2 Onsite Supporter who ensures stable, reliable, and user centric IT services at our Zurich site.

You act as a key contact point for our employees on site, handle complex support cases, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of our workplace environment in close collaboration with central IT teams and external partners.

What You Will Do

• provide onsite 2nd level support (and backup for 1st level when required) for Windows 11 clients and standard workplace services

• handle incidents and service requests via ITSM, including IMACD activities and escalation coordination

• install, replace, and troubleshoot end user devices (laptops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals)

• support Microsoft 365, Active Directory / Azure AD user and access management

• operate and support printers, meeting rooms, and collaboration technology (Teams Rooms, video conferencing)

• support Endpoint Management (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) for device enrollment, compliance checks, and software assignments

• contribute to workplace standardization and lifecycle management (devices, accessories, meeting rooms)

• support rollouts, pilots, and refresh cycles in cooperation with central engineering teams

• ensure accurate documentation of solutions, processes, and how tos

• work closely with 3rd level engineering, service providers, and internal stakeholders

• support smaller workplace IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives

• act as a reliable onsite counterpart for central initiatives and standards

What You Bring

• 2–4+ years of experience in onsite IT support or IT service desk (Level 1/2) in enterprise environments

• strong hands-on skills in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• practical experience with hardware support and structured rollouts

• solid understanding of Active Directory / Azure AD and basic Intune tasks

• basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN fundamentals) for onsite troubleshooting

• experience working with ticketing and asset processes, SLA oriented mindset

• high service orientation, reliability, structured working style, and clear communication

• German fluent (spoken and written); good English for documentation and support interaction

• ITIL Foundation or comparable certification

• experience in large enterprise environments

• know how around Microsoft Teams Rooms and meeting room technology

• English certification (e.g. Cambridge B2 / C1)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

IT Workplace Support Spezialist

Zürich | 100% | Referenz 7977

• Bedienung und Unterstützung von Druckern, Besprechungsräumen und Collaboration-Technologie (Teams Rooms, Videokonferenzen)

• Unterstützung von Endpoint Management (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) für Geräteregistrierung, Compliance-Prüfungen und Softwarezuweisungen

• Beitrag zur Arbeitsplatzstandardisierung und zum Lifecycle Management (Geräte, Zubehör, Besprechungsräume)

• Unterstützung von Rollouts, Piloten und Aktualisierungszyklen in Zusammenarbeit mit zentralen Engineering-Teams

• Gewährleistung einer genauen Dokumentation von Lösungen, Prozessen und How Tos

• eng mit 3rd Level Engineering, Dienstleistern und internen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten

• Unterstützung kleinerer IT-Projekte am Arbeitsplatz und Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung

• als zuverlässiges Gegenstück vor Ort für zentrale Initiativen und Standards

Was du mitbringst

• 2–4+ Jahre Erfahrung im IT Support vor Ort oder im IT Service Desk (Level 1/2) in Unternehmensumgebungen

• starke praktische Fähigkeiten in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• praktische Erfahrungen mit Hardware-Unterstützung und strukturierten Rollouts

• solides Verständnis von Active Directory / Azure AD und grundlegenden Intune-Aufgaben

• grundlegendes Netzwerkwissen (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN-Grundlagen) für die Fehlersuche vor Ort

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Ticketing- und Asset-Prozessen, SLA-orientierte Denkweise

• hohe Serviceorientierung, Zuverlässigkeit, strukturierter Arbeitsstil und klare Kommunikation

• Deutsch fließend (gesprochen und geschrieben); gutes Englisch für Dokumentation und Support-Interaktion

• ITIL Foundation oder vergleichbare Zertifizierung

• Erfahrung in großen Unternehmensumgebungen

• Wissen um Microsoft Teams Rooms und Besprechungsraumtechnologie

• Englische Zertifizierung (z.B. Cambridge B2 / C1)

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Spécialiste du soutien en milieu de travail en TI

Zurich 100 % Référence 7977

Sur le rôle

Pour notre équipe informatique sur le lieu de travail, nous recherchons un supporteur sur place de niveau 2 qui assure des services informatiques stables, fiables et centrés sur l'utilisateur sur notre site de Zurich.

Vous agissez comme un point de contact clé pour nos employés sur place, manipulez des cas de soutien complexes et contribuez à l'amélioration et à la normalisation continues de notre environnement de travail en étroite collaboration avec les équipes informatiques centrales et les partenaires externes.

Ce que vous ferez

• fournir sur place une assistance de 2e niveau (et une sauvegarde pour le 1er niveau au besoin) pour les clients de Windows 11 et les services standard en milieu de travail

• traiter les incidents et les demandes de services par l'intermédiaire de la MISC, y compris les activités de la MIACD et la coordination de l'escalade;

• installer, remplacer et dépanner les périphériques utilisateurs finaux (ordinateurs portables, moniteurs, stations d'accueil, périphériques)

• support Microsoft 365, Active Directory / Azure AD utilisateur et gestion d'accès

• gérer et soutenir les imprimantes, les salles de réunion et la technologie de collaboration (salles d'équipe, vidéoconférence)

• support Endpoint Management (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) pour l'inscription des appareils, les contrôles de conformité et les affectations de logiciels

• contribuer à la normalisation des lieux de travail et à la gestion du cycle de vie (dispositifs, accessoires, salles de réunion)

• soutenir les déploiements, les pilotes et les cycles de recyclage en coopération avec les équipes centrales d'ingénierie

• assurer une documentation précise des solutions, des processus et de la façon de les utiliser

• travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'ingénierie de troisième niveau, les fournisseurs de services et les intervenants internes;

• soutenir des projets de TI et des initiatives d'amélioration continue en milieu de travail plus restreint

• agir comme contrepartie fiable sur place pour les initiatives et les normes centrales

Ce que vous apportez

• 2 à 4 ans d'expérience dans le support informatique sur place ou le service informatique (niveau 1/2) dans les environnements d'entreprise

• compétences pratiques fortes dans Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (équipes, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• expérience pratique avec support matériel et déploiement structuré

• compréhension solide de Active Directory / Azure AD et des tâches Intune de base

• connaissances de base en réseau (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, fondamentaux VLAN) pour le dépannage sur site

• expérience de travail avec la billetterie et les processus d'actifs, SLA orienté état d'esprit

• orientation de service élevée, fiabilité, style de travail structuré et communication claire

• Allemand couramment (parlé et écrit); bon anglais pour la documentation et l'interaction de soutien

• ITIL Fondation ou certification comparable

• expérience dans les environnements de grande entreprise

• savoir comment autour de Microsoft Teams Chambres et technologie de salle de réunion

• Certification anglaise (p. ex. Cambridge B2 / C1)

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Messaging Platform Engineer, Cloud & Containers

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8165

We are looking for a hands-on Messaging Platform Engineer to join our team in Zürich. A core responsibility of this role is the ongoing operation, maintenance and development of our business-critical on-premises IBM MQ Appliance environment. Alongside this established platform, our next step is to expand our messaging portfolio across OpenShift and Microsoft Azure. Beyond IBM MQ, we are also evaluating complementary cloud-native messaging technologies for the future hybrid messaging portfolio. This role combines platform engineering with software development. Your experience does not need to be limited to IBM MQ.

What You Will Do

• Operate and improve the IBM MQ Appliance platform

• Build automation, self-service capabilities and platform services

• Design and implement IBM MQ services in OpenShift and Azure

• Evaluate complementary messaging technologies

• Develop automation using APIs, CI/CD and infrastructure as code

• Troubleshoot production issues and participate in on-call rotation

What You Bring

• Enterprise messaging platform administration or engineering experience

• Production experience in OpenShift or public cloud environments

• Automation or software engineering skills in Java and Spring Boot

• Strong Linux, container, networking and security fundamentals

• Experience with CI/CD, observability and incident management

• Knowledge of Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform or cloud-native messaging

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Ingegnere di piattaforma di messaggistica, cloud & container

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8165

Stiamo cercando un Ingegnere della Piattaforma di Messaging per unirsi al nostro team a Zurigo. Una responsabilità fondamentale di questo ruolo è il funzionamento in corso, la manutenzione e lo sviluppo del nostro business-critical on-premises IBM MQ Appliance ambiente. Accanto a questa piattaforma consolidata, il nostro prossimo passo è quello di espandere il nostro portafoglio di messaggistica in OpenShift e Microsoft Azure. Oltre a IBM MQ, stiamo anche valutando le tecnologie complementari di messaggistica cloud-native per il futuro portafoglio di messaggi ibridi. Questo ruolo combina l'ingegneria della piattaforma con lo sviluppo del software. La tua esperienza non deve essere limitata a IBM MQ.

Cosa farai

• Operare e migliorare la piattaforma IBM MQ Appliance

• Costruire automazione, capacità self-service e servizi di piattaforma

• Progettazione e realizzazione dei servizi IBM MQ in OpenShift e Azure

• Valutare le tecnologie di messaggistica complementari

• Sviluppare l'automazione utilizzando API, CI/CD e infrastrutture come codice

• Risoluzione dei problemi di produzione e partecipazione alla rotazione delle chiamate

Che cosa porta

• Enterprise messaging piattaforma di amministrazione o esperienza di ingegneria

• Esperienza di produzione in ambienti OpenShift o cloud pubblici

• Capacità di automazione o software in Java e Spring Boot

• Forte Linux, container, networking e fondamentali di sicurezza

• Esperienza con CI/CD, osservabilità e gestione degli incidenti

• Conoscenza di Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform o messaggi cloud-native

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Engineer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8248

Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment and build reliable, scalable backend systems? Are you passionate about Java, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures? Then our Backend Engineering Team wants to hear from you.

We are an agile and collaborative team responsible for designing and operating core backend services that power our platform in the Post Trading area of the SIX Swiss Exchange. Our goal is to build & maintain robust, scalable, and maintainable systems that support critical business processes.

In this position, you will work closely with software engineers, architects, and product teams to design, maintain and deliver high-quality backend solutions.

What You Will Do

• Design, develop, and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot

• Build and operate event-driven services using Apache Kafka

• Develop and maintain applications running on Java application servers such as WildFly

• Collaborate with engineers and architects on system design, architecture, and technical improvements

• Ensure reliability, scalability, and performance of production systems

What You Bring

• Very strong experience with Java backend development and modern backend design principles

• Experience with Spring and Spring Boot for building microservices

• Experience with Kafka or other messaging / event-streaming platforms

• Experience with Wildfly/JBOSS is a big plus

• Experience designing RESTful APIs and working with SQL databases

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in english.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Engineer

Madrid | 100 | Reference 8248

Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment and build reliable, scalable backend systems? Are you passionate about Java, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures? Then our Backend Engineering Team wants to hear from you.

We are an agile and collaborative team responsible for designing and operating core backend services that power our platform in the Post Trading area of the SIX Swiss Exchange. Our goal is to build & maintain robust, scalable, and maintainable systems that support critical business processes.

In this position, you will work closely with software engineers, architects, and product teams to design, maintain and deliver high-quality backend solutions.

What You Will Do

• Design, develop, and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot

• Build and operate event-driven services using Apache Kafka

• Develop and maintain applications running on Java application servers such as WildFly

• Collaborate with engineers and architects on system design, architecture, and technical improvements

• Ensure reliability, scalability, and performance of production systems

What You Bring

• Very strong experience with Java backend development and modern backend design principles

• Experience with Spring and Spring Boot for building microservices

• Experience with Kafka or other messaging / event-streaming platforms

• Experience with Wildfly/JBOSS is a big plus

• Experience designing RESTful APIs and working with SQL databases

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call German Lopez Arranz at +34 91 709 5771 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in english.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Asset Servicing Internship
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Asset Servicing Internship

Madrid |  Flexible Working Model | Reference 8236

Are you a student with excellent organizational skills and an interest in the financial industry, looking for an exciting internship in Securities Services? We are looking for a bright, dedicated team player who will like to join our Global Asset Servicing team for a minimum of a six-month internship to provide hands-on support in managing the day-to-day operations of Asset Servicing.

Our global team, located in Switzerland and Spain, is responsible for Asset Servicing in the Domestic markets. We process all issuances and corporate actions in close cooperation with issuers, involved custodians and market participants. You will be part of a specialized team in which you will gather relevant practical experience and insights into the securities value chain and the cooperation with various interfaces will enable you to build up a broad network.

What You Will Do

• manage registration/deregistration of securities in the Spanish Market

• manage income corporate events such as dividends, coupon payments, redemptions…

• support SIX issuers and their agents on their day-to-day business

• identify and implement opportunities to improve and automate our processes liaising with other Asset Servicing team members

• provide ad hoc support to the projects related to the Asset Servicing team

What You Bring

• bachelor's or master's degree related to Business administration, finance, economics, etc. Knowledge of financial markets will be also a plus, but is not mandatory

• ability to work in a fast-paced environment with excellent organizational skills

• willingness to collaborate and work autonomously, paired with good time management skills and with a continued motivation to learn

• strong analytical skills with an eye for details and a team member mindset

• very good verbal and written skills in Spanish and English (B2 minimum) to interact with our international colleagues

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Internship Tax Services
jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Internship Tax Services

Olten |  100% | Referenz 8204

SIX Securities Services nimmt als zentrale Verwahrstelle für Wertschriften in der Schweiz eine wichtige Rolle im Finanzmarkt ein und unterliegt deshalb zahlreichen regulatorischen Anforderungen – insbesondere im Steuerbereich. Um diesen Anforderungen sowie den stetig wachsenden Kundenbedürfnissen gerecht zu werden und gezielt Nachwuchstalente zu fördern, bieten wir ein einjähriges Internship im Bereich Tax Services an.

Während des Internships erhältst du einen umfassenden Einblick in die steuerlichen Aspekte des Wertschriftengeschäfts. Du lernst die wichtigsten Steuerarten im Wertschriftenbereich kennen, unterstützt bei der Depotdokumentation und Kontoeröffnung entlang der Verwahrkette und wirkst bei der Bearbeitung von Steuerrückforderungen in verschiedenen Märkten mit.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Du übernimmst die risikoarme und kundenorientierte Abwicklung des Tagesgeschäfts im Team Regulatory Tax mit Fokus auf US Tax, Transaction Based Taxes sowie Account Documentation.

• Im Team Tax Processing Services lernst du, Steuerrückforderungsdienstleistungen für verschiedene internationale Märkte selbstständig abzuwickeln.

• Du unterstützt bei operativen, administrativen und analytischen Tätigkeiten sowie bei steuerrelevanten Projekten und Publikationen.

• Du bearbeitest Kundenanfragen eigenverantwortlich und führst fachliche Abklärungen mit Depotbanken, Steuerbehörden und weiteren externen Gegenparteien durch.

• Du arbeitest aktiv an anspruchsvolleren steuerlichen Fragestellungen mit und baust dein Fachwissen kontinuierlich aus.

Das brings du mit

• Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsrecht, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.

• Erste Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Daten sowie in der Datenanalyse sind von Vorteil.

• Du bist eine teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit Eigeninitiative und überzeugenden Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Du verfügst über ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten, eine strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, insbesondere in Excel und PowerPoint.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Janine Reichling  unter der Nummer +41 58 399 42 99.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Specialist Proxy Voting Services (80-100%)

Olten |  Bis zu 40 % Home Office möglich | Referenz 8235

Suchst du eine spannende Herausforderung in einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld? Möchtest du Verantwortung für die Koordination und Abwicklung von weltweiten Proxy Votings übernehmen?

Dann freut sich unser Team Proxy Voting International von dir zu hören!
Unser Team ist in täglichem Kontakt mit unseren Kunden und unterstützt diese bei allen Fragen rund ums Proxy Voting.  In dieser Rolle übernimmst du Verantwortung für die termingerechte Abwicklung internationaler Stimmrechtsweisungen und unterstützt unsere Kunden bei einem spezialisierten Service mit wachsender regulatorischer Bedeutung.
 Wir nehmen dich und deine Meinung sehr ernst und bauen auf deine Erfahrungen, um die Anforderungen unserer anspruchsvollen Kunden zu erfüllen und unser Angebot stetig zu verbessern und weiter zu entwickeln.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Abwicklung von weltweiten Stimmrechtsweisungen und GV-Eintrittskarten

• Überwachung von Deadlines, Exceptions und Spezialfällen wie Late Votings

• Beantwortung von Kundenanfragen sowie Abstimmung mit Depotstellen, Providern und internen Schnittstellen

• Koordination von Offenlegungsanfragen im Rahmen regulatorischer Anforderungen, z. B. SRD II

• Mitarbeit an Prozessverbesserungen und Projekten mit Einfluss auf den Proxy Voting-Service

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundbildung oder gleichwertige Ausbildung, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Finanzdienstleistungen oder regulierten Dienstleistungen

• Berufserfahrung im Finanz-, Wertschriften-, Operations- oder Kundenservice-Umfeld; Kenntnisse in Proxy Voting, Corporate Actions, Custody oder Securities Operations sind ein Plus

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit Blick für Risiken, Deadlines und Details

• Freude am Kundenkontakt, Teamarbeit und an der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Julia Schmidt  unter der Nummer +41 583 994 236.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

System Engineer

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8060

Are you passionate about building and maintaining secure, scalable, and resilient IT environments? Do you want to proof your skills in a highly impactful and challenging setup and be part of the team shaping the future of the Swiss financial market? Then our Directory Services team in Zürich is looking forward to hearing from you.

What You Will Do

• Design, operate, and secure Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments (including MFA, SSO, and PIM) in a hybrid setup.

• Constantly improve and automate existing services

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support infrastructure projects and incident resolution

• Ensure high availability, performance, and security of our critical systems

• Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize system performance and reliability

What You Bring

• Degree in Computer Science (FH, HF, Uni) or equivalent.

• 5+ years of experience in managing enterprise-scale environments and critical infrastructure.

• Strong understanding of Active Directory, Entra ID, Group Policies, and PowerShell scripting

• Experience with Microsoft management tools (MEMCM, SCOM, ADFS, Hyper-V), Networking and Hardware management

• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Ingegnere di sistema

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8060

Sei appassionato di costruire e mantenere ambienti IT sicuri, scalabili e resilienti? Vuoi provare le tue competenze in una configurazione altamente impegnativa e impegnativa e far parte del team che plasma il futuro del mercato finanziario svizzero? Allora il nostro team di Servizi Directory a Zurigo non vede l'ora di sentire da voi.

Cosa farai

• Progettazione, operare e proteggere gli ambienti Active Directory e Microsoft Entra ID (compresi MFA, SSO e PIM) in una configurazione ibrida.

• Migliorare costantemente e automatizzare i servizi esistenti

• Collaborare con team interfunzionali per sostenere progetti infrastrutturali e risoluzione degli incidenti

• Assicurare elevata disponibilità, prestazioni e sicurezza dei nostri sistemi critici

• Monitorare, risolvere i problemi e ottimizzare le prestazioni e l'affidabilità del sistema

Che cosa porta

• Laurea in Informatica (FH, HF, Uni) o equivalente.

• 5+ anni di esperienza nella gestione di ambienti su scala aziendale e infrastrutture critiche.

• Forte comprensione di Active Directory, ID ingresso, Criteri di gruppo e script di PowerShell

• Esperienza con strumenti di gestione Microsoft (MEMCM, SCOM, ADFS, Hyper-V), Gestione di rete e hardware

• Fluente in inglese (sia verbale che scritta), tedesco è un plus

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al +41583998611 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Test Automation & Guardrails
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - impulsa la transformación de los mercados financieros y pertenece a SIX, el tercer grupo bursátil más grande de Europa.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brillantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

AI Engineer - Test Automation & Guardrails

Warsaw, Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Referencia  8247

Agentic AI is changing how software gets built — and at SIX, it will touch the work of more than thousand engineers. We're building a new team at the center of this shift, responsible for shaping how AI-driven software engineering works across the company. As part of this team, you will build the guardrails that make agentic development trustworthy at scale: the test automation, coverage enforcement, and independent review layers that let AI agents write and ship code without compromising quality.

What You Will Do

• build test automation as a platform capability, not a project. Agent-driven test generation and maintenance, coverage enforcement on changed lines, flaky-test detection and self-healing, mutation testing, and test-suite health (redundancy, gaps, execution time) across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers.

• build and operate the AI agent harness. The sandboxed execution environment, tool/permission scoping, and CI/CD integration that lets agents propose, test, and merge code, instrumented with decision logs and action provenance so every agentic change is traceable and reproducible.

• own the independent review layer for AI-generated code and tests: correctness, coverage, and quality gates in CI/CD that verify what an agent produces using tooling the agent doesn't control, so speed never comes at the cost of test quality or code health.

• define and evolve the test strategy for an AI-driven SDLC. What gets tested where, how test data is generated and managed, and how test quality is measured (not just pass/fail, but whether the tests catch regressions).

• treat test automation and guardrails as a product, not a gate. Instrument for adoption, false-positive rate, and developer trust, keeping the safe, well-tested path the fastest path.

What You Bring

• 6+ years in software engineering with deep, hands-on expertise in test automation. Ideally a software/platform engineer in test, with a track record of building tooling or developer infrastructure that other engineering teams adopted, not just writing test suites.

• hands-on familiarity with agentic AI architectures. Agent orchestration, tool-use/sandboxing, and harness design, not just conceptual awareness of "AI in the SDLC."

• deep knowledge of test methodology and code quality: test pyramids, coverage strategy, mutation testing, flaky-test remediation, and what makes a test suite trustworthy versus just green.

• platform-product mindset. You build reusable capabilities and pave roads for other engineers, and you measure and strive for adoption and impact across SIX's business units.

• working knowledge of governance and controls in a regulated or high-assurance setting. Financial market infrastructure experience is a plus, but adjacent regulated-industry background is a plus. A pragmatic, collaborative bias toward quality and automation.

Si tienes alguna duda, consulta nuestra página de preguntas frecuentes (FAQ) o contacta con Yuliya Stoyko   +34 917095993 .

Para esta vacante sólo aceptamos solicitudes directas.

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - impulsa la transformación de los mercados financieros y pertenece a SIX, el tercer grupo bursátil más grande de Europa.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brillantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

AI Engineer - Test Automation & Guardrails

Madrid | 100 | Referencia 8247

Agentic AI is changing how software gets built — and at SIX, it will touch the work of more than thousand engineers. We're building a new team at the center of this shift, responsible for shaping how AI-driven software engineering works across the company. As part of this team, you will build the guardrails that make agentic development trustworthy at scale: the test automation, coverage enforcement, and independent review layers that let AI agents write and ship code without compromising quality.

What You Will Do

• build test automation as a platform capability, not a project. Agent-driven test generation and maintenance, coverage enforcement on changed lines, flaky-test detection and self-healing, mutation testing, and test-suite health (redundancy, gaps, execution time) across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers.

• build and operate the AI agent harness. The sandboxed execution environment, tool/permission scoping, and CI/CD integration that lets agents propose, test, and merge code, instrumented with decision logs and action provenance so every agentic change is traceable and reproducible.

• own the independent review layer for AI-generated code and tests: correctness, coverage, and quality gates in CI/CD that verify what an agent produces using tooling the agent doesn't control, so speed never comes at the cost of test quality or code health.

• define and evolve the test strategy for an AI-driven SDLC. What gets tested where, how test data is generated and managed, and how test quality is measured (not just pass/fail, but whether the tests catch regressions).

• treat test automation and guardrails as a product, not a gate. Instrument for adoption, false-positive rate, and developer trust, keeping the safe, well-tested path the fastest path.

What You Bring

• 6+ years in software engineering with deep, hands-on expertise in test automation. Ideally a software/platform engineer in test, with a track record of building tooling or developer infrastructure that other engineering teams adopted, not just writing test suites.

• hands-on familiarity with agentic AI architectures. Agent orchestration, tool-use/sandboxing, and harness design, not just conceptual awareness of "AI in the SDLC."

• deep knowledge of test methodology and code quality: test pyramids, coverage strategy, mutation testing, flaky-test remediation, and what makes a test suite trustworthy versus just green.

• platform-product mindset. You build reusable capabilities and pave roads for other engineers, and you measure and strive for adoption and impact across SIX's business units.

• working knowledge of governance and controls in a regulated or high-assurance setting. Financial market infrastructure experience is a plus, but adjacent regulated-industry background is a plus. A pragmatic, collaborative bias toward quality and automation.

Si tienes alguna duda, consulta nuestra página de preguntas frecuentes (FAQ) o contacta con Yuliya Stoyko +34 917095993 .

Para esta vacante sólo aceptamos solicitudes directas.

La diversidad es importante para nosotros. Por lo tanto, estamos deseando recibir solicitudes independientemente de cualquier contexto personal.

jobs.title: Head Product Management Funds
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Product Management Funds

London, Zurich |  Hybrid 60-40% | Reference 8243

Introduction
SIX is a leading provider of financial information, data services and related solutions for the financial services industry. We are seeking an experienced product leader to head the Funds Product Management function within SIX Financial Information. Reporting directly to the Head Product & Commercial Strategy, you will lead a team of Senior Product Managers and subject matter experts, shaping the strategic direction of our Funds proposition, driving commercial growth, and ensuring our offerings remain highly relevant, differentiated and aligned with evolving client and market needs.

What You Will Do

•    Define and execute the Funds product, content and commercial strategy, roadmap and proposition, ensuring alignment with business objectives, client demand and regulatory developments.
•    Drive revenue growth by strengthening market positioning, enhancing proposition clarity, supporting Sales teams and increasing client engagement across target markets.
•    Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from market opportunity identification and business case development through to product launch, performance management and retirement.
•    Simplify and optimise the Funds product portfolio by supporting end-of-life decisions for legacy services and integrating valuable capabilities into the strategic Funds offering.
•    Establish and deliver strategic objectives for content sourcing, data quality, service levels and automation, while reducing dependency on third-party providers through increased direct sourcing.
•    Partner closely with Data Operations, Technology, Business and IT Architecture teams to optimise operating models, improve organisational effectiveness and lead a high-performing team of Senior Product Managers and SMEs.

What You Will Bring

•    Significant experience in product management, product strategy or commercial product leadership within financial information, funds, asset management, wealth management or related data services.
•    Strong understanding of the Funds ecosystem, including market structure, client workflows, data sourcing, quality management, service delivery and regulatory requirements.
•    Proven ability to translate market opportunities into compelling product propositions, investment cases, commercial priorities and measurable business outcomes.
•    Experience leading expert product teams and influencing senior stakeholders across product, operations, technology, sales and executive leadership functions.
•    Excellent communication, commercial judgement and strategic decision-making skills, with the ability to drive focus, scalability and long-term client value.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Engineer (80-100%)

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8241

Do you want to design, build, and operate reliable, scalable systems powering financial index services? Are you passionate about hands-on engineering and solving complex technical challenges in a distributed environment?

Our Index team is based in Zurich and India and develops core platforms that enable the creation, calculation, and distribution of financial indices. We work at the intersection of data, engineering, and financial markets, ensuring stable and high-quality services for internal and external stakeholders.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a senior individual contributor within this distributed setup, working closely with engineers in Zurich and India. You will combine deep hands-on engineering expertise with end-to-end technical ownership, shaping robust solutions from design through production. You will collaborate closely with product managers, domain experts, SRE teams, and other engineers to deliver reliable, maintainable, and effective systems.

What You Will Do

• Design, build, and maintain backend services using Java (Spring Boot) and Python for index calculation and data processing platforms

• Own the end-to-end delivery of features, ensuring they are delivered on time and meet quality expectations

• Take technical ownership of complex components and features, from solution design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support

• Collaborate with SRE teams to ensure systems are reliable and production-ready, contributing to improvements where needed

• Drive architecture and engineering decisions to improve scalability, performance, and maintainability

What You Bring

• Deep hands-on software engineering expertise with Java (Spring Boot) and Python, including building, testing, deploying, and supporting production services

• Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems and make sound architecture and engineering decisions in production environments

• Strong knowledge of backend and distributed system design, including scalability, resilience, performance, observability, and maintainable integration patterns

• Experience using modern engineering tooling and AI-assisted development to improve productivity and code quality

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience in building and operating production systems

• Fluent English communication skills; German is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Do you want to design, build, and operate reliable, scalable systems powering financial index services? Are you passionate about hands-on engineering and solving complex technical challenges in a distributed environment?

Our Index team is based in Zurich and India and develops core platforms that enable the creation, calculation, and distribution of financial indices. We work at the intersection of data, engineering, and financial markets, ensuring stable and high-quality services for internal and external stakeholders.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a senior individual contributor within this distributed setup, working closely with engineers in Zurich and India. You will combine deep hands-on engineering expertise with end-to-end technical ownership, shaping robust solutions from design through production. You will collaborate closely with product managers, domain experts, SRE teams, and other engineers to deliver reliable, maintainable, and effective systems.

What You Will Do

• Design, build, and maintain backend services using Java (Spring Boot) and Python for index calculation and data processing platforms

• Own the end-to-end delivery of features, ensuring they are delivered on time and meet quality expectations

• Take technical ownership of complex components and features, from solution design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support

• Collaborate with SRE teams to ensure systems are reliable and production-ready, contributing to improvements where needed

• Drive architecture and engineering decisions to improve scalability, performance, and maintainability

What You Bring

• Deep hands-on software engineering expertise with Java (Spring Boot) and Python, including building, testing, deploying, and supporting production services

• Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems and make sound architecture and engineering decisions in production environments

• Strong knowledge of backend and distributed system design, including scalability, resilience, performance, observability, and maintainable integration patterns

• Experience using modern engineering tooling and AI-assisted development to improve productivity and code quality

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience in building and operating production systems

• Fluent English communication skills; German is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Risk Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Risk Data & Analytics Engineer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8226

Are you interested in the intersection of financial markets, risk management, and data engineering? Do you enjoy building scalable data solutions and automated processes that enable risk-informed decision-making? If so, this role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to group‑wide risk management at the core of the organization.
The Risk Methodology & Reporting unit plays a central role in shaping the global risk framework and advancing the risk data infrastructure. The team develops and operates the risk data platform and delivers high‑quality, decision‑relevant reporting to senior management and external stakeholders. We offer an attractive Microsoft Azure and Databricks-based technology stack, providing opportunities to work with modern data engineering frameworks, scalable cloud architectures, and the latest AI technologies.
In this role, you will work with a team of highly motivated, self‑driven specialists at the crossroads of risk analytics, financial market infrastructures, and state-of-the-art IT systems.

Does it sound interesting for you? Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Develop and enhance the Group’s risk data platform, data pipelines, and reporting capabilities.

• Translate complex risk data into decision‑relevant insights and dashboards

• Drive automation and scalability of risk data processing and analytics workflows

• Act as a key interface between Risk, IT, and Business functions to deliver data-driven solutions

• Take ownership of selected areas and drive the further development of group‑wide risk analytics capabilities

• Design and enhance data pipelines, automate risk data processes, and support the delivery of reliable risk information for decision-making

What You Bring

• Degree in Economics, Finance, Data Science, or a related field, with relevant professional experience in risk management, data engineering & analytics, or financial services

• Strong ability to structure and communicate complex topics for senior stakeholders, with a self‑driven working style and a high level of ownership and accountability

• Proven +4 years of hands‑on experience with data engineering & analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Spark, PowerBI); experience with Databricks and MS Azure is a strong plus

• Conceptual strength with the ability to link analytical results to business and risk implications

• Fluent English, both written and spoken; Spanish and/or German are an advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Head Business Architecture
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Business Architecture

London, Zurich |  Hybrid 60-40% | Reference 8233

Introduction
As Head of Business Architecture at SIX Financial Information, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic evolution of our financial data platforms. Working closely with senior business leaders, IT Architecture, and technology teams, you will translate business strategy into tangible transformation initiatives that drive growth, innovation, and operational excellence. Reporting into and working with Head Product & Commercial Strategy, you will lead a team of Business Architects, champion capability-driven planning, and help modernise the delivery of critical financial information products across our core content pillars, including Index, Funds, Fixed Income, Reference Data, and Market Data. Acting as a trusted strategic advisor, you will partner closely with IT Architecture and bridge the gap between business and technology, ensuring that platform investments align with long-term business objectives and customer needs.

What You Will Do

•    Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Business Architects Specialists, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
•    Translate business strategy into actionable business architecture artefacts, including value streams, process maps, business operating models and a strategic narrative and accompanying roadmaps.
•    In close partnership with Head of IT Architecture, contribute to the development and evolution of business capability models and joint strategic roadmaps that bridge strategy and execution
•    Partner closely with IT Architecture and business leaders to identify and drive transformation opportunities that enhance data platforms and delivery capabilities.
•    Conduct assessments of existing platforms, processes, and operating models, including functional SWOT analyses and supporting build-versus-buy evaluations, to support strategic decision-making.
•    Develop compelling business cases and executive-level recommendations that support investment decisions and enterprise transformation initiatives.
•    Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to evaluate emerging technologies, integrate third-party solutions, and optimise workflows across the organisation.

What You Will Bring

•    Extensive experience within the financial information industry, with deep expertise in market data, reference data, corporate actions, and financial data platforms.
•    Proven success in developing and applying structured frameworks and models, including value stream mapping, business operating models, and strategic planning methodologies.
•    Understanding of enterprise technology landscapes, data integration approaches (APIs, SFTP), and modern platform transformation programmes.
•    Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage and challenge senior executives, technology leaders, and cross-functional teams.
•    Outstanding analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, with a track record of translating complex business challenges into practical solutions and clear recommendations.
•    A collaborative leadership style, with a proven track record of partnering with IT Architecture and Technology functions, excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to inspire teams while driving organisational change and business outcomes.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Senior Labor Relations Consultant (vorübergehend)

Madrid | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 8178

• Beratung und Unterstützung bei allen operativen HR-Themen im Zusammenhang mit dem gesamten Lebenszyklus der Mitarbeiter; von Onboarding bis Offboarding und allem dazwischen, als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Führungskräfte und Mitarbeiter in Bezug auf Mitarbeiterbeziehungen

• fließend in Englisch und Spanisch, jede andere Sprache ist ein Plus

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - conduit la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième groupe de change en Europe.

Consultant principal en relations de travail (temporaire)

Madrid: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8178

Réussissez-vous à relever des défis complexes, à établir de solides relations et à diriger des initiatives qui comptent vraiment? Avez-vous une expérience étendue en matière de consultation en RH ou de gestion du personnel? Cherchez-vous un nouveau défi professionnel et êtes-vous intéressé par le secteur financier?

Rejoignez notre équipe RH en Espagne en tant que consultant principal en relations de travail pour couvrir un poste temporaire.

Nous sommes impatients de vous entendre. Postulez maintenant avec votre CV en anglais.

Ce que vous ferez

• Fournir des conseils et du soutien sur tous les sujets opérationnels des RH liés au cycle de vie complet des employés; de l'embarquement à l'éloignement et tout ce qui se passe entre eux, en agissant comme conseiller de confiance auprès du leadership et du personnel sur les relations avec les employés

• Fournir des conseils juridiques sur les accords de travail, les conflits sur le lieu de travail et les questions disciplinaires, et représenter l'entreprise dans les procédures judiciaires si nécessaire

• Surveiller les mises à jour des lois locales du travail et des règlements SIX, veiller à ce que les politiques locales en matière de ressources humaines soient adaptées en temps opportun et vérifier leur conformité aux normes les plus récentes

• Agir comme l'un des points de contact pour les représentants syndicaux et gérer les processus de négociation collective et négocier les ententes, l'ABC, résoudre les différends et assurer le respect des ententes syndicales

• Établir et maintenir des relations efficaces avec les syndicats pour promouvoir la compréhension mutuelle et l'alignement sur les objectifs organisationnels

• Gérer les inspections et les exigences des autorités du travail, de la sécurité sociale, de l'Agence fiscale et d'autres autorités

• Diriger les initiatives de RH, y compris les programmes de diversité et d'inclusion, l'engagement des employés et la gestion du changement organisationnel, travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de RH aux niveaux local et mondial et contribuer à différents projets de RH

Ce que vous apportez

• Licence ou maîtrise en droit du travail, ressources humaines ou domaine connexe

• Minimum de 7 ans d'expérience en conseil en ressources humaines ou en gestion du personnel, avec au moins 3 ans à titre de cadre supérieur

• Connaissance approfondie des lois, règlements et normes du travail espagnols

• Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion des relations syndicales, y compris la négociation collective et le règlement des conflits

• Capacité de naviguer dans une organisation matricielle internationale et mondiale

• Compétences solides en résolution de problèmes et en adaptabilité, négociation et communication

• Connaissance de l'anglais et de l'espagnol, toute autre langue est un plus

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Sara Perez de la Cuesta au +34 91 709 56 80 .

Pour cette vacance, nous acceptons uniquement les candidatures directes en anglais.

jobs.title: Business Data Architect
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Data Architect

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 8194

The Financial Information division within SIX Group is a global provider of financial data and analytics to the global financial services industry. This role sits within the Business-led Product Development division and focuses on our business data model, ensuring our financial data products meet customer, commercial and regulatory needs. The role partners closely with Product Teams, SMEs and Operations as key stakeholders.

We are looking for a Data Architect with UML business data model experience to work within the Financial Information Product Delivery group for a hands on role updating and maintaining our business data model. This encompasses the design of conceptual data models and deep analysis of the data which underpins it. The team also creates physical schemas, so experience or an interest in creating JSON schemas from conceptual models is a plus!

``

What You Will Do

• work with stakeholders across the business to review, update and design the conceptual data models for Financial Information, defining class definitions, standards and association semantics.

• develop and maintain design, naming conventions, dictionaries, lineage and metadata standards, collaborating with data quality teams to ensure models support validation rules.

• partner with stakeholders across the business to translate complex data concepts and requirements into robust UML data models that form the basis of BFI products.

• support the evolution of data distribution models, including API-first delivery and AI data access enablement.

• work closely with our Quality Management stakeholders, to drive adoption of the data model and data completeness.

What You Bring

• financial data knowledge: Strong understanding of the financial data domain. For example, securities reference data, corporate actions, tax/regulatory classifications or market data

• technical skills: Programming language experience in SQL, Phython and Vbscript, VBA . Demonstrated proficiency in UML business data modelling tools such as Sparx EA (ideally), Erwin, PowerDesigner or similar, with experience in forward engineering and database or data warehouse design highly desirable.

• strong understanding of data governance best practices such as the role of data owners, stewards and custodians and of conceptual and physical data models. Experience with data catalogs is desirable, but not mandatory.

• collaborative and detail oriented approach to analytical and modelling tasks. The team collaborate with many stakeholders and the outputs of these discussions must be clearly held in the Business Data Model.

• fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Architetto di dati aziendali

Varsavia | lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8194

La divisione Informazioni Finanziarie all'interno del Gruppo SIX è un fornitore globale di dati finanziari e analisi per il settore dei servizi finanziari globali. Questo ruolo si trova all'interno della divisione Business-led Product Development e si concentra sul nostro modello di dati aziendali, garantendo che i nostri prodotti finanziari soddisfano le esigenze del cliente, commerciale e regolamentare. Il ruolo collabora a stretto contatto con i team di prodotti, le PMI e le operazioni come principali stakeholder.

Siamo alla ricerca di un Data Architect con l'esperienza del modello di dati aziendali UML per lavorare all'interno del gruppo Financial Information Product Delivery per una mano sull'aggiornamento del ruolo e il mantenimento del nostro modello di dati aziendali. Ciò comprende la progettazione di modelli di dati concettuali e l'analisi profonda dei dati che lo sostengono. Il team crea anche schemi fisici, quindi l'esperienza o l'interesse a creare schemi JSON da modelli concettuali è un plus!

``

Cosa farai

• lavorare con gli stakeholder di tutto il business per rivedere, aggiornare e progettare i modelli di dati concettuali per le informazioni finanziarie, definendo le definizioni di classe, gli standard e l'associazione semantica.

• sviluppare e mantenere la progettazione, design convenzioni, dizionari, lineage e metadati standard, collaborando con i team di qualità dei dati per garantire le regole di validazione dei modelli.

• partner con gli stakeholder di tutto il business per tradurre concetti e requisiti di dati complessi in robusti modelli di dati UML che formano la base dei prodotti BFI.

• supporta l'evoluzione dei modelli di distribuzione dei dati, tra cui la prima consegna API e l'attivazione dell'accesso ai dati AI.

• lavorare a stretto contatto con i nostri stakeholder di Gestione della Qualità, per guidare l'adozione del modello di dati e la completezza dei dati.

Che cosa porta

• conoscenza dei dati finanziari: forte comprensione del dominio dei dati finanziari. Ad esempio, dati di riferimento dei titoli, azioni societarie, classificazioni fiscali/regolari o dati di mercato

• competenze tecniche: Esperienza linguistica di programmazione in SQL, Phython e Vbscript, VBA . La competenza dimostrata negli strumenti di modellazione dati aziendali UML come Sparx EA (idealmente), Erwin, PowerDesigner o simili, con esperienza nell'ingegneria avanzata e nella progettazione di database o di data warehouse altamente desiderabile.

• forte comprensione delle migliori pratiche di governance dei dati, come il ruolo dei titolari di dati, amministratori e custodi e dei modelli di dati concettuali e fisici. L'esperienza con i cataloghi di dati è auspicabile, ma non obbligatoria.

• approccio collaborativo e orientato al dettaglio alle attività analitiche e di modellazione. Il team collabora con molte parti interessate e i risultati di queste discussioni devono essere chiaramente tenuti nel Business Data Model.

• fluente in inglese (sia verbale che scritta), tedesco è un plus.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Anthony Mills al numero +44 207 550 5407 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Business Data Architekt

Warschau | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 8194

Die Division Financial Information innerhalb der SIX Group ist ein globaler Anbieter von Finanzdaten und Analysen für die globale Finanzdienstleistungsbranche. Diese Rolle ist Teil der Business-led Product Development Division und konzentriert sich auf unser Geschäftsdatenmodell, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Finanzdatenprodukte den Kunden-, Handels- und regulatorischen Anforderungen entsprechen. Die Rolle ist eng mit Produktteams, KMU und Operations als wichtige Stakeholder verbunden.

Wir suchen einen Datenarchitekten mit UML-Geschäftsdatenmodell-Erfahrung, der innerhalb der Financial Information Product Delivery-Gruppe für eine praktische Rollenaktualisierung und Wartung unseres Geschäftsdatenmodells arbeitet. Dies umfasst die Gestaltung von konzeptionellen Datenmodellen und eine gründliche Analyse der Daten, die sie untermauern. Das Team erstellt auch physische Schemata, so dass Erfahrung oder Interesse an der Erstellung von JSON-Schemata aus konzeptionellen Modellen ein Plus sind!

``

Was Sie tun werden

• Arbeiten Sie mit Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen zusammen, um die konzeptionellen Datenmodelle für Finanzinformationen zu überprüfen, zu aktualisieren und zu entwerfen und Klassendefinitionen, Standards und Assoziationssemantik zu definieren.

• Entwicklung und Pflege von Design-, Namenskonventionen, Wörterbüchern, Abstammungs- und Metadatenstandards in Zusammenarbeit mit Datenqualitätsteams, um sicherzustellen, dass Modelle Validierungsregeln unterstützen.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen, um komplexe Datenkonzepte und -anforderungen in robuste UML-Datenmodelle zu übersetzen, die die Grundlage für BFI-Produkte bilden.

• Unterstützung der Entwicklung von Datenverteilungsmodellen, einschließlich API-First Delivery und AI Data Access Enablement.

• eng mit unseren Stakeholdern des Qualitätsmanagements zusammenarbeiten, um die Einführung des Datenmodells und die Vollständigkeit der Daten voranzutreiben.

Was du mitbringst

• Wissen über Finanzdaten: Starkes Verständnis des Finanzdatenbereichs. Zum Beispiel Wertpapierreferenzdaten, Kapitalmaßnahmen, steuerliche/regulatorische Klassifizierungen oder Marktdaten

• Technische Fähigkeiten: Programmieren Spracherfahrung in SQL, Phython und Vbscript, VBA . Nachgewiesene Kenntnisse in UML Business Data Modeling Tools wie Sparx EA (idealerweise), Erwin, PowerDesigner oder ähnlichem, mit Erfahrung im Forward Engineering und Datenbank- oder Data Warehouse-Design sehr wünschenswert.

• Ein fundiertes Verständnis der bewährten Praktiken im Bereich Data Governance wie der Rolle von Dateneigentümern, Verwaltern und Verwahrern sowie von konzeptionellen und physischen Datenmodellen. Erfahrung mit Datenkatalogen ist wünschenswert, aber nicht obligatorisch.

• kollaborativer und detailorientierter Ansatz für analytische und Modellierungsaufgaben. Das Team arbeitet mit vielen Stakeholdern zusammen und die Ergebnisse dieser Diskussionen müssen klar im Geschäftsdatenmodell festgehalten werden.

Varsovie : travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% Référence 8194

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior PL/SQL Analyst

Madrid, Barcelona |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8109

Join our team and play a key role in shaping the future of European Clearing services. As aSenior PL/SQL Analyst, you will work at the heart of a business-critical Clearing ecosystem, supporting and evolving complex applications while contributing to the development of a next-generation, unified Clearing platform, working with Oracle, PL/SQL, Java, and modern architectures. You will play a key role in ensuring the stability, performance, and evolution of a complex financial ecosystem in an international environment. The hiring could be either in Madrid or in Barcelona.

What You Will Do

• Develop a deep understanding of the Clearing applications ecosystem, including core business flows, data models, and system dependencies.

• Design, develop, and maintain robust PL/SQL solutions to support critical Clearing processes, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.

• Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production incidents, acting as part of the L3 support model for business-critical applications.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurrence, contributing to system stability and continuous improvement.

• Participate in support activities outside business hours, including resolution of high-priority incidents affecting Clearing operations.

• Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to evolve legacy systems, contributing to modernization initiatives and integration with new architectures (e.g., microservices).

• Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and handover processes, ensuring long-term maintainability and team autonomy.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, operations, and risk teams to ensure efficient and compliant operation of Clearing services.

• Contribute to the re-architecture, analysis and development of the next-generation Clearing platform, supporting the integration and consolidation of European Clearing systems into a unified ecosystem.

What You Bring

• Strong expertise in Oracle databases and advanced PL/SQL development, with proven experience in complex data processing and performance optimization.

• Solid background in application and system architecture, especially in complex legacy environments.

• Understanding of the Clearing business domain will be a plus

• Some experience with Java (microservices architecture) and Linux environments will be highly valuable.

• Good level of Spanish and English (B2 minimum), both written and spoken.

• Availability to perform planned support activities outside standard working hours, when required. This is extra compensated.

• Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call support rotation, covering full weeks (approximately one week per month) and to cover some bank holidays (aprox. 6 per year). This services are extra compensated.

Are you interested in working in a highly dynamic environment with international tax exposure? We are looking for an experienced Senior Tax Specialist to join our Group Tax / Tax Management team in Spain. This role requires a self-driven professional who independently manages key tax matters, including tax compliance, tax planning, and advisory support to the group on topics such as restructurings and acquisitions. A particular focus lies on FATCA and QI compliance, where deep expertise and practical experience are essential. Beyond this, you will cover a wide spectrum of responsibilities within an international tax function.

What You Will Do

• Own and manage FATCA and QI compliance processes, including reporting, controls, and coordination with key stakeholders such as the tax operations teams in Switzerland

• Oversee EU DAC obligations, ensuring accurate data validation, documentation, and regulatory submissions

• Act as a tax business partner to BSS Business Units, providing advisory support on products, services, and operational tax matters

• Collaborate closely with Swiss and Spanish teams to align processes and ensure consistent tax governance standards

• Support transfer pricing topics, including data preparation, documentation, and coordination with internal experts

• Take responsibility for corporate tax compliance and tax reporting across relevant entities

• Contribute to tax planning initiatives and provide support on group-wide projects, including restructurings and M&A activities

• Provide comprehensive tax advice on a broad range of international and local tax matters within the group

What You Bring

• Degree in Tax, Business, or Economics with hands-on experience in FATCA, QI, and tax compliance frameworks

• Solid experience in international or regulated environments with exposure to EU or US tax reporting obligations

• Ability to work independently with structured and reliable approach in compliance-driven environments

• Strong communication skills to collaborate across teams and explain complex tax matters to internal and external stakeholders clearly

• Needed Language Skills: English and Spanish

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
