jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Analyst

Warsaw |  80-100% | Reference 8240

Are you passionate about working with Fund data and being involved in the financial markets? Do you possess strong problem-solving skills, and a desire to influence others and drive change? We are looking for a dedicated team player to join our team within SIX Financial Information to support and improve the processes for onboarding Fund Full Holdings data.

To help you achieve your goals, you will have the support of the product management team, and will benefit from partnering with product development, support/operations, project management, customer support as required. Additionally, you may be working with external partners on implementing and interconnecting data, solutions and analytical workflows.

This is a full-time position based in Warsaw, offering the opportunity for remote work 40% of the time as part of our hybrid working model.

Join us at SIX and make your impact with financial data!

What You Will Do

• Support and coordinate the onboarding of fund data providers and services, including file analysis, configuration, testing, and production deployment.

• Ensure operational excellence by maintaining data quality and service performance across fund data products.

• Drive process improvements and automation initiatives to enhance efficiency, scalability, and data quality.

• Manage stakeholder relationships and onboarding requirements, while serving as the escalation point for complex operational issues.

• Contribute to the development of new analytics, products, and data services to support business growth and innovation.

What You Bring

• Strong knowledge of multiple asset classes, including mutual funds, equities, fixed income, and derivatives, with a particular focus on funds.

• Good understanding of fund portfolio holdings, fund data structures, and key fund analytics and indicators.

• Experience in Fund Administration, Asset Management Operations, or a middle-office environment is an advantage.

• Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills, with a structured and methodical approach to work.

• Customer-focused and collaborative team player who is motivated, organized, inquisitive, and demonstrates a proactive "can-do" attitude.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Index Customer Administration Specialist
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Index Customer Administration Specialist

Zurich |  bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Reference 8239

Du arbeitest für den Geschäftsbereich Index Services und bist verantwortlich für alle unterstützenden und administrativen Tätigkeiten im Index Business und Sales Support. Dich erwartet eine abwechslungsreiche Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Kunden, Datenmanagement, Finanzprodukten und Compliance. Ein erfahrenes und engagiertes Team unterstützt dich dabei, die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und Stakeholder in den Mittelpunkt zu stellen.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Kundenstammpflege, Vertragsmanagement, Gebührenverrechnung und Mahnwesen; Freigabe von Daten/Services gemäss Kundenvereinbarungen

• Bearbeitung von Themen in Compliance, Legal und Quellensteuer; enge Abstimmung mit internen Fachstellen

• First Level Support hinsichtlich Finanzprodukten, Indexdaten, kommerziellen Vereinbarungen und technische Fragen; Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Daten-Vendoren und Geschäftspartnern

• Konsolidierung/Überwachung indexbasierter Produkte (Fonds, strukturierte Produkte, Derivate); Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsprozessen, regulatorischen Berichten und Prozessdokumentationen

• Durchführung von Analysen, Statistiken und Reports; Mitarbeit in bereichsübergreifenden Projekten und strategischen Umsatzinitiativen; allgemeine Administration

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung; relevante Berufserfahrung im Finanzsektor

• Ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung sowie professionelles, überzeugendes Auftreten und klare Kommunikation

• Hohe Genauigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise; souverän im Management komplexer administrativer Aufgaben

• Starke Organisationsfähigkeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld Prioritäten zu setzen und den Überblick zu behalten

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Spanisch von Vorteil); sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, SAP-Erfahrung ist ein grosses Plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41 583 994 236 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Kundenstammpflege, Vertragsmanagement, Gebührenverrechnung und Mahnwesen; Freigabe von Daten/Services gemäss Kundenvereinbarungen

• Bearbeitung von Themen in Compliance, Legal und Quellensteuer; enge Abstimmung mit internen Fachstellen

• First Level Support hinsichtlich Finanzprodukten, Indexdaten, kommerziellen Vereinbarungen und technische Fragen; Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Daten-Vendoren und Geschäftspartnern

• Konsolidierung/Überwachung indexbasierter Produkte (Fonds, strukturierte Produkte, Derivate); Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsprozessen, regulatorischen Berichten und Prozessdokumentationen

• Durchführung von Analysen, Statistiken und Reports; Mitarbeit in bereichsübergreifenden Projekten und strategischen Umsatzinitiativen; allgemeine Administration

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung; relevante Berufserfahrung im Finanzsektor

• Ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung sowie professionelles, überzeugendes Auftreten und klare Kommunikation

• Hohe Genauigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise; souverän im Management komplexer administrativer Aufgaben

• Starke Organisationsfähigkeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld Prioritäten zu setzen und den Überblick zu behalten

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Financial securities specialist with French

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7909

At SIX, this role offers the opportunity to contribute to a leading financial market infrastructure provider by ensuring the quality and reliability of reference data across funds, fixed income, and shares. Following a structured onboarding, the position focuses on maintaining accurate data, supporting regulatory compliance, and delivering high standards of service to clients. The role combines analytical responsibilities with functional client support in an international and data‑driven environment. It is well suited for candidates interested in financial markets and the core processes that support them.

What You Will Do:

• entering reference data into SIX different databases

• verifying data consistency and performing second-level checks

• providing functional assistance to clients

What You Bring:

• fluent French speaking

• first experience in the financial data industry or a related field is a plus

• knowledge of French and European fund/Fixed Income/Shares regulations

• understanding of the fund/Fixed Income/Shares ecosystem (market players, data distribution systems, Back/Front office concepts)

• SQL language knowledge is a plus

• experience with JIRA and Confluence tools

• higher education background in management/finance (ideally a Master’s degree)

• strong interest in and passion for financial markets

• excellent analytical skills, autonomy, rigor, and strong team spirit

• ability to work across diverse environments and adapt to various tools and technologies

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at 538 562 645 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Shares and Bonds Data Editor with French

Varsavia | Fino al 40% di lavoro da casa possibile | Riferimento 7909

A SIX, questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di contribuire a un fornitore di infrastrutture di mercato finanziario leader garantendo la qualità e l'affidabilità dei dati di riferimento su fondi, reddito fisso e azioni. A seguito di una strutturata onboarding, la posizione si concentra sul mantenimento di dati accurati, sul supporto della conformità normativa e sulla fornitura di elevati standard di servizio ai clienti. Il ruolo combina le responsabilità analitiche con il supporto funzionale del cliente in un ambiente internazionale e guidato dai dati. È adatto per i candidati interessati ai mercati finanziari e ai processi fondamentali che li sostengono.

• inserire i dati di riferimento in SIX diversi database

• verificare la coerenza dei dati e eseguire controlli di secondo livello

• fornire assistenza funzionale ai clienti

Cosa porti:

• fluente francese parlando

• la prima esperienza nel settore dei dati finanziari o in un settore relativo è un plus

• conoscenza del fondo francese ed europeo/regolamenti sul reddito/condizioni fiscali

• comprensione dell'ecosistema di reddito/condizioni del fondo/Fixed (responsabili del mercato, sistemi di distribuzione dei dati, concetti di ufficio Back/Front)

• Conoscenza della lingua SQL è un plus

• esperienza con gli strumenti JIRA e Confluence

• livello di istruzione superiore nella gestione/finanza (di solito un master)

• forte interesse e passione per i mercati finanziari

• eccellenti capacità analitiche, autonomia, rigore e forte spirito di squadra

• capacità di lavorare in ambienti diversi e adattarsi a vari strumenti e tecnologie

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Shares and Bonds Data Editor mit Französisch

Warschau | Bis zu 40% von zu Hause aus arbeiten möglich | Referenz 7909

Bei SIX bietet diese Rolle die Möglichkeit, einen Beitrag zu einem führenden Anbieter von Finanzmarktinfrastrukturen zu leisten, indem die Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit von Referenzdaten über Fonds, Fixed Income und Aktien hinweg sichergestellt wird. Nach einem strukturierten Onboarding konzentriert sich die Position auf die Pflege genauer Daten, die Unterstützung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften und die Bereitstellung hoher Servicestandards für Kunden. Die Rolle verbindet analytische Verantwortlichkeiten mit funktionaler Kundenbetreuung in einem internationalen und datengesteuerten Umfeld. Es eignet sich gut für Kandidaten, die sich für Finanzmärkte und die Kernprozesse interessieren, die sie unterstützen.

Was Sie tun werden:

• Eingabe von Referenzdaten in verschiedene Datenbanken von SIX

• Überprüfung der Datenkonsistenz und Durchführung von Prüfungen der zweiten Stufe

• Bereitstellung funktionaler Unterstützung für Kunden

Was Sie mitbringen:

• fließend Französisch sprechend

• erste Erfahrung in der Finanzdatenbranche oder einem verwandten Bereich ist ein Plus

• Kenntnis der französischen und europäischen Fonds/Fixed Income/Aktien-Vorschriften

• Verständnis des Ökosystems Fonds / Fixed Income / Shares (Marktakteure, Datenverteilungssysteme, Back / Front Office-Konzepte)

• SQL Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus

• Hochschulhintergrund in Management / Finanzen (idealerweise ein Master-Abschluss)

descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Éditeur de données des actions et des obligations avec français

Varsovie: jusqu'à 40% de travail à domicile possible

Chez SIX, ce rôle offre la possibilité de contribuer à un fournisseur d'infrastructure de marché financier de premier plan en assurant la qualité et la fiabilité des données de référence sur les fonds, les revenus fixes et les actions. À la suite d'un embarquement structuré, le poste est axé sur le maintien de données exactes, l'appui à la conformité réglementaire et la prestation de normes élevées de service aux clients. Ce rôle combine les responsabilités analytiques et le soutien fonctionnel des clients dans un environnement international et axé sur les données. Il convient parfaitement aux candidats intéressés par les marchés financiers et les processus de base qui les soutiennent.

Ce que vous ferez :

• saisie des données de référence dans SIX différentes bases de données

• vérifier la cohérence des données et effectuer des contrôles de deuxième niveau

• Fournir une assistance fonctionnelle aux clients

Ce que vous apportez:

• parler couramment français

• première expérience dans le secteur des données financières ou un domaine connexe est un plus

• connaissance de la réglementation française et européenne des fonds/revenus fixes/actions

• compréhension de l'écosystème fonds/revenus fixes/actions (acteurs du marché, systèmes de distribution de données, concepts back/Front office)

• La connaissance du langage SQL est un plus

• expérience avec les outils JIRA et Confluence

• Études supérieures en gestion/finance (idéalement un master)

• fort intérêt et passion pour les marchés financiers

• excellentes compétences analytiques, autonomie, rigueur et esprit d'équipe

• Capacité de travailler dans divers environnements et de s'adapter à divers outils et technologies

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa au 538 562 645 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Product Manager

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home | Reference 8195

Join the Customer Interfaces Product Management team to shape next generation of financial data delivery solutions. We seek motivated professionals with a passion for technology and financial data, capable of maintaining current platforms while driving innovation in new delivery systems. The Delivery Product Manager is responsible for specifying, developing and managing products that enable efficient, compliant and scalable delivery of financial data to clients. This roles bridges business needs and technical capabilities ensuring seamless integration across file delivery systems, APIs and Cloud solutions.

What You Will Do

• Define and maintain product vision and roadmap for the delivery interfaces.

• Aligning product strategy with business objectives

• Engage with customers and customer experience team to identify areas for improvement and business opportunities.

• Translate requirements into features and user stories.

• Collaborate with IT teams to ensure high-quality and timely delivery.

• Manage product lifecycle.

• Work closely with development, architecture, and support teams.

• Coordinate with security and compliance and billing teams.

• Present to Sales and Sales consultants new features and roadmap.

• Support sales during the pre- and post-selling phases.

What You Bring

• Experience in the financial information industry and product management

• Understanding of delivery technologies (SFTP, APIs. Cloud experience will be a plus).

• Good understanding of financial data.

• Good analytical and communication skills.

• Experienced in agile methodologies (SCRUM, SAFe).

• Familiar with AI technologies.

• Fluent in English. French is plus. German and Spanish a nice to have.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: DevOps Software Engineer (Gitlab)
jobs.description:
SIX impulsa la transformación de los mercados financieros.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brillantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

DevOps Software Engineer (Gitlab)

Warsaw, Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Referencia  7860

Our centralized Software Development LifeCycle platform, based on GitLab and JFrog Artifactory, provides core capabilities to software developers across SIX.  We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to maintain and evolve our GitLab platform and enhance our GitLab components with related tooling, that empower product teams across the organization to increase efficacy and code quality.

What You Will Do

• take a leading role in maintaining and evolving our corporate SIX GitLab platform running in Azure

• design, implement, and manage GitLab components and configurations (groups, projects, runners, pipelines, templates, shared libraries)

• build and maintain shared CI/CD pipelines, reusable templates, automations and best-practice patterns for delivery at scale

• implement and maintain GitLab Runners (Kubernetes, autoscaling, Docker, Shell) with enterprise-grade reliability and security

• drive continuous improvement through automation, AI solutions, self-service capabilities and feedback loops

• create documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement materials; deliver training and provide Tier 2/3 support for GitLab and related tools

What You Bring

• 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or SRE, with focus on GitLab administration and CI/CD. Experience with GitLab Premium or Ultimate features is a plus

• proficiency with CI/CD concepts: branching strategies, pipeline as code, artifacts, environments, approvals, and compliance controls

• hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes),  deploying/scaling GitLab Runners on K8s, Prometheus and Grafana

• familiarity with IaC tools (Terraform, Helm) and configuration management (Ansible or similar). Strong scripting and automation skills (Bash, Python or similar)

• strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to work cross-functionally

• team-player with good verbal and written skills in English

Si tienes alguna duda, consulta nuestra página de preguntas frecuentes (FAQ) o contacta con Yuliya Stoyko   +34 917095993 .

Para esta vacante sólo aceptamos solicitudes directas.

La diversidad es importante para nosotros. Por lo tanto, estamos deseando recibir solicitudes independientemente de cualquier contexto personal.

jobs.title: Senior Data Architect
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Data Architect

London |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7637

The Financial Information division within SIX Group is a global provider of financial data and analytics to the global financial services industry.  This role sits within the Business-led Product Development division and focuses on business data architecture, ensuring our financial data products meet customer, commercial and regulatory needs. The role partners closely with IT Architecture as a key stakeholder but is not part of the IT function.

We are looking for an experienced data architect to work within the Financial Information Product Delivery group to provide data architecture leadership across the firm to ensure our data products deliver value to our customers and they can be readily maintained and enhanced.  This encompasses the design and architecture of logical and physical data models and schemas, data transport mechanisms, metadata management, lineage management, API schema design and enabling SIX financial information to be accessible to AI agents.

What You Will Do

•    Design, develop and maintain the technology-agnostic, business-aligned canonical/conceptual data models for Financial Information, defining class definitions, standards and association semantics.
•    Provide data architecture expertise to all delivery teams to ensure we build data products that meet customer expectations, can be readily maintained and enhanced, and we have a core foundation on which we can readily build new revenue generating products.
•    Develop and maintain design, naming conventions, dictionaries, lineage and metadata standards, collaborating with data quality teams to ensure models support validation rules.
•    Partner with stakeholders across the business to translate complex data concepts and requirements into robust data products that customers want to purchase whilst contributing to the architectural governance process.
•    Support the evolution of data distribution models, including API-first delivery and AI data access enablement.

What You Bring

•    Hands-on experience designing schemas for relational databases, messaging, data lakes/lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent), and API/message formats (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).  Strong understanding of metadata and lineage management.
•    5+ years of experience, or demonstrated delivery against requirements in data modelling, data architecture, or a closely related discipline within financial services with proficiency in UML data modelling tools such as Sparx EA (ideally), Erwin, PowerDesigner or similar
•    Strong understanding of the financial data domain: securities reference data, corporate actions, market data, and regulatory classifications, fixed income would be highly desirable
•    Understanding of API design principles (REST, GraphQL) and schema evolution strategies for backward compatibility is essential.  Direct experience of making data commercially available to AI agents is desirable.
•    Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus.  It is essential that the person in this role is able to clearly communicate complex concepts and data structures to a wide range of stakeholders.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Customer Support Agent

Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8252

In this hybrid role you handle day-to-day customer requests while driving automation and continuous improvement. You ensure high-quality ticket handling, spot patterns, and help reduce avoidable tickets through AI-assisted solutions and workflow optimization.

What You Will Do

• Handle recurring and standard customer tickets with accuracy and a customer-focused approach, ensuring correct categorization and high data quality.

• Analyze tickets to identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.

• Support ticket routing and classification processes.

• Monitor outcomes and performance trends, and recommend process enhancements.

What You Bring

• 1-3 years of experience in customer support, service operations, or a related customer-facing role, with strong English language skills.

• A customer-first mindset, strong process discipline, and attention to detail.

• Analytical thinking and the ability to identify patterns and suggest improvements.

• Familiarity with basic automation concepts and tools, with a willingness to learn new technologies and ways of working.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41 583 994 236 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Business Analyst
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

ServiceNow Business Analyst

Warsaw |  Hybrid model | Reference 7870

We are looking for a ServiceNow Business Analyst to support the rollout and ongoing evolution of a greenfield ServiceNow platform and the transformation of service management capabilities at SIX. This is not a short-term or single-module role. It is a platform-focused position supporting the design and delivery of ServiceNow across multiple domains over time. The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner, Platform Architect and business stakeholders to translate prioritized demand into clear, structured requirements, ensuring solutions are scalable, OOTB-first and aligned with the long-term platform vision.

The role supports requirements and process design across several ServiceNow domains within a greenfield platform context, including: ITSM - must, CSM - preferred, CMDB / CSDM - preferred, IRM / GRC - preferred, HRSD - preferred. The candidate does not need to be equally strong across all domains. Experience in several areas is sufficient.

What You Will Do

• gather, analyze and document business and functional requirements in collaboration with stakeholders across ITSM, CSM, CMDB/CSDM, IRM/GRC and HRSD

• run workshops to understand current-state processes, pain points, dependencies and future-state needs

• translate business requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and supporting documentation

• support the transformation of processes from legacy tools and practices into the ServiceNow platform

• perform OOTB fit-gap analysis and challenge unnecessary customization early

• identify opportunities to standardize, simplify, redesign, phase or retire processes

• work closely with the Product Owner on backlog refinement and scope clarification

• work closely with the Platform Architect to ensure requirements align with the target-state design and platform guardrails and do not introduce unnecessary customization

• support testing and UAT by preparing scenarios, clarifying defects and validating business outcomes

• maintain documentation including traceability, assumptions, decisions and current-state and future-state process maps

What You Bring

• 3-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role

• 2-3 years of experience working on ServiceNow implementations or ServiceNow-enabled transformations, with solid understanding and hands-on experience with ITSM

• experience across several domains such as CSM, IRM / GRC, CMDB / CSDM - a strong plus

• strong experience in requirements gathering, process analysis, user story writing and functional documentation within SDLC environments

• experience documenting current-state and future-state processes

• experience supporting UAT and business validation

• experience in greenfield platform implementations or transformation programs

• experience working in cross-functional environments and with platform governance and organizational change management (OCM)

• strong business analysis and process mapping skills

• good understanding of ServiceNow platform concepts and workflow-based solutions

• ability to translate ambiguous demand into clear, structured requirements

• strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills

• clear written and verbal communication

• ability to work across business, product, architecture and delivery teams

• ServiceNow CSA - preferred

• ITIL Foundation - preferred

• experience with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio or Lucidchart - preferred

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at  +48 538 562 645

.

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

• eseguire analisi fit-gap OOTB e sfidare la personalizzazione non necessaria presto
• identificare le opportunità per standardizzare, semplificare, ridisegnare, fase o reticolare i processi

• supporto test e UAT preparando scenari, chiarificando difetti e convalidando i risultati aziendali
• mantenere la documentazione tra cui tracciabilità, presupposti, decisioni e mappe del processo di stato attuale e stato futuro Che cosa porta
• 3-5 anni di esperienza come Business Analyst o in un ruolo simile
• 2–3 anni di esperienza lavorando sulle implementazioni di ServiceNow o sulle trasformazioni di ServiceNow, con una solida comprensione e un'esperienza pratica con ITSM
• esperienza in diversi domini come CSM, IRM / GRC, CMDB/CSDM – un vantaggio forte
• forte esperienza nei requisiti di raccolta, analisi dei processi, scrittura della storia dell'utente e documentazione funzionale all'interno degli ambienti SDLC
• esperienza che documenta i processi attuali e futuri-stato
• esperienza di supporto UAT e validazione aziendale
• esperienza nelle implementazioni della piattaforma greenfield o nei programmi di trasformazione

• forte analisi aziendale e capacità di mappatura dei processi
• buona comprensione dei concetti di piattaforma ServiceNow e soluzioni basate sul flusso di lavoro
• capacità di tradurre domanda ambigua in requisiti chiari e strutturati
• forte capacità di gestione e facilitazione delle officine
• comunicazione scritta e verbale chiara
• capacità di lavorare tra business, prodotto, architettura e team di consegna
• serviceNow CSA – Preferito

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale. L'analyste des affaires travaillera en étroite collaboration avec le propriétaire du produit, l'architecte de la plateforme et les intervenants commerciaux pour traduire la demande prioritaire en exigences claires et structurées, en veillant à ce que les solutions soient évolutives, en premier lieu OOTB et alignées sur la vision à long terme de la plateforme. Portée Le rôle soutient les exigences et la conception de processus dans plusieurs domaines de ServiceNow dans un contexte de plateforme de terrain vert, y compris: STIM – doit CSM – préféré CMDB / CSDM – préféré IRM / GRC – préféré HRSD – préféré Le candidat n'a pas besoin d'être aussi fort dans tous les domaines. L'expérience dans plusieurs domaines est suffisante. Ce que vous ferez
• recueillir, analyser et documenter les besoins opérationnels et fonctionnels en collaboration avec les intervenants de la GSTI, de la GSM, de la DGCM/DGSM, de la GIR/GRC et de la DGRH

• effectuer une analyse d'ajustement OOTB et de défier la personnalisation inutile tôt
• déterminer les possibilités de normaliser, simplifier, remanier, mettre en phase ou retirer les processus
• travailler en étroite collaboration avec le propriétaire du produit sur le perfectionnement de l'arriéré, la clarification de la portée et l'établissement des priorités

• soutenir les essais et les TAU par la préparation de scénarios, la clarification des défauts et la validation des résultats commerciaux
• tenir à jour la documentation, y compris la traçabilité, les hypothèses, les décisions et les cartes des processus actuels et futurs Ce que vous apportez

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans le domaine des implémentations ou des transformations utiles au serviceNow, avec une solide compréhension et une expérience pratique avec l'ITSM
• expérience dans plusieurs domaines tels que CSM, IRM / GRC, CMDB/CSDM – un plus fort

jobs.title: ServiceNow Platform Architect
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

ServiceNow Platform Architect

Warsaw |  Flexible hybrid model | Reference 7831

Do you want to shape how ServiceNow is used across the enterprise to drive transformation?

We are looking for a ServiceNow Platform Architect to join our CIT team in Warsaw. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping and governing the ServiceNow architecture in a greenfield environment, with direct influence on how the platform is designed, built and evolved across the organization.

You will design scalable cross-module solutions and drive standards, governance and best practices across the platform, ensuring a secure, compliant and future-ready setup in a regulated environment. You will work closely with the Platform Owner, Enterprise Architecture, Product Owner and key business stakeholders as part of a structured design authority, helping to build a strong and sustainable platform foundation in a complex enterprise landscape.

This role will also support the transformation from legacy service management and governance tooling into a standardized, scalable and future-ready ServiceNow platform model.

What You Will Do

• shape and assure the technical architecture of the ServiceNow platform, with a strong focus on stability, performance, security and maintainability

• ensure the ServiceNow platform architecture aligns with business strategy and supports secure, scalable and future-ready solutions

• define and maintain the technical architecture roadmap and provide architecture input into platform release planning

• identify opportunities to maximize value from ServiceNow investments and improve service delivery through automation and standardization

• define platform and data architecture standards, patterns and documentation, ensuring design consistency and data integrity across the platform

• guide teams through solution design, technical delivery and environment strategy, ensuring alignment with architectural standards

• enforce technical governance across the platform through defined standards, architecture reviews and design authority practices

• design cross-module solutions across ITSM, CMDB/CSDM, IRM/GRC, CSM, HRSD and related platform capabilities, ensuring end-to-end consistency and appropriate integration patterns

• define and drive the CMDB and service modelling strategy (CSDM) and provide architecture oversight for CMDB health and evolution

• act as a trusted advisor by translating business requirements into effective ServiceNow solutions and clearly communicating architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders

• drive solution direction in close collaboration with the Platform Owner and Enterprise Architecture, ensuring alignment with governance, security and overall platform strategy

• help ensure that legacy requirements are appropriately challenged and that the target platform evolves through standardization, simplification and scalable design principles

What You Bring

• bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

• 8+ years of ServiceNow experience, including substantial architecture responsibility in complex enterprise environments

• strong experience designing ServiceNow solutions in organizations with demanding compliance, audit and governance requirements

• CSA certification is mandatory

• additional certifications such as CAD, CIS ITSM or other relevant CIS certifications are strongly preferred

• strong understanding of ServiceNow implementation strategies, architectural best practices and platform governance

• certifications such as CIS CSM, CIS GRC, CIS SecOps are preferred

• CTA or CMA certifications are a strong advantage

• experience with AI is a strong plus

• experience with Git is preferred

• proven ability to design secure and compliant integrations, as well as enterprise-scale workflows

• experience designing CMDB/CSDM models integrated with BMC Discovery in complex enterprise environments is preferred

• experience contributing to Design Authority reviews and ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and platform strategy is a strong plus

• experience in highly regulated environments is preferred

• fluent English communication skills, written and spoken

• German language skills are preferred

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. ServiceNow Soluzione Architetto Varsavia | Modello ibrido flessibile | Riferimento 7831 Vuoi modellare come ServiceNow viene utilizzato in tutta l'azienda per guidare la trasformazione? Stiamo cercando un ServiceNow Platform Architect per unire il nostro team CIT a Varsavia. In questo ruolo, si assumerà un ruolo chiave nella modellazione e nel governo dell'architettura ServiceNow in un ambiente greenfield, con influenza diretta su come la piattaforma è costruita ed evolve in tutta l'organizzazione. Progetterai soluzioni cross-module scalabili e standard di azionamento, governance e best practice in tutta la piattaforma, garantendo una configurazione sicura, conforme e futura in un ambiente regolamentato. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il proprietario della piattaforma e l'architettura aziendale come parte di un'autorità di progettazione strutturata, svolgendo un ruolo centrale nella costruzione di una solida e sostenibile piattaforma di fondazione in un complesso paesaggio aziendale. Cosa farai
• Contabile per la stabilità complessiva, le prestazioni e la sicurezza della piattaforma ServiceNow.
• Garantire l'architettura della piattaforma ServiceNow si allinea alla strategia aziendale e offre soluzioni sicure, scalabili e future.
• Definire e mantenere il piano di rilascio roadmap della piattaforma tecnica a lungo termine.
• Identificare le opportunità per massimizzare il valore degli investimenti di ServiceNow e migliorare la consegna dei servizi attraverso l'automazione e la standardizzazione.
• Definire gli standard, i modelli e la documentazione della piattaforma e l'architettura dei dati, garantendo la coerenza e l'integrità dei dati della piattaforma.
• Guide team attraverso la progettazione di soluzioni, la consegna tecnica e la strategia ambientale, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard architettonici.
• Rafforzare la governance tecnica attraverso standard definiti e pratiche di autorità di progettazione.
• Soluzioni cross-module di progettazione in ITSM, CMDB, IRM/GRC, CSM, HRSD e relative funzionalità della piattaforma, garantendo la coerenza end-to-end e supervisionando le integrazioni.
• Definire e possedere la strategia CMDB e di modellazione dei servizi (CSDM), e supervisionare la salute CMDB.
• Agire come consulente di fiducia traducendo i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni ServiceNow efficaci e comunicare chiaramente le decisioni architettoniche e i trade-off a stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici.
• Guidare la soluzione in stretta collaborazione con Platform Owner e Enterprise Architect, garantendo l'allineamento con la governance, la sicurezza e la strategia globale della piattaforma. Che cosa porta
• Corso di laurea in Informatica, IT o un campo correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente, idealmente all'interno di ambienti aziendali regolamentati.
• Oltre 8 anni di esperienza di ServiceNow pratico in organizzazioni complesse con requisiti di conformità e audit esigenti.
• Certificazioni ServiceNow come CSA, CAD, CIS ITSM – obbligatorie.
• Forte comprensione delle strategie di implementazione di ServiceNow e delle migliori pratiche.
• CIS CSM, CIS GRC, CIS SecOps – preferito.
• Certificazioni CTA o CMA – preferite.
• Esperienza con AI – un vantaggio forte.
• Esperienza con Git – preferito.
• Prova capacità di progettare integrazioni sicure e conformi, così come flussi di lavoro su scala aziendale.
• Esperienza progettando modelli CMDB integrati con BMC Discovery in ambienti aziendali complessi e framework di governance – preferito.
• Capacità di contribuire alle recensioni di Design Authority, garantendo l'allineamento con l'architettura aziendale, la governance e la strategia di piattaforma – un vantaggio forte.
• Esperienza in ambienti altamente regolamentati – preferito.
• Capacità di comunicazione fluente inglese (scritta e parlata). Le competenze linguistiche tedesche – preferite. Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Agnieszka Leputa al numero +48 538 562 645 Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale. Traduzione:

jobs.title: Senior Observability Engineer
jobs.description:
The Senior Observability Engineer is a hands-on role for someone who has already built production observability capabilities—not only consumed observability platforms as an end user. You will help establish how telemetry is instrumented, collected, processed, visualized, alerted on, and governed across teams, leading early onboardings and shaping practical standards, processes, and ways of working.

Working closely with platform, product, and application teams, you will translate requirements into working telemetry solutions across traces, metrics, and logs, with OpenTelemetry as a core and mandatory technology. This role follows a trace-centric approach: metric-based deviations help detect issues, traces are the primary investigation path, and logs are used when additional detail is required. This is an opportunity to shape observability standards and engineering practices at enterprise scale, with direct influence on how teams instrument, operate, and troubleshoot critical services.

The Senior Observability Engineer is a hands-on role focused on building and delivering observability and AIOps as a shared engineering capability and service. You will help establish how observability is designed, implemented, and consumed across teams, leading early onboardings and shaping practical standards, processes, and ways of working.

Working closely with platform, product, and application teams, you will translate requirements into actionable observability solutions, implement and operate core capabilities, and continuously improve how insights, alerting, and automation support reliable services. As a core contributor to the Observability & AIOps Center of Excellence, you will combine deep technical execution with strong ownership of service quality, operational readiness, and capability maturity

What You Will Do

• design, deploy, and operate observability and AIOps capabilities for cloud-native and hybrid environments, supporting reliable, production-grade services

• lead the onboarding of teams and services, defining and applying standards for telemetry instrumentation, collection, SLIs, SLOs, and alerting in real-world systems using OpenTelemetry

Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di piattaforme, prodotti e applicazioni, tradurrai i requisiti in soluzioni di osservabilità attuabili, implementare e gestire le funzionalità core e migliorare continuamente come intuizioni, avvisi e servizi affidabili di automazione. Der Senior Observability Engineer ist eine praktische Rolle für jemanden, der bereits Produktionsbeobachtungsfunktionen aufgebaut hat - nicht nur Beobachtungsplattformen als Endbenutzer. Sie helfen dabei festzustellen, wie Telemetrie instrumentiert, gesammelt, verarbeitet, visualisiert, alarmiert und über Teams hinweg gesteuert wird, indem Sie frühe Onboardings leiten und praktische Standards, Prozesse und Arbeitsweisen gestalten.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Plattform-, Produkt- und Anwendungsteams werden Sie Anforderungen in funktionierende Telemetrielösungen über Traces, Metriken und Protokolle hinweg umsetzen, wobei OpenTelemetry als Kern- und Pflichttechnologie dient. Diese Rolle folgt einem Trace-zentrischen Ansatz: metrische Abweichungen helfen, Probleme zu erkennen, Traces sind der primäre Untersuchungspfad, und Protokolle werden verwendet, wenn zusätzliche Details erforderlich sind. Dies ist eine Gelegenheit, Beobachtbarkeitsstandards und Engineering-Praktiken auf Unternehmensebene zu gestalten, mit direktem Einfluss darauf, wie Teams kritische Dienste instrumentieren, betreiben und beheben.

Der Senior Observability Engineer ist eine praktische Rolle, die sich auf den Aufbau und die Bereitstellung von Observability und AIOps als gemeinsame Engineering-Fähigkeit und Service konzentriert. Sie helfen bei der Festlegung, wie die Beobachtbarkeit teamübergreifend gestaltet, implementiert und konsumiert wird, leiten frühe Onboardings und gestalten praktische Standards, Prozesse und Arbeitsweisen.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Plattform-, Produkt- und Anwendungsteams übersetzen Sie Anforderungen in umsetzbare Beobachtbarkeitslösungen, implementieren und betreiben Kernfunktionen und verbessern kontinuierlich, wie Erkenntnisse, Alarmierung und Automatisierung zuverlässige Dienste unterstützen. Als zentraler Beitrag zum Observability & AIOps Center of Excellence verbinden Sie eine umfassende technische Ausführung mit einer starken Verantwortung für Servicequalität, Betriebsbereitschaft und Reife der Fähigkeiten.

L'ingénieur principal d'observation est un rôle pratique pour quelqu'un qui a déjà construit des capacités d'observation de la production, non seulement les plateformes d'observation consommées comme utilisateur final. Vous aiderez à établir comment la télémétrie est instrumentée, recueillie, traitée, visualisée, alertée et gouvernée entre les équipes, menant les premières embarquements et façonnant les normes pratiques, les processus et les méthodes de travail.

En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de plate-forme, de produit et d'application, vous traduireez les exigences en solutions de télémétrie en service à travers les traces, les mesures et les journaux, avec OpenTelemetry comme technologie de base et obligatoire. Ce rôle suit une approche centrée sur les traces : les écarts métriques aident à détecter les problèmes, les traces sont le principal chemin d'investigation et les journaux sont utilisés lorsque des détails supplémentaires sont requis. C'est l'occasion de façonner les normes d'observation et les pratiques d'ingénierie à l'échelle de l'entreprise, avec une influence directe sur la façon dont les équipes instrumentent, exploitent et dépannent les services essentiels.

L'Ingénieur principal d'observation joue un rôle pratique axé sur la création et la prestation d'observations et d'opérations d'intelligence artificielle en tant que capacité et service d'ingénierie partagés. Vous aiderez à déterminer comment l'observabilité est conçue, mise en œuvre et consommée dans l'ensemble des équipes, à diriger les premières embarquements et à élaborer des normes, des processus et des méthodes de travail pratiques.

En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de plate-forme, de produit et d'application, vous transformerez les exigences en solutions d'observabilité actionnables, mettre en œuvre et exploiter des capacités de base, et améliorerez continuellement la façon dont les informations, l'alerte et l'automatisation soutiennent des services fiables. • concevoir, déployer et exploiter des capacités d'observation et d'IAOps pour des environnements cloud-natifs et hybrides, en supportant des services de qualité de production fiables

• diriger l'embarquement des équipes et des services, définir et appliquer des normes pour l'instrumentation de la télémétrie, la collecte, les SLI, les SLO et l'alerte dans les systèmes du monde réel en utilisant OpenTelemetry

• travailler avec des équipes d'ingénierie, de SRE et d'opérations pour rassembler les exigences et les traduire en solutions actionnables d'observation et d'automatisation

• installer, configurer, affiner et maintenir OpenTelemetry Collecteurs et pipelines de télémétrie pour les applications et les plateformes

• construire et maintenir des tableaux de bord, des alertes et des flux de télémétrie à travers le traçage distribué, les mesures et les journaux, en tirant parti d'OpenTelemetry pour fournir des informations utiles et réduire le bruit opérationnel

• gérer et développer des services d'observation qui appuient la détection des incidents, les enquêtes et la prise de décisions opérationnelles modernes

• concevoir, configurer et maintenir les intégrations avec les systèmes de gestion des événements et de billetterie pour le routage des alertes, le contexte des incidents et les flux de travail opérationnels

• expérience du déploiement, de la configuration et de l'exploitation OpenTelemetry Les collecteurs et la conception de pipelines de télémétrie constituent un avantage important; il s'agira là de responsabilités clés dans le rôle

jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

API Platform Engineer, Kong API & AI Gateway

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8187

Join our international platform team in Madrid and help application teams expose APIs and connect to AI services securely through a critical shared Kong platform.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure administration position. You will operate Kong in production, reduce toil through automation and build self-service paths for API onboarding and policy delivery.

The role suits an experienced engineer who already handles production topics independently and wants to broaden technical ownership. Direct Kong experience is welcome. Experience with another API gateway is equally relevant. What You'll Build First: Turn Kong AI Gateway into a production-ready service that gives application teams a secure, observable and self-service path to LLM and MCP connectivity. Build the guardrails for policy enforcement, traffic routing, rate limiting, auditability and reliable operations.

What You Will Do

• Operate and continuously improve our business-critical Kong API Gateway across OpenSnd Microsoft Azure, including incidents, changes, upgrades, security, capacity and lifecycle management.

• Design and build automation and self-service capabilities that make API onboarding, policy delivery and platform changes safer, faster and more consistent.

• Develop platform services and tooling using APIs, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.

• Establish actionable observability across metrics, logs and traces using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana and the Elastic Stack, and strengthen API security through policies, certificates, secrets and modern identity standards.

• Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis and turn operational learnings into durable platform improvements.

• Share on-call responsibility for the platform and use incidents to eliminate recurring operational toil.

What You Bring

• You do not need experience with every tool listed below. We are looking for solid production judgment, curiosity and the ability to take ownership.

• Hands-on experience operating an API gateway in a production environment.

• Strong production experience with Kubernetes or OpenShift and Microsoft Azure and services such as AKS and Entra ID.

• Proven automation skills using GitOps, CI/CD and infrastructure or configuration as code, with tools such as Terraform, Helm, Argo CD or GitLab CI.

• Software engineering or scripting experience. Go for Terraform integrations or Java and Spring Boot for self-service platform development is advantageous.

• Solid knowledge of networking, TLS, certificates, secrets and identity standards such as OAuth and OIDC.

• Experience with observability, incident response and root-cause analysis in business-critical, regulated environments. Knowledge of OpenTelemetry is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

API Platform Engineer, Kong API & AI Gateway

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8187

Join our international platform team in Madrid and help application teams expose APIs and connect to AI services securely through a critical shared Kong platform.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure administration position. You will operate Kong in production, reduce toil through automation and build self-service paths for API onboarding and policy delivery.

The role suits an experienced engineer who already handles production topics independently and wants to broaden technical ownership. Direct Kong experience is welcome. Experience with another API gateway is equally relevant. What You'll Build First: Turn Kong AI Gateway into a production-ready service that gives application teams a secure, observable and self-service path to LLM and MCP connectivity. Build the guardrails for policy enforcement, traffic routing, rate limiting, auditability and reliable operations.

What You Will Do

• Operate and continuously improve our business-critical Kong API Gateway across OpenSnd Microsoft Azure, including incidents, changes, upgrades, security, capacity and lifecycle management.

• Design and build automation and self-service capabilities that make API onboarding, policy delivery and platform changes safer, faster and more consistent.

• Develop platform services and tooling using APIs, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.

• Establish actionable observability across metrics, logs and traces using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana and the Elastic Stack, and strengthen API security through policies, certificates, secrets and modern identity standards.

• Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis and turn operational learnings into durable platform improvements.

• Share on-call responsibility for the platform and use incidents to eliminate recurring operational toil.

What You Bring

• You do not need experience with every tool listed below. We are looking for solid production judgment, curiosity and the ability to take ownership.

• Hands-on experience operating an API gateway in a production environment.

• Strong production experience with Kubernetes or OpenShift and Microsoft Azure and services such as AKS and Entra ID.

• Proven automation skills using GitOps, CI/CD and infrastructure or configuration as code, with tools such as Terraform, Helm, Argo CD or GitLab CI.

• Software engineering or scripting experience. Go for Terraform integrations or Java and Spring Boot for self-service platform development is advantageous.

• Solid knowledge of networking, TLS, certificates, secrets and identity standards such as OAuth and OIDC.

• Experience with observability, incident response and root-cause analysis in business-critical, regulated environments. Knowledge of OpenTelemetry is a plus.
